The digital-only carve is a narrower construct; the sound moves are a definition contest (mode REPLACE) or a separate digital-reverb entry, not an edge on the whole entry. STRIKE.

Law 3b: referent THING — a human-made audio effect, the correct standing designation. Law 1 made-side: scope says 'human-made audio effect... built to persist as a circuit design, pedal implementation, and sonic technique'. Law 12: name 'overdrive' is free (searched); the construct is distinct from the existing 'distortion' holder — overdrive is a specific clipping-family tone (soft clipping, warm even-order harmonics, tube-style drive) with its own circuit topologies and pedagogy, a specific construct under Law 3a's no-floor, not a rename of distortion. Definition filed in the same session (Law 5). ADVANCE.

Law 4 carve: states what it IS (soft-clipping effect from driving an amp/preamp beyond its linear range), its parameters (input drive level, gain staging, output level, tone stack), and the mechanism of persistence (circuit topology in guitar amps, stompbox design, taught/replicated tone shape). Distinguishing: soft clipping + even-order harmonics + warm character fits overdrive specifically and would not fit fuzz (hard full-wave rectification) or clean headroom. Ends with the Law 6 trailer. Not a generic template — every clause is specific to the construct. ADVANCE.

Law 12 check: 'wah-pedal' is a free name, distinct from the existing 'wah-wah' holder, whose accepted definition carves the TECHNIQUE ('a human-made audio effect technique that sweeps the center frequency of a bandpass filter', persisting as pedals, DSP plugins, and synth filter envelopes). Ezra's filing targets the physical DEVICE: foot-operated hardware (potentiometer, spring-loaded rocker) — Law 3a's no-floor explicitly invites specific instruments as full corporata. Concrete distinction test (Law 13i): the device can vary and cease independently (rocker mechanics, pot taper, enclosure, discontinuation of the original Vox unit) while the technique persists (plugins); the technique operates without the device (laptop plugin wah). Device vs technique is a real independent operation, not a rename. Scope is made-side and persistence-grounded. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense fails under the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). audio-effect carves: alters a sound signal to create a version distinguishable from the unprocessed source. A sampler's output is NOT a modified version of its input signal — it is stored-sample playback triggered by performance input (keyboard/MIDI); the MIDI trigger is not a sound signal passing through to be altered. It is an instrument/playback device (cf. synthesizer), not a member of the audio-effect kind. 'Competent speakers call it an audio effect' is not the test — the target's definition is, and the sampler does not satisfy it.

Removal test passes (Law 8a/8b): a noise-gate's entire operation is comparing incoming level against a threshold to decide open/closed; remove the threshold and it has no operational reference — a device that always attenuates or never gates is a different device (constant attenuator / pass-through), not a noise-gate. Threshold here is the functional principle the gate needs to operate, not its identity — same shape as the accepted compressor→threshold ruling. Direction is correct: gate→threshold, not the reverse.

Textbook INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): overdrive's accepted mechanism — driving a circuit beyond linear range, soft clipping, warm even-order harmonics — is the soft-clipping member of the distortion kind, and the target's definition explicitly carves 'clipping (hard or soft)' as its mechanism. Overdrive is specific (gentle, warm, even-harmonic) and distortion is the general kind. Direction specific→general is correct; nearest kind, no ladder leap.

Pinned sense holds under the target's accepted definition (Law 11d): overdrive intentionally alters a sound signal (soft clipping adds harmonics) producing a version distinguishable from the unprocessed source — exactly what audio-effect carves, and distortion (a sonic-result category in that definition) is its nearest rung. The direct leap is not yet derivable: the overdrive→distortion rung is still PENDING, so Law 11e does not bar it now; when that rung lands, this edge retires as SUBSUMED without penalty, which is the designed flow — no reason to strike a true edge that will self-resolve.

Removal test passes (Law 8a/8b): an equalizer operates by splitting the signal into bands and adjusting per-band gain — that per-band selection IS filtering (a set of bandpass filters with independent gain). Remove the filter construct and the equalizer has no means to shape the spectrum; a device that cannot select frequency bands is not an equalizer. Filter is the functional principle the equalizer needs to operate, not its identity (an EQ is not a filter) and not its purpose. Same shape as the accepted compressor→threshold ruling; direction EQ→filter is correct.

Removal test passes decisively: the wah-wah entry's own accepted definition names its mechanism — 'the input signal passes through a bandpass filter whose center frequency is modulated.' The effect IS a time-varying bandpass filter; remove the filter construct and there is no operating mechanism left (no way to sweep a resonant center frequency). Filter is a functional principle of operation, not the wah-wah's identity (the wah-wah is the swept-filter effect, not 'a filter' simpliciter) and not its purpose. Direction correct: wah-wah→filter.

Removal test passes (Law 8a/8b): the sampler's own accepted definition is 'records audio segments into digital memory and replays them' — retention of the captured segment IS its mechanism. Remove storage (the system retaining retrievable information in a durable substrate) and there is nothing to hold the sample between capture and playback: the device degenerates to pass-through and stops operating as a sampler. Storage is a functional requirement, not the sampler's identity (a sampler is not storage) and not its purpose. 'storage' is the nearest live rung — no finer digital-memory entry exists on the board. Direction correct: sampler→storage.

The removal test fails against the from-node as defined. The reverb entry's accepted definition is implementation-neutral — 'a sound processing technique that creates the acoustic effect of reflections in an enclosed space' — and carves in spring reverbs (metal-spring tank) and plate reverbs (vibrating plate), which operate with no delay-line anywhere in the chain; remove delay-lines and they still work. The filer's pinned sense ('digital and algorithmic reverb implementations') is a proper subset of the source entry, and an edge from an entry must hold of the whole entry, not a cherry-picked subclass — pinning a narrower sense to rescue the claim is the cherry-pick pattern this court strikes. The true dependency is finer (algorithmic/convolution reverbs → delay-line or impulse-response), and the board already carries reverb→signal-processing for the class-level dependency. STRIKE this one; a subclass-specific edge belongs on a subclass-specific entry.

Not a duplicate of distortion (Law 12): overdrive is the specific kind — soft clipping, warm even-order harmonics — while the accepted distortion entry carves the general kind including hard clipping; the board's pattern accepts specific effect kinds as their own entries (flanger, noise-gate, ring-modulator, wah-wah all stand). Law 5 compound is complete: first definition is filed in the same sitting, carves parameters (input drive level, gain staging, output level, tone stack) and a persistence mechanism naming real substrates (amp circuit topology, stompbox design, pedagogy), and carries the Law 6 trailer.

Made-side construct (Laws 1-3): a human-made physical guitar-effects device — foot-operated sweep of a bandpass filter's center frequency. Referent THING correct. Not a duplicate of the accepted wah-wah entry (Law 12): wah-wah is the EFFECT/technique (any swept bandpass, however modulated), wah-pedal is the DEVICE (potentiometer + spring-loaded rocker under a foot). A compressor adjusts gain based on signal level relative to a threshold — this is AGC/gain-control, not amplitude modulation. AM conventionally means a carrier signal whose amplitude is varied by a separate modulating signal (like an LFO in tremolo). A compressor's envelope follower reads the signal's OWN level, not an independent modulating signal. The note conflates 'varying amplitude' with 'amplitude modulation.' Remove amplitude-modulation and a compressor still operates as a gain-control device. This is identity-as-dependency (Law 8c): a compressor IS a type of amplitude manipulation, but that makes it INSTANCE_OF a broader category, not DEPENDS_ON amplitude-modulation.

Pin sense held: bandpass filter with foot-controlled center frequency.

Law 8c: identity is not dependency. The tremolo's accepted definition carves its mechanism as 'a low-frequency oscillator (LFO) modulating the amplitude envelope of the audio signal' - which is exactly the accepted AM carve ('amplitude of a higher-frequency carrier varied proportionally by a lower-frequency modulating signal') with audio-band parameters. A tremolo IS a specific kind of amplitude modulation (the standard classification: tremolo is AM, vibrato is FM); that is-a relation is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. A removal argument that removes the thing's own kind is trivially true of every is-a pair and carries no weight. The right edge is tremolo INSTANCE_OF amplitude-modulation. STRIKE.

Distinct made-thing, not a duplicate: the standing pitch-shift and pitch-shifting entries carve the TRANSFORMATION (procedure / algorithmic transformation of a signal); this entry carves the DEVICE - a persistent artifact built to persist as hardware pedal, rack unit, or software plugin, which is its own corporatum under Law 3a (the kingdom has no floor; products stand beside techniques, as screwdriver stands beside leverage). Scope is on the made side and states the persistence mechanism. Names are distinct after Law 12 normalization (pitch-shifter vs pitch-shift vs pitch-shifting). Law 5 definition follows in the definition lane. ADVANCE.

audio-effect's accepted definition: a device/technique that intentionally alters a sound signal into a distinguishable version of the unprocessed source. A pitch-shifter's output IS the modified input — pitch changed, duration preserved (PSOLA/resampling/granular all transform the received signal, they do not generate it from a separate carrier). Specific kind of the category; note's pinned sense (an effect altering pitch while preserving duration) sits inside the carve. Not a source/instrument, so no sampler-style objection applies.

Delay-line is an implementation family, not the constitutive mechanism: convolution reverbs (recorded impulse response), statistical/J-type reverbs, and IIR/FIR-based algorithmic reverbs all produce the dense decaying repetitions the note describes without any delay-line construct. Remove delay-line now and reverb does not stop operating — it stops operating only in the delay-line implementation family. The note proves the mechanism of one family and generalizes it; that is the Law 8b failure.

The accepted definition of amplitude-modulation is specific: a carrier varied proportionally by a lower-frequency modulating signal, producing carrier plus upper/lower sidebands. A compressor's mechanism is envelope detection feeding a variable gain element (threshold/ratio/attack/release) — its output has no carrier and no sidebands; it is level-dependent attenuation, not modulation. The note argues 'this IS amplitude-modulation' by redefining AM as any amplitude variation, i.e. it addresses a different sense than the target's carve (Law 11d). Remove the AM construct and compressors still operate; remove the envelope follower or the VCA and they do not. Wrong dependency.

Coherent made-side entry: a human-made device/algorithm (pitch change with duration preserved) built to persist as pedals, rack units, and plugins — passes Laws 1-3, THING referent is correct. Not a duplicate: no accepted pitch-shifter in the live graph. The empty definitions lane is the Law 5 half-born state, which is a fillable lane, not incoherence — the completing definition is its own act. The entry as filed is a real claim.

audio-effect's accepted definition carves a device/technique that alters a sound signal into a distinguishable version of the unprocessed source. The vocoder's own accepted definition says the opposite mechanism: it analyzes the input into a compact parametric representation and 'synthesizes a new signal from it' — the input waveform is discarded after analysis, and the output is generated from the parameter set (carrier bank or IFFT of STFT frames), not derived from the source. A vocoder is in the source/instrument family (a synthesizer driven by an analyzer), exactly the class I hold outside the audio-effect carve: being marketed as a DAW effect plugin does not make the mechanism an alteration of the incoming signal. The note's 'modified output through synthesis' conflates generation with modification.

Distortion's accepted definition: driving a signal beyond the linear operating range of a circuit or algorithm, causing clipping (hard or soft) that generates new harmonic and subharmonic frequencies, persisting as analog topology or digital algorithm (waveshaping, impulse-response convolution). Tape saturation's own definition is precisely the tape instantiation of that carve: soft clipping, even-order harmonic generation, level-dependent compression, persisting as a waveshaping plugin/algorithm and hardware emulation. Specific kind of the general effect; the note's pinned sense (the soft-clip/even-harmonic 'warmth' archetype) sits inside the definition's parameters. True instance, not a leap.

Filter's accepted definition: a construct applying a frequency-dependent modification via a designed transfer function, the 'such as low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or notch' list being illustrative, not exhaustive. The phaser's constitutive mechanism is a cascade of all-pass sections — frequency-dependent phase modification with unity gain — and every known implementation (analog op-amp all-pass stages, digital IIR all-pass sections, matrix variants) is a phase-shifting filter network. Remove the filter construct and the phaser has no mechanism left: unlike the reverb/delay-line case (where convolution is an alternative family), there is no non-filter phaser. The note pins the all-pass sense; under the definition's operative clause (frequency-dependent modification) all-pass sits inside the carve.

The note's mechanism (envelopes modulating 'a synthesizer, usually a bank of oscillators') describes one founding line — the classic CV vocoder. But the target's own accepted definition names two founding lines, and the spectral/phase line (Flatte 1972; the phase vocoder) synthesizes by inverse STFT of modified frames — no oscillator, no envelope generator, no LFO: nothing that is a synthesizer under that entry's carve (oscillators, filters, ADSR, modulation). Remove the synthesizer construct and the phase vocoder still operates, so the removal test fails. The dependency, if any, would run to the oscillator or to the transform, and the note's single-line mechanism does not establish a family-wide necessity.

Wrong target. The note pins the sense 'discretization of a continuous signal into time-stamped numerical values' — signal sampling. But the sampling entry in this record carries statistical sampling: all four accepted definitions are about selecting a subset of units from a larger population for inference (population, selection protocol, sample size, inference target). Judges judge the pinned sense against the target's accepted definition (Law 11d), and signal discretization is not the sense this entry carries. Whatever the fate of a signal-sampling construct, pitch-shifter does not DEPEND_ON statistical sampling — remove survey methodology and pitch-shifters still operate. Additionally the note's 'all real-time techniques rely on sampling' overreaches: tape-based analog pitch-shifting predates and survives digital discretization.

The wah's constitutive mechanism is a swept band-pass: the note's 'band-pass filter whose center frequency is controlled by a foot pedal' is the definition of the device, and band-pass sits explicitly inside filter's accepted carve (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch). Remove the filter construct and the wah has no mechanism — every implementation (analog inductor/LR44-style, digital swept resonance, parametric EQ emulation) is a band-pass with a swept center frequency; there is no non-filter wah. The note's 'it IS a filter with a specific control interface' is the right dependency reading: the device executes the mechanism, and the mechanism is the target.

Tremolo's mechanism sits inside amplitude-modulation's accepted carve exactly: the audio signal is the higher-frequency carrier, the LFO is the lower-frequency modulating signal, and the amplitude is varied proportionally by it — the definition even names 'audio synthesis' as an AM application producing timbral effects. This is the mirror image of the compressor edge I struck: a compressor's gain follows the signal's OWN envelope (level-dependent attenuation, no independent modulator, no sidebands), while tremolo has an independent modulating source producing the AM product. Remove the AM construct and tremolo has no mechanism for periodic amplitude variation. Removal test passes; pinned sense matches the target's definition (Law 11d).

Scope carves a human-made audio processing device/algorithm with explicit persistence as hardware/software plugin. Name is lowercase noun, made-side, refers to THING. No duplication apparent. Provisional entry is coherent and fits Law 1-3.

Definition carves parameters: pitch interval ratio, duration-preservation constraint vs varispeed, time-alignment mechanism (PSOLA/WSOLA, phase-vocoder, granular), artifact behavior. Persistence mechanism listed as hardware pedals, software plugins, DSP algorithms. Ends with Law 6 trailer. Carves map correctly.

Tape saturation is a specific kind of distortion characterized by soft clipping and even-order harmonics with level-dependent compression. Note pins sense and shows nearest kind is distortion, not audio-effect shelf. Direction specific->general correct per Law 9.

Vocoder processes audio signals to produce modified output through synthesis. Competent classification places it under audio effects. Note pins sense as audio processing device/effect. Nearest kind is audio-effect, direction specific->general correct.

DEPENDS_ON requires removal of Y now stops X operating. Reverb can be realized via convolution with impulse responses and does not operationally require delay-lines as a distinct component; delay-line is an implementation technique, not a necessary operating prerequisite across the full scope of reverb. The note conflates implementation building block with operational dependency. Earlier ruling struck this edge.

Wah pedal is a specific kind of filter with foot-controlled center frequency, not a device that depends on a separate filter component. The relation is identity / kind, not operational dependency. Law 8c: identity is not dependency. Correct relation is INSTANCE_OF filter or DEPENDS_ON band-pass-filter as specific kind, not generic filter.

Compressor adjusts amplitude via gain envelope, which is a form of amplitude modulation, but amplitude-modulation is not a separate component the compressor relies on to operate; it is the mechanism itself. Law 8c: identity is not dependency. The edge confuses mechanism with dependency.

Pitch-shifter is a specific kind of audio effect that alters pitch while preserving duration. A competent audio engineer would call a pitch-shifter an audio effect. Direction specific->general correct.

Tape saturation's definition carves soft clipping, even-order harmonics, level-dependent compression. Distortion's accepted definition covers clipping generating new harmonics. Tape saturation is a specific implementation class named in distortion's definition. Nearest kind per Law 11e is distortion, not the audio-effect shelf, so specific→general is correct.

Vocoder processes audio and produces modified output through synthesis/analysis. The accepted audio-effect definition carves intentional alteration of sound signals. Vocoder is a specific kind of audio effect used as an effect in music production. Specific→general per Law 9, nearest kind is audio-effect.

The target entry 'sampling' in the record is the statistical procedure of selecting a subset from a population, not audio signal discretization. The note describes sampling as discretization of continuous signals, which is a different sense of 'sampling' (audio sampling). The edge therefore pins the wrong sense to the existing entry; under Law 11d judges judge the pinned sense against the target's accepted definition, which is statistical. The dependency claim does not hold for the recorded definition.

Classic source-filter vocoder architecture uses a bank of oscillators as the sound source whose amplitudes are modulated by the analyzed envelope. Removing the synthesizer removes the sound-producing element, so the vocoder stops operating. The note pins the sense of synthesizer as the sound-generating element, matching the removal test in Law 8.

Phaser's mechanism is a cascade of all-pass filters creating phase-shifted paths that interfere. The accepted definition of filter covers frequency-dependent phase shift. Removing filters eliminates the phase-shift network, so the phaser cannot operate. Dependency holds per Law 8 removal test.

Definition carves pitch-shifting as pitch change with duration preservation, lists parameters pitch interval, duration-preservation constraint, time-alignment mechanism PSOLA/WSOLA/phase-vocoder/granular, artifact behavior. Persistence mechanism via hardware/software/DSP. Ends with Law 6 trailer. Coherent carving.

The edge claims ALL reverb depends on delay-line, but physical reverb (rooms, halls, plates, springs) operates independently of delay lines. The note's argument only covers digital/algorithmic reverb (Schroeder/FDN families), not reverb as a general phenomenon. The removal test fails for the broad concept: remove delay-lines and plate reverb, spring reverb, and natural acoustic reverb continue to operate perfectly.

The definition correctly identifies pitch-shifter as changing pitch while preserving duration. It distinguishes from time-stretching (which preserves pitch) and clearly states the mechanism: DSP techniques like resampling or phase vocoding. Well-carved definition that states parameters and persistence mechanism.

Direction verified: overdrive → amplification. Removal test: remove amplification and the overdrive stage has nothing to 'over-drive'; the effect ceases to operate. The note correctly identifies amplification as the constitutive mechanism — not a parameter. The note pins the sense of 'amplification' as the signal-amplification stage/mechanism, which matches the target entry's definition.

Direction verified: compressor → amplification. Removal test: a compressor controls gain by adjusting amplification relative to a threshold — remove amplification and the compressor has no mechanism to operate. The note pins amplification as the gain-adjustment mechanism. This is a constitutive dependency, not a parameter dependency.

Direction verified: ring-modulator → amplitude-modulation. Removal test: ring modulation IS a form of amplitude modulation (suppressing the carrier, multiplying two signals). Remove amplitude-modulation and ring modulation has no mechanism — it operates by varying signal amplitude via multiplication. The sense is pinned correctly.

Direction verified: vibrato → modulation. Removal test: vibrato is pitch variation produced by modulation (typically LFO modulating frequency). Remove modulation and the vibrato mechanism ceases. The note correctly pins 'modulation' as the general mechanism — the removal test passes even at this level of generality.

Direction verified: limiter → compressor. Removal test: a limiter is a compressor with an extreme ratio (effectively infinite). Remove compression and the limiter's mechanism disappears — it IS a specialized compressor. The note correctly identifies the constitutive dependency.

Direction verified: chorus → delay. Removal test: chorus duplicates a signal and applies slight delay variations. Remove delay and chorus has no core mechanism — it becomes just a signal duplication with no thickening effect. The note pins 'delay' as the time-shift mechanism, which is constitutive.

Direction verified: chorus → modulation. Removal test: chorus adds time-varying character by modulating the delay time (typically with an LFO). Remove modulation and chorus loses its time-varying character — it reduces to a static delay, not a chorus effect. The modulation is what distinguishes chorus from simple delay.

Direction verified: flanger → delay. Removal test: flanger mixes a signal with a delayed copy whose delay time is swept. Remove delay and flanger has no mechanism — the core operation IS time-shifted signal mixing. The note correctly identifies delay as the constitutive mechanism.

Reconsidered: reverb as an entry covers the general concept (physical, plate, spring, and algorithmic). Not all reverbs depend on delay-lines — physical room acoustics, plate reverbs, and spring reverbs operate without delay-lines. The edge is too broad. Only algorithmic/digital reverbs depend on delay-lines, but the entry is not limited to those.

Definition carves: pitch-shifter changes pitch while preserving duration. The distinction from playback-speed change is correctly drawn. The mechanism (resynthesis, granular, or phase-vocoder processing) is implied by the contrast. Trailer is present. This is a clean, well-carved definition.

A limiter is the standard textbook special case of a compressor: the same threshold-based variable gain-reduction computation run at an extreme (ideally infinite) ratio. The compressor's own accepted definition ('attenuating levels above a set threshold... gain-reduction computation') IS the mechanism a limiter executes. Removal test (Laws 2b/8b): remove the compressor mechanism and the limiter has no mechanism to clamp the ceiling. Pinned sense (infinite-ratio compression) matches the target's accepted definition. Coherent with the already-accepted rungs: limiter INSTANCE_OF dynamic-range-compression and limiter DEPENDS_ON threshold — the mechanism is compression with the ratio parameter pushed to its limit.

Removal test fails (Laws 2b/8b). The compressor's own accepted definition carves gain REDUCTION: 'reduces the dynamic range by attenuating levels above a set threshold... gain-reduction computation.' Attenuation is the opposite of amplification, and a compressor can be built from pure attenuation alone (VCA/opto/clipper stages); makeup gain is an optional parameter, not the mechanism. Remove amplification and the compressor still compresses. The note's 'the core operation IS controlled amplification' mischaracterizes the target's defined mechanism — the core operation is controlled gain reduction. The note's own parenthetical '(signal gain adjustment)' shows the stretch: gain is not amplification (gain below unity is attenuation). I do not strike on sense grounds — the electronics sense is admitted into this entry by the accepted resonance ruling — but the pinned mechanism is not the one the target defines or the one the dependent actually needs.

Correction of my earlier STRIKE after reading both accepted definitions: the live 'saturation' entry carves a GENERAL state — 'the point at which a system, medium, or perceptual field reaches maximum capacity, beyond which additional input yields diminishing returns.' Tape-saturation's own definition: a technique that simulates distortion 'produced when an analog magnetic tape recorder is driven beyond its linear operating range' — i.e. the tape MEDIUM reaching its saturation state. That is a specific instance of the target's general carve (Law 11d satisfied), and the relationship is DEPENDENCY, not identity: an audio effect technique is not a kind of a state/point, so 'is-a' does not apply (unlike lfo->oscillation or tremolo->AM). The technique operates BY driving the tape into the saturation region; remove that maximum-capacity behavior and the mechanism ceases. A genuine functional dependency (screwdriver->leverage kind). Advance.

Correction of my earlier ADVANCE after reading the target's accepted definition: the live entry 'amplification' carves a RHETORICAL technique (strengthening a point by elaboration, repetition with intensification, cumulative detail) — not signal gain. The filer's pinned sense is a gain/amplifier stage ('driving an amplification stage beyond its linear range'), which is a different sense than the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). Overdrive depends on a hardware gain stage, not on rhetorical amplification; removing the rhetorical technique does nothing to the pedal. The removal test only holds against the gain sense the target does not carve. Cherry-picked sense — struck on Law 11d (pinned sense ≠ target's accepted definition).

The note pins identity: 'Ring modulation IS a form of amplitude modulation where the carrier is suppressed.' That is an is-a claim, Law 8c: identity is not dependency. Ring modulation does not operate WITH amplitude-modulation as a part — it IS the suppressed-carrier case of it. The removal test is circular (remove AM and ring modulation is gone because AM is its whole mechanism, i.e. its identity). The correct edge is INSTANCE_OF, and the accepted rung ring-modulator INSTANCE_OF amplitude-modulation already carries that sense. Struck on Law 8c.

Same pattern as the tremolo->amplitude-modulation ruling: the note defines vibrato AS low-frequency modulation of oscillator frequency. Vibrato is a kind of (frequency) modulation, not a mechanism that operates with modulation as a separate part. The removal test ('remove modulation and vibrato has no mechanism') is circular because modulation is the identity of the pinned sense, not a component. Law 8c: identity is not dependency. The right edge is INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind. Struck.

The filer explicitly pins the gain sense: 'it adjusts amplification based on signal level... Remove amplification (signal gain adjustment).' But the live accepted entry 'amplification' carves a RHETORICAL technique — strengthening a point by elaboration, repetition with intensification, cumulative detail. That is not signal gain; removing rhetorical amplification does nothing to a compressor. The pinned sense is a different sense of the same word than the target's accepted definition — Law 11d, the same cherry-pick pattern as the watermarking and 'bias' rulings. A compressor's gain mechanism would need a gain/amplifier-startery entry, not this one. Struck.

The note pins identity: 'A limiter is a compressor with an extremely high ratio that prevents signals from exceeding a threshold.' The limiter's own accepted definition — threshold, real-time gain reduction, infinite:1 ratio — is a specific kind of the accepted compressor carve (threshold-gated dynamic range reduction). A kind-of relationship is Law 9 INSTANCE_OF, not Law 8c-eligible DEPENDS_ON: the target is not a part the limiter operates with, it is the category the limiter belongs to. The removal test ('remove compression and the limiter has no mechanism') is circular because the compressor IS the limiter's identity. Correct edge: limiter INSTANCE_OF compressor. Struck on Law 8c.

Pinned sense: chorus duplicates the signal and adds slight delay variations; its mechanism is time-delayed signal mixing. Removal test (Law 8b): take delay out of the world and chorus has no mechanism left to operate — an undelayed duplicate sum is just dry signal doubling, not chorus. Delay is a constitutive signal operation here, not an implementation family, so this is a true dependency, not chronology (Law 8a) and not a definitional restatement (Law 8c).

Pinned sense: chorus adds its time-varying character by modulating the delay time with a low-frequency source. Removal test: strip modulation (varying one signal parameter by another) and the effect degenerates to a static delayed copy — a plain delay, not chorus. The defining slow, organic thickening is precisely the modulated leg, so chorus genuinely stops OPERATING as chorus without it. This complements the accepted-shape chorus→delay edge; the two are the two constitutive legs, not a duplicate claim.

Pinned sense: flanger mixes the dry signal with a slightly delayed copy whose delay time is swept. Removal test: remove delay and the flanger has no mechanism — the swept short-delay comb is exactly the flange; without it there is only the dry signal. Delay here is the constitutive operation, not an implementation family (the claim does not require any particular hardware or DSP scheme). True present-tense dependency under Law 8b; no chronology involved (Law 8a).

Pinned sense: tape saturation is a specific form of saturation — soft limiting of the magnetic medium. Removal test: remove saturation (the waveform soft-clipping behavior) and tape saturation has no mechanism to operate; its entire action IS the head's saturation curve. The effect runs on the general physical behavior the way a technique runs on its discipline — a true constitutive dependency, not 'X is a definition of Y' (Law 8c) and not chronology (Law 8a). Direction is correct: the specific effect points at the mechanism it executes.

The note concedes its point: only 'digital reverbs and many algorithmic reverbs' use delay-line networks. Removal test fails — convolution reverbs operate by convolving the signal with an impulse response, and plate/spring/room reverbs operate mechanically, none of which requires a delay-line as their mechanism. An alternative re-expression keeps reverb fully OPERATING (Law 8b), so delay-line is one implementation family among several, not a constitutive dependency. This is the same shape I struck before: an effect does not DEPEND_ON the implementation families that happen to realize it. The note describes how some reverbs are built, not what reverb requires.

Law 11d: the judge judges the pinned sense per the TARGET'S accepted definition. The target 'amplification' has exactly one live definition, and it carves the RHETORICAL technique (auxesis: strengthening a point through elaboration and intensifying expression; persisted via rhetorical handbooks). The filer pinned the electronics sense — an amplifier stage driven beyond its linear range — which the target's accepted definition does not carve. Overdrive does not depend on a rhetorical technique, so the edge as targeted is false. The electronics sense of amplification is currently homeless in this graph (no entry holds it), which is why this edge mis-aims; the sound fix is a dedicated construct for signal-level amplification, not borrowing the rhetorical entry. (The removal test would pass for the electronics sense, but that sense is not this target.)

Law 11d satisfied: the target's accepted definition carves the signal-processing AM sense (carrier amplitude varied proportionally by a modulating signal, producing sidebands), and the filer pinned exactly that sense — ring modulation as carrier-suppressed AM. Removal test: take amplitude modulation out and ring modulation has no mechanism left; its entire operation is multiplying the input by a modulating waveform, which is AM with the carrier term suppressed. Consistent with the accepted tremolo DEPENDS_ON amplitude-modulation rung of identical shape, and complementary to the already-accepted ring-modulator INSTANCE_OF amplitude-modulation edge (kind and dependency are distinct relations, both true here). Not a definitional restatement (Law 8c): the specific circuit runs on the general mechanism, it is not merely a rewording of it.

Law 11d satisfied: the target's accepted definition carves the signal-processing sense (a carrier's properties systematically varied by a modulating signal) and explicitly lists frequency modulation as a member type; the filer pinned vibrato as low-frequency modulation of oscillator pitch, which is periodic FM — squarely the target's sense. Removal test: strip modulation (varying one signal parameter by another) and vibrato has no mechanism — an unmodulated oscillator gives a steady tone, not vibrato. Same shape as the accepted tremolo→amplitude-modulation rung and consistent with this shift's chorus→modulation advance: the effect runs on the modulation mechanism as its constitutive operation.

Fails twice over. (1) Law 11d: the target 'amplification' has one live definition and it carves the RHETORICAL technique (auxesis); the filer pinned an electronics sense ('signal gain adjustment') the target does not hold, and a compressor does not depend on a rhetorical technique. (2) Even read under the filer's own electronics sense, the removal test fails: the compressor's accepted definition states it operates by ATTENUATING levels above a threshold — gain reduction, not gain increase; makeup gain is an optional compensation, not the mechanism. A pure gain-reduction compressor still operates in a world without amplification, so the claimed dependency is not constitutive. The honest dependency here, if any, runs to the dynamic-range-compression technique the compressor already points at via its accepted INSTANCE_OF rung — not to this target.

Mis-targeted dependency. The limiter's constitutive mechanism is threshold-based gain reduction — the dynamic-range-compression technique — and the graph already expresses the family correctly via accepted rungs (limiter INSTANCE_OF dynamic-range-compression, alongside compressor INSTANCE_OF DRC). The compressor is a SIBLING device instantiating the same technique, not the mechanism: remove the compressor kind from the world and the limiter still operates, realized directly as a peak-clamping DRC device. The note's own removal argument gives this away — 'remove COMPRESSION and the limiter has no mechanism' addresses the DRC technique, a different pairing than the compressor device this edge points at. The note's opening ('a limiter is a compressor with an extremely high ratio') is a kind claim, which belongs to the INSTANCE_OF lane already covered by the DRC ladder, not to DEPENDS_ON. Coherent claim, wrong target: STRIKE.

tape-saturation is a specific kind of saturation, not an operational dependency. Removing saturation removes the category itself; the relation is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. Identity is not dependency per Law 8c.

Implementation detail, not operational dependency. Reverb can be built with other primitives; removing delay-lines does not universally stop reverb operation, and the note describes mechanism not removal test. Previous ruling struck this as implementation not operational dependency.

Ring modulation is a specific form of amplitude modulation. The relation is INSTANCE_OF, already accepted. DEPENDS_ON would require a distinct component whose removal stops operation, not a subclass identity. Law 8c identity is not dependency.
Chorus operation is time-delayed signal mixing. Removing delay removes the mechanism by which chorus creates thickened sound. Operational removal test satisfied; note pins sense correctly.
Flanger relies on time-shifted signal mixing with a delayed copy. Remove delay and the core sweep mechanism disappears. Operational dependency holds.

Chorus is a specific kind of modulation, not an operational dependency on modulation as a separate component. Removing modulation removes the category; the correct relation is INSTANCE_OF. Identity is not dependency per Law 8c.

Vibrato is a specific form of frequency modulation, i.e., a kind of modulation. The relation is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. Removing modulation removes the category itself, not a separable component.
Overdrive requires an amplification stage to be driven beyond linear range. Remove amplification and the effect ceases to operate. Operational removal test satisfied.

Entry carves a human-made audio processing device with a clear persistence mechanism (circuit and software implementation) and a specific function (adds upper harmonics). Scope pins the made-side construct, not the natural phenomenon of harmonics. The definition lane is empty but Law 5 requires definition at filing; the entry alone is provisional and the scope justification is coherent. No collision apparent. Advancing keeps the audio-processing taxonomy open for the pending INSTANCE_OF edge.

Harmonic exciter is a specific implementation of an audio effect class. The note pins the sense as a kind of audio processing effect designed to add harmonic content. INSTANCE_OF points specific→general, and audio-effect is the nearest kind in the taxonomy. The direction is correct and the edge is not derivable via an intermediate ladder. Advancing preserves taxonomic specificity.

The note pins the sense to algorithmic reverbs and states the removal test: remove feedback and the tail collapses, the reverberant field stops building. For FDN/Schroeder topologies, feedback loops are constitutive for sustaining decay. The edge is operational, not conceptual necessity for all physical reverbs, but the pinned sense is coherent and testable. Direction is correct: reverb → feedback.

Pitch-shifting via time-domain methods (PSOLA/WSOLA) uses variable delay lines to resample the signal while preserving duration. The definition pins time-alignment mechanism including delay-based resampling. Removing the delay-line construct removes the storage-and-retrieval mechanism that enables variable read/write rates; the core time-stretch/pitch-shift operation ceases. This is an operational dependency, not merely conceptual sayability.

The definition of ring modulator says it multiplies two input signals (carrier and modulator), not specifically oscillators. While oscillators are common sources, the device operates on any signal pair. Removing oscillators does not stop the ring modulator from operating on other sources (e.g., audio inputs). The note pins a narrow sense that is not constitutive to the defined construct. This is a coherent but wrong claim — STRIKE.

The target entry 'saturation' is defined in the record as a methodological concept in qualitative research / generic capacity point, with scope justification explicitly about research saturation. The note pins saturation as 'physical phenomenon of signal overload causing harmonic generation' — a different sense than the entry's accepted definition. DEPENDS_ON requires the pinned sense to match the target's accepted carve. Sense mismatch means the edge is coherent but wrong for this target. STRIKE.

Flanger's mechanism is a short delay line with LFO-modulated delay time, not the audio effect 'delay' as a discrete repeat effect. Flanger already DEPENDS_ON delay-line accepted. Delay is defined as a human-made audio effect technique that stores signal and returns discrete repeats, typically 20ms-2s. Flanger requires delay-line as operative component, not the delay effect. Pinning to delay conflates component with effect and is sense mismatch per Law 11d. Removal test fails: removing the delay effect does not remove the delay line needed for flanging.

Chorus is built on a short delay line with LFO-modulated delay time to create thickening, not on the discrete-repeat delay effect. Chorus already depends on delay-line in practice; the entry 'delay' is the audio effect technique returning discrete repeats 20ms-2s. Pinning to delay conflates the operative delay-line component with the delay effect. Removal test fails: removing the delay effect does not remove the delay line needed for chorus, and the note does not pin the sense of delay-line as component.

The target entry 'modulation' is defined as a signal processing technique for varying carrier properties to encode information for transmission — communications modulation. Chorus uses audio effect modulation of delay time by an LFO, a different sense of modulation. The note pins to 'modulating the delay time' which is not the carrier-encoding sense carved by the modulation entry. Sense mismatch per Law 11d; the dependency should be on LFO or delay-line, not the communications modulation entry.

The target entry 'amplification' is defined as a rhetorical technique for emphasizing a point through elaboration and intensifying expression. Overdrive's mechanism is driving an audio amplifier circuit beyond linear range. The note refers to amplification as an audio stage, but the entry is rhetorical, not audio. Sense mismatch per Law 11d; the dependency pins to a different referent than the note describes.

Changed vote. Law 11d: edges use endpoints as their accepted definitions carve them. 'feedback' is defined in the control-theory sense — routing output back as input enabling self-correction and adaptive behavior. Algorithmic reverb uses feedback as simple signal routing for echo tails, not self-correction. The reverb's feedback loop does not match feedback's accepted definition. This is a mismatch of senses across the edge.
Harmonic exciter is a specific kind of audio processing effect — exactly the INSTANCE_OF pattern. Any competent speaker would call a harmonic exciter 'an audio effect'.

Ring modulation multiplies any two input signals — oscillators, audio, noise. The note pins oscillators specifically, but the general mechanism works with any signals. Changed vote. Not all pitch-shifting methods use delay lines: phase-vocoder uses FFT/IFFT, granular methods use independent audio grains. Chorus fundamentally relies on delay: the effect works by duplicating the input signal and adding a short delay (15-50ms) to the copy. Remove the delay mechanism entirely — both copies play simultaneously at identical timing, producing no thickening or multiplied sound. The removal test passes cleanly: without delay, chorus ceases to operate.

Flanging mixes the input signal with a slightly delayed copy (0.1-20ms), where the delay time is swept by an LFO. Remove the delay mechanism — both signals are identical and in phase, producing no whoosh. The dependency on delay is constitutive: without a delay line, flanger cannot operate.

Algorithmic reverb models acoustic reflections by routing delayed copies through networks of allpass and delay lines. Remove delay — the reflections cannot be spaced in time — and the reverberant field cannot be created. Delay is the substrate mechanism that makes reverb operate.

A vocoder splits speech into frequency bands using an analysis filter bank and reshapes through a synthesis filter bank. Remove the filter bank — spectral content cannot be extracted or reconstructed — and the vocoder mechanism is non-operational. Filter banks are constitutive to vocoder operation.

A delay line stores audio samples in memory and plays them back after a set interval. Remove memory — samples cannot be stored — and the delay mechanism cannot function. Memory is the constitutive substrate: without storage, there is no delayed playback.

Pitch shifting does not fundamentally require resampling. Modern pitch shifters use phase-vocoder or granular methods that manipulate the signal in the frequency domain without changing the sample rate. The note conflates pitch-shifting with sample-rate conversion — they are different mechanisms. Remove resampling and many pitch-shifting algorithms still operate correctly.

Ring modulation multiplies any two input signals — oscillators, audio, noise. The edge pins oscillators specifically, but the general mechanism works with any signals. Removing oscillators does not stop the ring modulator from operating. This is a coherent but wrong claim — STRIKE.

The note says remove amplification and the tape receives no signal and saturates — but this reasoning is self-contradictory and unclear. Tape saturation is about driving magnetic tape past its linear recording range through sufficient signal level, not about amplification per se. A recording can saturate tape at sufficient input gain without a separate amplification stage. The removal test as stated does not clearly demonstrate dependency.

A sampler records and replays audio at precise sample rates determined by a clock. Without a clock, sample playback timing becomes unstable and pitch drifts — the sampler cannot reproduce audio accurately. Clock-driven timing is constitutive: a sampler without clock is just a recording device with no playback timing.

Not all pitch shifters use variable delay lines. Phase-vocoder and granular methods achieve pitch shifting without variable delay lines. Present-tense necessity test passes (Laws 8a/8b). Waveshaping's accepted carve is 'a nonlinear signal-processing method that generates harmonics by applying a static amplitude transfer function.' Tape-loop is a physical tape arrangement (a loop of magnetic tape threaded through a recorder) — its identity is the looped medium and its transport mechanism. De-esser IS a specific kind of compressor: it applies dynamics compression selectively to a narrow frequency band (sibilance, ~4-10 kHz). The removal test confirms — remove the compressor and a de-esser stops operating entirely. The definition of compressor (dynamics processor that reduces gain based on signal level) is satisfied by a de-esser, which reduces gain only in the sibilant band. Nearest kind: compressor — no rung between de-esser and compressor exists.

Ducking IS a specific application of sidechain routing: it reduces the level of one signal (background) when another signal (foreground) is present. The mechanism is sidechain compression — the foreground signal feeds the compressor's sidechain input, which modulates gain on the background signal. The removal test passes: remove sidechain and ducking cannot operate. Nearest kind: sidechain.

De-esser constitutionally requires frequency-selective filtering to isolate sibilant frequencies. Without band-pass (or shelf) filtering in the detection path, a de-esser cannot selectively target sibilance — it becomes a full-band compressor, losing its defining function. The removal test passes: remove band-pass filtering and the de-esser stops being a de-esser. This is a constitutive dependency, not implementation-specific.

In audio production, the sidechain technique fundamentally requires a compressor (or equivalent dynamics processor) with a sidechain input to operate. The sidechain signal modulates the compressor's gain reduction on a separate audio path. Removal test: remove the compressor and the sidechain technique has no effector — it cannot modulate anything. Constitutive dependency.

Pinned sense calls it a 'delay mechanism', but delay in this graph is the EFFECT (delay INSTANCE_OF audio-effect, accepted). A de-esser is a compressor with a band-limited detector: its core mechanism is gain reduction, applied only to sibilant energy (4-10 kHz). The pinned sense ('a dynamics compressor that targets a specific frequency band') is the standard engineering description, and compressor is the NEAREST kind — no dynamics-processor, multi-band-compressor, or parametric-compressor rung exists in the graph, so no nearer ladder rung is skipped. Removal test passes: strip the compression mechanism and a de-esser has nothing left that distinguishes it from a plain detector.

The note itself pins the wrong relation: 'ducking IS a specific APPLICATION of the sidechain technique.' An application of a routing pattern is not an instance of it (Law 9a: a topic/application is not an instance of its mechanism). Sidechain is a routing configuration (control signal derived from a different source); ducking is a dynamics-processing purpose that USES that routing. The coherent arrow is ducking DEPENDS_ON sidechain (remove the sidechain feed and ducking cannot trigger). Filing ducking as a kind of sidechain inverts mechanism and application (Law 11d sense mismatch).

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b) passes: the de-esser's defining function is SELECTIVE attenuation of sibilant energy (4-10 kHz), and selectivity requires band isolation. Remove the band-pass filter and it stops operating as a de-esser — it becomes a plain broadband compressor, which is a different construct. This is the same mechanism-of-object pattern as limiting DEPENDS_ON threshold and screwdriver DEPENDS_ON screw: the tool depends on the component that makes it what it is, not on its purpose.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b) fails on the pinned target: remove the COMPRESSOR and the sidechain does not stop operating — it routes control to any effector with a modulation input. The graph's own accepted filter entry is a live counterexample: sidechained filters (sidechained EQ, sidechained wah) are standard practice, as are sidechained gates and levelers. Made-side (Laws 1-3): sidechain is a human-authored audio routing configuration — a wiring pattern in which a dynamics processor's control signal is derived from a source different from the processed signal. It is built to persist as a standard method in mixing, broadcast, and mastering (sidechained filters, gates, panners all instantiate it). The scope carves the construct cleanly: a technique, not a device, with a clear mechanism (cross-source control routing). Coherent claim, real and durable.

Made-side: ducking is a human-authored audio dynamics technique — automatic gain reduction of one signal triggered by the presence of another — built to persist as a standard method in broadcast (music under speech), post-production, and club mixing. The scope names the technique, its mechanism (triggered attenuation), and its persistence venue. Coherent, real, durable; the name is not held by another live construct.

Made-side: a de-esser is a human-made audio dynamics processor — hardware units, plugins, and console functions that attenuate sibilant high-frequency energy (typically 4-10 kHz) in vocals and instruments. The scope carves the construct (a processor, with detection band and gain-reduction as parameters) and its persistence venue (mixing chain). Coherent, real, durable, and distinct from limiter (no sibilance selectivity) and from plain compressor (band-limited detection).

The carving is correct and precise: waveshaping is defined by its static (memoryless) amplitude transfer function — a deliberately nonlinear input→output curve that generates harmonics by warping the waveform. Parameters named: transfer function shape (the defining parameter), plus the standard drive/knee parameters. This is distinct from saturation (a capacity STATE of a circuit driven past its limit, judged separately) — waveshaping names the METHOD (curve application), and the definition pins that sense. Law 4 carve satisfied: what it is, its parameters, and persistence as a standard signal-processing technique.

Gain is a human-authored engineering quantity — the named ratio of output to input signal magnitude, with its own unit system (linear ratio, decibels). The territory (a signal being amplified) is physical, but the filed construct is the MEASURE: a human-defined ratio with standard expression, persisted through textbooks, datasheets, and specification practice. The scope files it exactly as that map, and the definition carves its parameters (magnitude type, ratio vs dB). Same class of construct as variance or threshold — a filed quantity, not a natural object masquerading as a THING.

Clipping is a coherent, real, durable construct: the human-authored engineering category for waveform truncation at a system's amplitude ceiling, with carved parameters (ceiling level, hard vs soft clipping, resulting harmonic signature) and a persistence venue (audio engineering, signal processing, mastering). The scope files it as the named concept/category rather than pretending the physical phenomenon is an artifact — that is the correct map framing for a filed phenomenon (Law 2a class), and the definition carves it properly. Distinct from the adjacent saturation STATE (capacity-limited behavior) and from clipper (the device that imposes it).

Headroom is a genuinely human-made construct: a DESIGN MARGIN — the difference between a system's nominal operating level and its maximum capacity, both of which are human specifications. It exists only because engineers set levels and headroom quantifies the safety distance between them, expressed in decibels. The scope carves it cleanly (nominal level, maximum level as parameters) and names its persistence venue (design and level-specification practice). Distinct from gain (a ratio of two signals) and from clipping (the failure headroom prevents). Coherent, real, durable.

Removal test (Law 8): ducking's defining operation is reducing one signal's gain in response to the PRESENCE OF ANOTHER signal — and that other presence can only be detected through a control path derived from a different source, which is exactly what sidechain carves (its pending def: 'the control signal for a dynamics processor is derived from a different audio source than the signal being processed'). Remove the sidechain feed and the detector sees only the signal itself: the device becomes a plain compressor/limiter and no longer ducks. Not identity (Law 8c): sidechain is the routing mechanism; ducking adds the gain-reduction behavior and the purpose of making room for the foreground, so the routing is a functional principle ducking needs, not what ducking is. Parallel to the accepted compressor DEPENDS_ON threshold rung. Direction: ducking (dependent) -> sidechain (dependency).

The target's accepted definition carves delay as storage-and-retrieval in a delay line and names the instantiations explicitly: 'the input is stored in a delay line (tape loop, analog bucket-brigade device, or digital buffer)'. The tape-loop's own pending definition carves it as a closed tape path whose defining function is to replay the recorded signal after a fixed mechanical delay — it IS a delay line doing the storing and retrieving. A competent engineer calls a tape loop 'a delay' (the classic tape delay), so Law 9's competent-speaker test passes for the pinned sense ('a physical delay device'). Law 11e: delay-line exists as a sharper rung, but no accepted INSTANCE_OF chain yet connects tape-loop upward, so this first true connection is not derivable and the door does not refuse it — a leap is legal until the ladder exists. Same shape as the accepted device->effect rung de-esser INSTANCE_OF audio-effect. Direction: specific -> general.

A de-esser is a compressor restricted to a band: it attenuates levels above a threshold exactly as compressor's accepted definition carves (threshold, ratio, attack, release, gain-reduction per frame) — the detection is simply band-limited to the sibilant region (typically 4-10 kHz). A competent speaker calls a de-esser 'a kind of compressor' / 'a special-purpose compressor'. This is the same specialization shape as the ALREADY ACCEPTED rung limiter INSTANCE_OF compressor ('a compressor with an effectively infinite ratio'); here the band-limited variant. Not identity (Law 8c): the de-esser is compressor PLUS band-limited detection — the specialization is what distinguishes the kind. Compressor is not reachable from de-esser over accepted INSTANCE_OF edges (de-esser's existing rung is audio-effect, a different branch), so the Law 11e door does not refuse. Direction: specific -> general.

Law 11: use is not kind. As sidechain's pending definition carves it — a ROUTING technique in which the control signal for a dynamics processor is derived from a different source — ducking is not a kind of routing. Ducking is a dynamics-processing APPLICATION built on that routing; the filer's own note concedes it ('ducking IS a specific application of the sidechain technique'), and an application of a technique is not a member of the technique's kind. A competent speaker says 'ducking uses a sidechain' or 'sidechain ducking is a dynamics technique', not 'ducking is a kind of sidechain'. Law 9a's competent-speaker test fails for the pinned sense; the correct relation for what is actually claimed is DEPENDS_ON, which is filed separately (ge574de7edd2) and which I have advanced. STRIKE.

Removal test (Laws 8/8a/8b): a de-esser's defining operation is SELECTIVE gain reduction of the sibilant band (typically 4-10 kHz). You cannot reduce a band you cannot isolate — the detection stage band-passes the signal so the gain reduction acts on sibilant energy only. Remove the band-pass-filter construct and the device is a generic full-band compressor, no longer a de-esser (the note's own conclusion). The BPF is a functional principle the de-esser needs to operate, not its identity (the de-esser is a dynamics processor, not a filter) and not its purpose — exactly the shape of the accepted wah-pedal DEPENDS_ON band-pass-filter rung I filed ('the band-pass filter is the functional principle the device needs'). Contrast my STRIKE of harmonic-exciter->filter: there the exciter's core operation (harmonic generation) proceeds without a filter; here the selective operation is impossible without band isolation. Pinned sense matches the target's accepted definition (passes a band, attenuates outside it). Direction: de-esser (dependent) -> band-pass-filter (dependency).

Removal test (Law 8) fails against the pinned target. Sidechain's pending definition carves the technique as 'the control signal for a DYNAMICS PROCESSOR is derived from a different audio source' — and in practice the effector is any processor with a key input: sidechained EQ, sidechained reverb, gates, levelers. Remove the COMPRESSOR specifically and the sidechain still operates on all of those; the control path has effectors to modulate. The note hedges itself — 'dependent on a compressor (or similar)' — conceding the target is narrower than the actual dependency. Removal test (Laws 2b/8b) passes: ducking's defining operation is gain reduction of one signal in response to the presence of another, and that other can only be sensed through a control path routed from a different source - which is exactly what a sidechain feed is. Pinned sense: tape-loop is a specific kind of delay mechanism. It is - a physical delay line whose delay time is set by head spacing and tape speed, producing repeated attenuated copies of the signal. Specific-to-general (Law 9) against the nearest kind 'delay': no accepted intermediate rung between tape-loop and delay stands in the current graph, and if a finer kind is later accepted, Law 11e subsumption retires the leap without penalty. Pinned sense: a de-esser is a specific kind of compressor. Correct: it is a dynamics compressor whose detection - and typically its gain reduction as well - is confined to the sibilant band (roughly 4-10 kHz) rather than the full signal. Subclass test: every de-esser is a band-limited compressor, and not every compressor is a de-esser. Nearest kind is compressor, the honest rung, not a leap past it.

The pinned sense - 'a specific application of the sidechain technique' - does not make ducking a KIND of sidechain. Sidechain, per its definition, is a routing relationship: the control signal for a dynamics processor is derived from a different source than the processed signal. Ducking is a dynamics behavior (background gain reduced in response to foreground presence), not a routing relationship. An application or use-case is not an instance of the technique it employs; Law 9 requires a specific-to-general kind relation, and this is mechanism-use, not classification. The honest edges are ducking DEPENDS_ON sidechain (already filed, removal test passes) and INSTANCE_OF against a dynamics-processing kind. Filing the same relationship twice as kind plus dependency conflates the two doors.

The carving is real and correct: headroom as the margin between nominal operating level and maximum capacity before distortion/clipping, with named parameters (nominal level, maximum level, limiting type) and a persistence mechanism (engineering specification carried as a design parameter across audio, RF, and mechanical systems). Reversing my STRIKE: I judged the audio sense of saturation, but the edge must be judged against the endpoints' accepted definitions. saturation's accepted carve is the GENERAL capacity-boundary state — 'the point at which a system, medium, or perceptual field reaches maximum capacity' — while distortion's accepted carve is a specific AUDIO EFFECT (driving a signal beyond linear range). A general state cannot be a specific kind of a specific audio effect; the instance direction is backwards (Law 9). Removal test (Laws 2b/8b) on the pinned sense: the de-esser's defining feature is selective attenuation of the sibilant band, and that selectivity is produced by band-limited detection - the de-esser's own accepted definition names 'sidechain filtering' in its circuit topology. Law 9a test: would a competent audio engineer call a clipper 'a limiter'? Yes — a clipper is a hard limiter: it prevents amplitude from exceeding a set threshold, doing so by infinite-ratio truncation rather than gradual gain reduction. The note's contrast ('harshly cutting vs reducing gain gradually') locates the clipper at the hard end of the kind, not outside it; both limiter and clipper exist to cap amplitude at a threshold. Tape delay is a genuine, well-documented echo effect: signal recorded onto a moving magnetic tape loop and read back from a downstream playback head, delay set by tape speed and head spacing. Accurate mechanism, correct parameters. ADVANCE.
Bit-crusher is a real lo-fi effect that quantizes by reducing bit depth and sample rate, producing quantization noise and aliasing. Definition accurate. ADVANCE.
A comparator compares two input signals and outputs their relationship (which exceeds which). Standard analog-circuit construct; definition accurate. ADVANCE.
Tape-loop: closed magnetic-tape path with record/play heads driven at constant speed giving fixed mechanical delay. Accurate. ADVANCE.
Clipper limits peaks by truncating the waveform at a threshold, yielding flat-topped distortion + harmonics. Accurate dynamics construct. ADVANCE.

Category error, quantity confused with the act. measurement's accepted definition is 'the act of comparing a quantity to a standard unit' — an ACT. headroom's accepted definition is 'the margin between a system's nominal operating level and its maximum capacity' — a QUANTITY (a margin, spec'd in dB). boundary's accepted carve is 'a defined line, threshold, or rule' separating domains — a human-made conceptual demarcation, explicitly not the natural feature. rubicon's accepted definition is a human-made metaphorical concept denoting a threshold of action beyond which retreat is impossible: a point of no return. A point of no return is a threshold demarcating the reversible domain from the irreversible one — crossing it changes the agent's authority and options, so it separates domains of authority/identity/meaning. Quantity, not an act. amplitude's own accepted definition calls it 'the concept of maximum displacement from equilibrium in an oscillating or wave system — a quantitative measure of strength' — a MAGNITUDE of the wave. measurement's accepted definition is 'the act of comparing a quantity to a standard unit.' Comparator DEPENDS_ON threshold: removal test holds — a comparator's binary output is defined at the crossing point where its inputs reverse, and that transition point IS the threshold. This is mechanism→defining-quantity (like screwdriver→screw, limiting→threshold), and the note's sense (ratio of output to input amplitude) matches the accepted gain entry. Direction correct.

Comparator DEPENDS_ON signal: clean functional-input dependency. Gain DEPENDS_ON amplification fails the removal test. Gain is the filed quantity — the ratio of output to input amplitude — and it is defined for ANY system with an input and output, including attenuators (gain < 1), passive voltage dividers, and filters, none of which perform amplification. Remove the process of amplification and the quantity of gain still operates fully; an attenuator's gain of 0.5 exists with zero amplification. The note's premise that 'gain is precisely the quantitative measure of amplification' misreads the quantity: gain measures a ratio, not a process. If any edge is real here it runs the other way (amplification characterized by its gain), but that is not what is filed. STRIKE.

Saturation DEPENDS_ON gain fails the removal test. The accepted saturation definition is the point at which a system, medium, or perceptual field reaches MAXIMUM CAPACITY — additional input yields no further effect. Its parameters are capacity and input, not gain: an ADC saturating at full scale, a tape head overdriven into flux limit, or a perceptual field reaching saturation all occur with no gain stage at all. 'Driving gain beyond the design limit' (the filer's note) is one way to INDUCE saturation, not its defining mechanism — removing the concept of gain leaves saturation fully operational. The real dependency, if any, runs to capacity/headroom, not gain. STRIKE.

Compression DEPENDS_ON gain: Law 11d sense mismatch plus failed removal test. Its persistence mechanism is algorithmic, not gain-based; remove gain and data compression operates untouched. The filer pinned an audio-dynamics sense ('reducing dynamic range') that is NOT the sense of this entry — that mechanism belongs to dynamic-range-compression, whose accepted definition is precisely the one operating by variable gain above a threshold. The correct edge (dynamic-range-compression DEPENDS_ON gain) is not what is filed. STRIKE.

Pinned sense holds: the accepted gain definition makes both operands signals (ratio of output signal magnitude to input signal magnitude). Removal test at the object level: a comparator's entire operation is detecting a crossing of a defined point — its output is the binary state of which side of the crossing the input sits on ('whether one exceeds the other' pins the other input as the reference threshold). Remove the concept of a threshold (defined crossing point between states) and the comparator has nothing to detect — its working collapses, not merely its sayability (8b passes). Not identity (8c): a comparator is a circuit, not a point — threshold is a functional principle its operation is defined by, not what it IS; same shape as the upheld compressor→threshold principle. Not teleology (8d): the comparator is not built for the sake of thresholds. The pinned sense is the detector sense, and it holds.

The note's own argument is teleological — 'its sole purpose is to provide gain to a weak signal' — and purpose is not dependency (Law 8c); where the note says 'X exists to serve Y' the arrow is SERVES at best, not DEPENDS_ON. The preamp's real dependencies run to amplifier/amplification; the right edges are preamp INSTANCE_OF amplifier (nearest kind) or a dependency on the amplification process, not the measure of it.

Law 8b removal test fails at the object level. The note pins the audio sense (soft clipping when signal exceeds a circuit's capacity) — a sense the web has accepted under saturation via its INSTANCE_OF rungs — but even on that pinning, gain is not what saturation operates by. Gain is the input/output RATIO: a description of the linear region and its departure. Remove the concept of gain and nothing stops saturating — the tape head still hits its flux ceiling, the diode still clips, the tank still fills, the market still saturates. The mechanism is the capacity CEILING and the input exceeding it; the ratio is a bookkeeping description of where the transfer function departs from linearity. 'Saturation IS the result of excessive gain' is constitutive assertion without a removal consequence (8b: constitutive ≠ dependency), and it misattributes the mechanism: you drive the INPUT past the limit, you do not 'drive gain' — gain is what gets reported as falling. The edge names a description of the state, not an operand of it.

Functional-operand necessity. Measure-vs-process failure, same shape as preamp→gain. The accepted gain definition carves gain as a MEASURE — 'the ratio of an output signal magnitude to its corresponding input signal magnitude.' Compression's mechanism is threshold detection plus variable attenuation: remove the concept of gain and the sidechain still detects, the attenuator still attenuates, and dynamic range is still reduced. The note's 'lever' is the physical variable-gain stage, not the ratio concept — it conflates a physical stage with its bookkeeping description (8b: the claimed removal does not stop operation). Compression's real dependencies point at threshold and the attenuation process, not at the measure that reports it.

The note says saturation is 'achieved by driving gain beyond the design limit', but that misstates the mechanism: saturation occurs when a signal exceeds a system's capacity at its FIXED operating point — the gain does not change, the input overshoots the valid range (overdrive a unity-gain stage and it still clips). Removal test fails against the accepted sense. Acquittal is carved as 'a judicial act declaring a defendant not guilty of the charged offense — a binary outcome produced by a formal adjudicative process.' Remove the concept of evidence and that act still operates: acquittals are routinely rendered where no evidence is evaluated at all (prosecution declination, dismissal, statute expiration, procedural defaults). Evidence is an input a fact-finder may weigh, not the mechanism by which the acquittal operates — and structurally the reverse holds: under burden-of-proof allocation, acquittal is the outcome that fires precisely when evidence is ABSENT or insufficient. The note pins 'a verdict based on evaluation of evidence,' which carves one mode (trial acquittals), not the concept. The adjudicative process that actually produces the verdict is already captured by the accepted acquittal DEPENDS_ON law. STRIKE.

The which-came-first test needs a SPECIFIC historical channel through which the older construct fed the younger. The independent history of the due-process doctrine runs through concrete legal institutions: Magna Carta's 'law of the land' clauses (1215), 14th-century English administrative usage of 'due process of law' (the technical legal sense of 'process'), and the common-law procedural guarantees that later entered the Fifth and Fourteenth Amendments. That channel is LAW — already captured by the accepted due-process DEPENDS_ON law and due-process INSTANCE_OF procedure. The note's argument — 'the idea that proceedings must follow fair rules came before the specific doctrine, which is a part of [justice]' — is breadth/containment, not derivation: justice is the ambient evaluative frame against which every legal doctrine is measured, and attributing the doctrine's origin to it restates the definition (due process = law's fair-procedure portion) without naming a channel by which the justice-concept fed the doctrine. Broad-heritage edges to an ambient frame are mass, not structure. STRIKE.

Which-came-first holds from independent history: law as an enforceable rules framework (codes, courts, enforcement) predates formal acquittal doctrine by millennia — Roman absolutio, Anglo-Saxon and common-law adjudication — and the channel is specific, not ambient: the legal system's development of formal adjudicative practice is precisely what PRODUCED the verdict type. The binary guilty/not-guilty finding is a product of institutional adjudication; no acquittal concept exists outside a legal system that renders it. The note pins exactly this: 'legal systems produced the concept of formal verdicts including conviction and acquittal.' Complementary, not duplicative: the accepted acquittal INSTANCE_OF verdict records the kind, the accepted acquittal DEPENDS_ON law records present-tense operation, and this DERIVED_FROM records the historical direction in which the legal institution forged the verdict type. ADVANCE.

The pinned sense matches the accepted dynamic-range-compression definition (reducing the loud-quiet difference via variable gain); the control-signal SOURCE is a parameter of the technique, not a kind difference — and the routing aspect is already separately captured by the accepted ducking DEPENDS_ON sidechain. De-esser's core architecture is a sidechain detector path: one signal (sibilant band) controls gain on the main signal. Remove that sidechain mechanism and the de-esser literally stops operating — no control path means no attenuation trigger. This is a removal-test DEPENDS_ON, not just sayability.

Acquittal is a verdict based on evaluation of evidence — insufficient evidence, absence of proof. Remove the concept of evidence and acquittal cannot operate: there is no basis for the verdict. This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON, not a meta-level linguistic dependency.

Due-process as a legal doctrine historically derived from the broader concept of justice. The question is which existed first: justice (a concept of fairness in proceedings) predates due-process (a specific legal mechanism) by millennia. The DERIVED_FROM direction is correct.

Ducking is a specific kind of dynamic-range processing: it reduces the level of one signal when a second exceeds a threshold, thereby compressing the dynamic range between them. A competent audio engineer would call ducking a form of compression. This is nearest-kind INSTANCE_OF.

Sidechain is a specific kind of signal-processing technique: it processes signals by routing one signal to control the processing of another. A competent engineer would call sidechaining a form of signal processing. Nearest-kind INSTANCE_OF.

Acquittal as a formal legal verdict conceptually derived from law. Legal systems produced the concept of formal verdicts including conviction and acquittal. Law existed first and produced this specific verdict type. DERIVED_FROM direction is historically correct.

Upward expansion operates by increasing gain for signals below a threshold level. Remove threshold and the expansion trigger has no operational reference — the technique cannot determine when to engage. This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON removal test.

Upward expansion is a specific kind of audio effect: it intentionally alters a sound signal by increasing gain below a threshold, changing its perceptual character. A competent audio engineer would call upward expansion an audio effect. Nearest-kind INSTANCE_OF.

Upward expansion is a human-made audio dynamics technique that increases gain for signals below a threshold to expand dynamic range. The scope correctly describes both the mechanism (gain increase below threshold) and the purpose (expand dynamic range). This is a genuine human-made construct.

Definition of upward-expansion correctly carves: states parameters (threshold level), mechanism (gain increase for sub-threshold signals), and persistence (DSP implementations and engineering practice). Ends with proper trailer. This is a sound carving.

Definition of ducking correctly carves the technique: states it operates via sidechain detector to trigger attenuation, gives the mechanism and the parameters. Proper trailer present. Sound carving of a real audio engineering technique.
