The note pins 'a kind of timing error' in the engineering-fault sense. A drift-rate concept parameterized in ppm is not a geometric mark encoding a confidence interval in a visualization. The word 'error' is held by a different construct here, and the pinned sense does not ride on that construct. (If the filer wanted a fault/failure kind, that is a different target entry, and audio-clock-drift is a mapped phenomenon, not a fault instance.)

Pinned sense stands against the target's accepted carve (Law 11d). stereo's definition: a method of sound reproduction that uses two or more independent audio channels to create spatial perception — it encodes separate signals for distinct channels. audio-processing's accepted definition is 'a human-made map of operations performed on audio signals to modify, analyze, or combine them,' and its processing-type parameter EXPLICITLY includes 'spatialization.' Stereo channel encoding is precisely that operation: a specific technique for spatializing sound. A competent speaker calls stereo a form of audio processing (stereo processing, width, M/S). Law 9a is not triggered: stereo is not a property or mere topic of the map, it is a technique within it. Nearest-kind check (Law 11e): no spatialization, multi-channel, or reproduction entry exists on the board, so audio-processing is the nearest accepted kind — no ladder leap.

Direct subkind of the target's accepted carve. audio-processing's definition explicitly enumerates 'effects (reverb, delay, modulation, distortion)' as one of its processing types — the target's own definition names this class. audio-effect's accepted definition: 'a signal processing technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal to change its perceptual character' — a specific operation within the map of operations performed on audio signals. The removal test (Law 8b) fails as pinned. measurement is accepted as 'the act of comparing a quantity to a standard unit — parameters: the quantity, the unit, the standard of comparison; persists through calibration chains and metrological artifacts.' The comparator's operating material is its two input signals and its reference input; it compares one signal against the other or against a setpoint, with hysteresis controlling chatter. It uses no standard unit at all: an op-amp comparator in a relay or threshold circuit operates in a world with no metrology, no units, no calibration chains. Remove the practice of measurement now and the comparator still compares and still drives its output. The note's 'a device that measures by comparing two quantities' conflates comparing two signals with each other against comparing a quantity to a standard unit — a constitutive/identity claim, and identity is not dependency (Law 8c). A competent speaker would call stereo a form of sound reproduction or spatial audio, not a routing technique. audio-routing is not the right category. STRIKE.

Nearest-kind (Law 11e) fails: audio-routing is not the nearest kind for a reproduction technique. STRIKE.

The accepted definition carves dithering as a 'signal processing technique' whose application point is inside the processing chain, and the technique has no life outside digital audio quantization — unlike the general concepts (compression, modulation, feedback) I have struck against audio disciplines because they exist independently of the discipline. Dithering is a native practice of the discipline, in the same class as delay and gain-staging serving audio engineering, or kalman/butterworth serving signal processing: the discipline is the master whose toolkit it constitutes. The servant points at its home discipline. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense: acoustic measurement is built for the sake of audio processing, to inform processing decisions. The note's pinned sense does not survive contact with the source's accepted definition, which carves a general measurement practice quantifying 'acoustic phenomena ... sound pressure level, frequency response, reverberation time, and related parameters.' Reverberation time serves room design; sound pressure level serves noise regulation and hearing science; frequency response serves product and loudspeaker design. The beneficiary is the acoustic domain broadly — rooms, products, environments, audiology — not the map of audio-processing operations. A general practice whose true masters are many and wider than the named target files no single SERVES arrow to one of them; that is the general-concept-not-the-beneficiary pattern I have applied before (compression/modulation/feedback against audio engineering). Audio processing consumes measurement results, but that is use, not the practice's sake. STRIKE.

Note pins the DEFINED sense: the accepted audio-dithering definition carves a technique that operates INSIDE the digital audio processing chain — applied before quantization/bit-depth reduction, with 'application point in the processing chain' as an explicit parameter. Its raison d'etre is to make those processing operations run without tonal distortion; the error-decorrelation exists only where quantization is present. Law 8d asks for-whose-sake: the servant was built for cleaner audio processing (recording, mastering). The beneficiary is broader than the already-accepted SERVES-to-quantization, and Law 11c permits broad senses. Same shape as the delay/gain-staging SERVES I advanced. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense fails Law 8d. The accepted definition carves acoustic-measurement as a domain-neutral metrology practice: it 'quantifies acoustic phenomena using calibrated instruments and standardized procedures' and persists through 'standardized protocols, calibrated equipment, and documented procedures' — general standards, not audio-processing ones. A servant built for general quantification of sound does not point at audio processing as its master. STRIKE.

Stereo is a reproduction technique for spatial perception using two or more independent channels. Audio-routing is the practice/system of directing audio signals from sources to destinations via paths, buses, switches. The stereo definition carves encoding/transmission/playback for spatial soundstage, not signal path selection. Routing concerns topology of directing signals; stereo concerns channel encoding for binaural perception. The note claims stereo is a specific configuration of channel mapping, but the accepted stereo definition does not carve routing topology as its parameters — it carves spatial perception via interaural cues. This is a sense mismatch under Law 11d, and stereo is already SERVES audio-engineering and DEPENDS_ON signals. The nearest kind for a reproduction format is audio-processing, not routing. The edge misclassifies a reproduction format as a routing class.

Definition carves a human-made pattern of engagement with bounded frame of low-stakes exploration and feedback, seeking enjoyment rather than instrumental outcome. Parameters listed: framing, participant roles, feedback loop speed and clarity, safety framing, repetition tolerance. Persistence via cultural transmission through demonstration, codified rule sets, media recordings, institutionalized play spaces. Trailer present. This carves the construct and respects Law 4/6. Version 2 improves specificity over prior.

Audio clock drift is a hardware timing phenomenon — the divergence of oscillator clocks relative to a reference. It operates at the physical layer regardless of whether audio samples exist. Samples are a measurement modality, not the mechanism of drift itself. Removing audio samples doesn't stop clock drift from occurring; it merely changes how (or whether) it's measured. DEPENDS_ON requires remove-Y-now-does-X-stop-OPERATING; the drift operates without samples.

Stereo is a spatial reproduction technique using two channels (left/right) for sound staging — it is a configuration of channel layout for reproduction, not a channel-routing technique. Audio-routing is the class of channel mapping and signal-path arrangements. Stereo does not map or route signals; it defines a spatial arrangement for playback. The nearest accepted kind for stereo is audio-processing, not audio-routing. Would a competent speaker call stereo 'a audio-routing'? No.

Playful interaction is well-carved: defines it as a human-made pattern of engagement bounded by voluntary participation, low-stakes exploration, and non-instrumental enjoyment. Parameters include the frame, feedback loop, and enjoyment-seeking motive. Persistence mechanism is social practice and cultural transmission. This is a genuine map of a natural phenomenon (play) rather than a territory-definition. Carves cleanly.

The note conflates measurement with operation. Audio clock drift is a clock's frequency deviation from a reference — it operates independently of any particular measurement modality. Remove audio samples and the drift still operates (it can be measured against a reference clock, an oscillator, or any timebase). Law 8b: 'losing the ability to name X is meta-level; only collapse of X's own working files a dependency.' Measuring audio samples is how we detect drift, not what makes drift operate. STRIKE.

On reconsider: peers raise a valid point. Stereo is a channel FORMAT and spatial reproduction technique, not a routing technique. Audio-routing refers to signal path management (crossbars, bus sends, patching). A competent speaker would call stereo 'a reproduction technique' or 'a channel configuration,' not 'a form of audio routing.' The filer's note conflates 'channel mapping' with 'audio routing' — stereo maps L/R to speakers by standard, not by routing infrastructure. STRIKE.

Definition body is the single word 'test' — not a definition. No parameters, no persistence mechanism, no display trailer. This is a placeholder/boilerplate, not a claim. Law 4 requires a definition to 'state what the thing is, the parameters that define it, and the mechanism by which it persists.' This carves nothing.

Definition carves a concept: playful interaction as a bounded frame of low-stakes engagement with feedback, distinct from instrumental outcomes. Has parameters and structure. Even though the body text is truncated in the queue display, the definition appears to be a genuine attempt at carving the concept. The core claim — that it's a pattern of voluntary, bounded, non-instrumental engagement — is coherent and distinct.

Sense mismatch (Law 11d). Accepted stereo pins 'a method of sound reproduction' — encoding and rendering spatial perception via two or more independent channels; its parameters are channel count and binaural rendering cues. Accepted audio-routing pins 'directing audio signals from sources to destinations through paths, buses, and switches' — topology, signals, control. The note's pinned sense ('a specific configuration of two channels') is a reproduction format, not a routing configuration: the same stereo signal can ride matrix, bus, or point-to-point routing; topology is orthogonal to whether the content is stereo. Stereo is not a kind of audio-routing; it is a configuration a routing system can carry.

Removal test fails. Accepted audio-clock-drift pins 'the systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base', parameterized by ppm, direction, accumulation — properties of the clock versus its reference, not of samples. Remove audio-sample now and the clock still deviates and the concept still maps the deviation. The note's own pinned unit ('timing error per sample period') is the clock's own nominal period — sample period is 1 over the nominal rate — expressible in ppm with no sample existing. Samples are the substrate in which drift's CONSEQUENCES (pitch shift, timing error) appear, not an operating input of the drift concept; 'cannot be measured' is an appeal to observability, not operation. Medium/substrate is not DEPENDS_ON.

Pinned sense passes the removal test and is not the generic-cognition trap. Accepted perception pins 'the MAP that organizes, categorizes, and gives meaning to sensory signals through learned patterns, cultural categories, and conceptual schemas', with explicitness spanning automatic pattern-matching to deliberate analysis. Accepted priming's mechanism — latent activation spreading through associative networks — operates on the perceptually encoded prime: semantic priming needs concept activation, perceptual priming needs recognition (categorization), affective priming needs evaluation; all three require the interpretive layer, and subliminal priming sits inside the 'automatic pattern-matching' parameter. Remove perception and the prime is never encoded as an organized stimulus — priming stops operating. Direction is right: remove priming and perception still operates.

The first real carving of a standing entry (rejected v1 was a text about negotiation — the wrong entry entirely). The body carves the construct: a human-made pattern of engagement in a bounded, low-stakes frame, seeking enjoyment rather than instrumental outcome — a made-side practice like a game or rite. It names parameters (framing, participant roles, feedback-loop speed and clarity, safety framing, repetition tolerance), a persistence mechanism (cultural transmission: demonstration, codified rule sets, media recordings, institutionalized play spaces), and closes with the Law 6 trailer. Revised from ADVANCE after re-reading the target's accepted definition. The note pins 'requires perceptual encoding', but the perception entry's accepted definition carves perception as raw input at the sensory boundary and does not carve encoding as an independent stage — the pinned sense ('perceptual encoding') is a disclaimed sense of the target, and Law 11d makes the pinned sense the judged one against the target's accepted definition. Even on the note's own terms the removal test (Law 8b) fails for the general mechanism: priming as an entry is the general mechanism by which prior exposure facilitates later response, and semantic and repetition priming run through associative/conceptual activation that operates without perception as a distinct standing construct. Only perceptual priming — a subset — needs perceptual processing. The note proves the subset and overreaches to the whole. STRIKE.

The note inverts the causal direction and argues from measurability, not operation. audio-clock-drift's accepted definition pins it as 'the systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base,' parameterized in parts-per-million: a property of the clock's rate relative to the reference. audio-sample's accepted definition is 'the smallest measurable unit of amplitude — a single numeric value captured at one instant from one channel': the data unit downstream of the clock. Remove the samples now and the clock still oscillates at the wrong rate and still accumulates deviation against the reference; a clock running at 44.06 kHz instead of 44.10 kHz drifts whether or not any amplitude value is ever captured. 'Cannot be measured' is not 'stops operating' — drift stays measurable by comparing sample counters against the reference timebase — and the 'sample period' the note invokes is the clock's OWN period, which makes the argument circular: the sample period is produced by the clock, not the reverse. The sample is a product of the clock, not an input to the drift.

Reversing my STRIKE on being shown a better argument (Law 26). My strike rested on two premises and both fail against the pinned text. (1) I read perception's 'raw input' disavowal as excluding the encoding layer entirely, but it disavows only sight/sound/touch/taste/smell as biological faculties — parameter (3) of the same definition ('level of explicitness: automatic pattern-matching vs. deliberate analysis') places automatic pattern-matching INSIDE perception, and the definition names its constituents 'learned patterns, cultural categories, and conceptual schemas.' (2) I read 'without conscious awareness of the influence' as excluding conscious perception of the prime; it qualifies the influence, not the prime. Subliminal primes are still pattern-matched — they sit inside the automatic parameter. Run the removal test on the full pinned senses: remove the framework that organizes, categorizes, and pattern-matches sensory signals down to the automatic level, and a prime can never become an organized stimulus; priming's defined mechanism — latent activation spreading through associative networks built from exactly those learned patterns — has no nodes to activate, and the paradigm stops operating. Remove priming and perception still operates, so the direction is the dependent→depended-upon direction. The note is terse but the claim it asserts passes the test on the pinned senses. ADVANCE.

Priming's accepted definition carves a human-made paradigm about prior exposure influencing subsequent response, with parameters semantic, perceptual, and affective priming, persisting via research programs, marketing, and behavioral economics. The note pins the sense that priming requires perceptual encoding to function, but perception in the board is the human-made MAP for interpreting sensory data, not biological sensing. Removing the map does not stop the priming paradigm from operating; the paradigm already has an accepted DEPENDS_ON memory, which is the operational substrate. Perceptual priming is a parameter of priming, not a dependency, and the removal test fails: semantic and affective priming can be studied and applied without invoking the perception framework, and priming as a construct remains sayable and usable even if the perception map were absent. The claim is a generic constitutive appeal — prior stimulus exposure needs encoding — true of every stimulus-based construct and therefore files nothing under Law 2b/8b. STRIKE.
Priming requires prior stimulus to be perceived; without perceptual encoding the prior exposure cannot affect later response. Remove perception, priming stops operating.

Audio jitter (timing variation in digital audio signals) is measured, analyzed, and managed specifically to improve audio processing quality. The edge runs SERVANT→BENEFICIARY: audio-jitter (the phenomenon/its measurement) serves audio-processing (the practice). The note says 'its measurement serves the practice' — this pins the sense correctly. Jitter metrics inform EQ design, clock management, and processing chain decisions. Valid SERVES.

Headphone stand → SERVES → audio-engineering. A headphone stand holds headphones for audio engineers when not in use, preserving equipment integrity (cable management, driver alignment) and keeping workspace organized. The note pins 'preserving them and keeping workspace clear for audio engineers' — this is a genuine servant→master relationship: the stand exists to serve the workflow of audio engineers. Parallel precedent: similar tools (stands, cases, racks) SERVES audio-engineering in accepted edges.

Priming → DEPENDS_ON → perception. Priming is the psychological phenomenon where prior exposure to a stimulus influences response to a subsequent stimulus. The mechanism requires perceptual encoding of the initial stimulus — without perception, there is no stimulus encoding, and thus no priming effect. The removal test passes: remove perception entirely and priming cannot operate. This is not a generic 'language/cognition' appeal — it's a specific causal dependency between the priming mechanism and perceptual processing. 5 judges already agree.

Formant vocoder IS a form of audio processing — it is not a separate thing built for the sake of the broader practice. SERVES requires a servant pointing at a master, not self-identification. A technique does not serve the category it instantiates. STRIKE.

Headphone-stand SERVES audio-engineering fails the beneficiary test. SERVES points to 'for whose sake' — a person or group, not a discipline. Audio engineering is a field of practice, not an entity that operates and benefits from a stand. STRIKE.

Audio jitter is a phenomenon — a timing artifact in digital audio systems. It is not 'built or maintained' for anyone's sake, which is the prerequisite for SERVES. The filer confuses the management of jitter with jitter itself. Phenomena do not serve; they simply occur. STRIKE.

Law 8d for-whose-sake, judged against the source's accepted carve. The note's pinned sense is 'studied and managed to improve audio processing quality' — a generic use appeal, not a beneficiary. Law 8d for-whose-sake, against the source's accepted carve: 'holds a pair of headphones by the headband or earcups when not in use, keeping the headphones off surfaces and preserving their shape.' A stand serves any owner of headphones (office worker, commuter, gamer) equally; the audio-engineering practice neither requires nor receives the stand's operation — a stand on a gamer's desk serves no engineer. Use-by-a-profession is not service-to-a-discipline, and fixture master is the held object, already named on the board. STRIKE.

The note pins the SERVES sense correctly: limiter is a dynamic range processor built and maintained for the sake of audio-processing. The note pins the SERVES sense: expander is an audio dynamic range processor built for the sake of audio-processing. 'For whose sake?' — servant (expander) points to master (audio-processing). This is a proper SERVES edge, not confused with DEPENDS_ON or INSTANCE_OF.

Pinned sense: limiter as an audio peak-control technique (accepted definition v2: 'human-made audio signal processing technique that prevents signal amplitude from exceeding a specified threshold by reducing gain'). The servant points at the audio-processing family whose practice it protects and shapes. The accepted audio-dithering->audio-processing edge confirms the court's standing treatment of audio-born techniques serving this family. Not identity, not dependency: purpose runs servant->master, which is exactly what SERVES carries. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense: expander as an audio dynamic-range technique (accepted definition: 'human-made audio processing technique that increases the dynamic range of a signal by reducing the amplitude of quieter portions relative to louder portions'). Its other accepted edges (INSTANCE_OF dynamic-range-processing, DEPENDS_ON threshold) are different relations and do not compete with SERVES. Purpose is not dependency (Law 8c) — it is exactly what SERVES carries (Law 8d). ADVANCE.

Consistent.

Socks are not built or maintained for the sake of clothing; socks ARE a type of clothing. The SERVES relation means X is built for the sake of Y (Law 8d). Socks are a garment, not a servant of garments. The correct relation would be INSTANCE_OF→clothing. The note claims 'Socks are worn for the sake of clothing' which conflates membership with purpose.

SERVES runs servant→beneficiary: for whose sake is X built or maintained (Law 8d)? Socks are made for the foot's sake — the note's own functional evidence (protection, warmth, hygiene) benefits the foot and the wearer, not the garment. "Fulfilling purposes WITHIN the domain of clothing" is domain membership, not benefit: belonging to a category is not being built for that category's sake. If clothing (the garment ensemble) were removed, socks would still operate — still protect the foot. The note never identifies what the clothing gains from socks' existence; it only locates socks inside the clothing domain. If a relation is warranted at all it is INSTANCE_OF (socks as a kind of garment) filed against the nearest kind, not SERVES. The pinned sense fails the beneficiary test. STRIKE.

DERIVED_FROM asks which came first (Law 7), established from historical reasoning. Soil cultivation (agriculture) is millennia older than the garden hoe as a distinct hand tool: the hoe's design lineage runs through agricultural toolmaking — Neolithic field hoes first, the smaller horticultural form a domestic refinement of that lineage. The note pins the correct sense and its test is honest: agriculture existed first and fed into the tool's design and purpose. This is a claim about the artifact's material history, not the generic 'a concept needs its discipline to be sayable' trap (Laws 2b/8b) — the garden hoe as a made object emerged inside the practice, and the direction tool←practice is the origin direction. ADVANCE.

Law 8d: SERVES points the servant at its master — built for whose sake? Socks are built for the sake of the FOOT: the note's own functional list (protection, warmth) names foot-benefits, and its aesthetic purpose is to the wearer's appearance, not to 'clothing' as a beneficiary. 'Clothing' is the category socks belong to (at most an INSTANCE_OF relation), not a beneficiary that socks are built to serve — a thing is not built for the sake of its own category. The note's 'as part of a garment ensemble' is category membership, not purpose, and it never shows the foot-benefits being delivered to 'clothing' itself. The pinned sense fails the Law 8d beneficiary test. STRIKE.

Law 7: DERIVED_FROM = which-came-first, established from independent historical reasoning. Agricultural practice (cultivating soil, growing crops) is an organized practice dating to the Neolithic and long predates the garden hoe as a distinct tool form. The garden hoe is a specialization of the hoe — a hand tool developed within and for cultivation, its flat-perpendicular-blade design (breaking crust, weeding, hilling) a response to the needs of soil work. Independent history places agriculture first and the garden hoe emerging from that practice; this is a genuine which-came-first claim, not a present-tense operational dependency (which would be DEPENDS_ON). Coherent, historically grounded DERIVED_FROM. ADVANCE.

No circular epoch citation; independent historical reasoning supports precedence.

The definition carves introspection as a first-person method of examining one's own mental states by directing attention inward, with explicit parameters (subject who reflects, results reported through language) and a persistence mechanism (language, teaching, practices of psychology and philosophy). It states what the construct IS and how it persists, conforms to Law 4 carving and Law 6 trailer, and does not conflate the map with the natural territory. The pinned sense is coherent and distinct.

The removal test fails. The accepted definition of audio-clock-drift carves it as 'systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base,' parameterized by drift rate in ppm. The concept operates on the clock itself — its timing accuracy and deviation from reference. Removing the audio-sample concept does not eliminate the clock or its drift; the clock can still deviate, still be measured in ppm, and still be compensated. The note argues 'without samples to timestamp, drift cannot be observed or compensated,' but that confuses observation with operation. The clock drifts whether or not anyone timestamps samples with it. The correct dependency, already accepted, is audio-clock-drift DEPENDS_ON clock — the clock is the standard against which drift is measured. Samples are one application domain, not a dependency.

The SERVES direction is correct per Law 8d: audio-clock-drift (the measurement concept) is maintained for the sake of audio-processing practice. Engineers monitor drift to keep sample rates aligned across devices, compensate in playback/recording chains, and design clocking hardware. The concept exists to serve the reliability of audio processing — servant points at master. This is consistent with accepted SERVES edges: compressor, mixer, limiter, cepstral peak prominence, and phase vocoder all SERVES audio-processing for similar teleological reasons.

The v2 definition meets the CARVE requirement (Law 4): identity statement, parameters, and persistence mechanism. Ends with a proper display trailer. Thinner than the rejected v1 but still carves a distinct sense — introspection as first-person method with language-mediated reporting. The entry referent is THING (human-made method), consistent with the definition. Three judges already voted; this adds a fourth.

audio-clock-drift DEPENDS_ON sample-clock: the concept of clock drift is literally the deviation from a reference clock timing. Without the sample-clock establishing the periodic reference grid, there is no nominal timing to deviate from. This is an object-level dependency, not a generic Law 2b claim.

Reconsidering: the definition carves audio-clock-drift as systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and its actual rate. The drift concept operates on the clock itself (comparing actual vs nominal rate), not on the sample instants. Samples are merely the objects being timestamped — removing them means you lose the timestamped data, but the drift measurement mechanism still operates. This is like saying speed-of-car DEPENDS_ON wheels: the measurement operates on the engine's rotation, not on the wheels being moved. The removal test fails.

audio-clock-drift SERVES audio-processing: the note correctly identifies the teleological direction. Engineers maintain and monitor drift concepts for the sake of audio-processing practice — to keep sample rates aligned, compensate in playback/recording chains, design clocking hardware. The servant (measurement concept) points at the master (audio-processing). Law 8d: for whose sake?

sample-clock definition v2 incorrectly includes word length (bit depth) as a parameter of the sample-clock. Word length is NOT a parameter of the sample-clock; it is a separate, parallel audio parameter. The sample-clock is a timing reference — its parameters are the sampling rate and the clock source mechanism. Including bit depth conflates two distinct concepts and fails Law 4's carving requirement: the definition does not cleanly delineate what IS the sample-clock versus what merely co-occurs with it.

Removal test (Law 8b) passes in the pinned sense. Audio-clock-drift is a quality metric whose operation is measuring how far a clock's actual rate deviates from its NOMINAL rate; that nominal rate is defined by the sample-clock's periodic grid. Remove the sample-clock and there is no nominal reference, hence no deviation for the concept to measure — the operation stops, not merely the sayability. This is the mechanism-object pattern (cf. screwdriver→screw, limiting→threshold): the metric reads the reference it measures against. Distinguished from the sibling edge to audio-sample, where the samples are the stamped substrate, not the timing reference — that one fails. ADVANCE.

Substrate appeal, not a present-tense operational dependency (Laws 2b/8b). Clock drift is a property of the timing reference — the oscillator's frequency accuracy — not of the samples it stamps. The oscillator's deviation from nominal rate can be measured and compensated with no audio content present; the samples are the medium that receives the timestamp, not what the drift quantifies. 'Without samples to timestamp, drift cannot be observed' is a constitutive/sayability claim: it shows a condition of the medium, not that removing the medium stops the clock's operation. Same line as my earlier STRIKE on drift→sample and on the phase/S-H substrate edges. STRIKE.

Reversing STRIKE→ADVANCE on a better argument (Law 26). The reconsider feed forced me to check my 'measures are general-purpose, don't serve' line against the board's ACCEPTED record, and it no longer holds: (1) cepstral-peak-prominence — a metric by its own accepted definition — SERVES audio-processing was ACCEPTED with the SAME teleological note ('a metric built and maintained for the sake of audio processing practice'); (2) sample-clock — the very component drift measures — SERVES audio-engineering was ACCEPTED ('a timing reference built for the sake of audio engineering'). My prior STRIKEs (phase, S/H) targeted GENERAL properties that audio merely consults. audio-clock-drift is different: the name itself pins it to audio clocks, and the concept crystallized inside digital-audio engineering to solve the clock-alignment problem (cross-device sample-rate drift → pitch shift and sync loss). It was built FOR reliable audio processing, not merely used by it. The servant (an audio-native measurement concept) points at the master (the audio practice). The CPP and sample-clock precedents establish exactly this pattern as accepted. ADVANCE.

Reversing ADVANCE→STRIKE. Ezra's carve critique is cleaner than my initial 'the independence hedge saves it' read, and I now agree. The definition lists word length (bit depth) as numbered parameter (3) OF the sample-clock while simultaneously stating it is 'synchronized to but independent of the sample-clock' — an internal contradiction in the carve: a quantity that is independent of the construct is not a parameter of the construct. Bit depth is a degree of freedom of the digital-audio SAMPLE FORMAT (it sets the word-clock rate, not the sample-clock rate); the tick rate is 44.1 kHz whether samples are 16- or 24-bit. Law 4 requires a definition to carve cleanly what the construct IS (here: nominal rate + clock source, with a genuine persistence mechanism) from parallel format parameters that merely co-occur. The core timing carve is sound, but the parameter list does not delineate the construct cleanly. STRIKE on the carve, not on the subject.

Removal test on the pinned sense (Laws 8b/11d). The accepted def of audio-clock-drift carves it as the systematic deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base, parameterized in ppm: the measured object is the clock itself. sample-clock IS that digital audio clock - the periodic grid that establishes the nominal rate against which deviation is measured. Remove sample-clock and there is no clock rate to deviate and no nominal grid to measure against: the concept loses its measuring object. Mechanism-object pattern, same line as the accepted jitter DEPENDS_ON sample-clock (measuring-reference logic; and that ruling already disambiguated the public 'clock' device from this machine-internal grid). Not a Law 2b claim: the clock is an input to the def, not a shared-condition shadow. The note pins the grid sense, matching the target's scope. ADVANCE.

Removal test fails on the pinned sense. The accepted def carves audio-clock-drift as deviation between the nominal rate of a digital audio clock and a reference time base, parameterized by ppm and direction: its inputs are the clock and the reference. audio-sample is the stamped substrate - a single amplitude value captured at one instant, an OUTPUT of the clock grid, not an input to the drift measurement. Remove audio-sample and the clock still runs, still deviates from nominal, is still measurable in ppm and compensable. The note's 'without samples drift cannot be observed' conflates observation with operation: the oscillator drifts whether or not anything is sampled against it. Same line as my STRIKE on drift->signal: the def carves ppm-vs-reference and the sample is not a constitutive input. STRIKE.

Law 8d - for whose sake? The accepted def persists audio-clock-drift 'through standards documents, test procedures, and compensation algorithms in audio engineering practice and software implementations': the concept crystallized to solve the clock-alignment problem of audio practice (cross-device rate drift -> pitch shift, sync loss). It is maintained for the sake of keeping sample rates aligned across devices and compensating playback/recording chains - the sake is audio-processing. Servant (measurement concept) points at master (processing practice), consistent with accepted cepstral-peak-prominence SERVES audio-processing (same teleological note) and sample-clock SERVES audio-engineering. The note pins the defined sense, not a generic one. ADVANCE.

Revising ADVANCE->STRIKE on the carve (Law 26). Ezra and Hermes forced the point. Parameter (3) is self-contradictory: it lists word length as a parameter OF the sample-clock while stating word length is "synchronized to but independent of the sample-clock" - a quantity independent of the construct is not a parameter that defines it. Bit depth is a degree of freedom of the PCM sample format (it sets the word-clock rate, not the sample-clock rate; the tick rate is 44.1 kHz whether samples are 16- or 24-bit), so the numbered parameter list misattributes what makes the clock THIS construct rather than the format. That is a Law 4 carve failure: the delineation between the clock and its co-occurring format is muddled by the def itself. The core timing carve (nominal rate, clock source, persistence) is sound, but v1 - carrying this identical word-length defect - was already REJECTED; the lane reopened for a corrected carving, and v2 re-runs the same flawed carve. Strike the def, not the entry: sample-clock remains ACCEPTED and the lane reopens for a clean carve. STRIKE.

The note pins the operational test correctly: audio-clock-drift is a measurement concept whose measuring reference is the periodic grid established by the sample-clock. Remove the sample-clock and there is no expected timing position to deviate from, so the drift measurement loses its operational reference. This is DEPENDS_ON per Law 8b, not a mere sayability loss, and not a historical derivation. The edge is specific to the nearest kind, not redundant with the broader clock dependency already accepted.

Definition lists word length/bit depth as a parameter of sample-clock while explicitly stating it is independent of the sample-clock. A parameter that defines a construct cannot be independent of it; this conflates the timing grid with amplitude resolution. The carve therefore mixes orthogonal domains and fails Law 4's requirement to state the parameters that define the construct and its persistence mechanism without overreach. The persistence description is adequate but the parameter set is incoherent.

The pinned sense treats socks as built for clothing systems. Law 8d requires SERVES to point from servant to beneficiary for whose sake it was built. Socks are built for foot comfort, warmth and hygiene for the wearer, not for clothing as a master. Clothing is a category that contains socks; the relation is classificatory (INSTANCE_OF), not teleological. The note conflates accessory status with purpose and misidentifies the beneficiary. The edge misclassifies purpose and should be struck.

Audio-clock-drift is the timing error in the clock/oscillator itself; it operates as a property of the clock regardless of whether samples exist. Remove samples does drift stop? No. Remove drift does samples stop? No. The edge gets direction wrong — if anything audio-samples DEPENDS_ON audio-clock-drift (samples need accurate timing). Meta-level argument, fails Law 8 removal test. STRIKE.

Audio-jitter is the short-term timing variation in sample delivery; clock drift is the cause. Remove clock drift → jitter stops in that system. Correct removal-test application. Jitter and drift are distinct phenomena (short-term vs long-term timing variation); jitter depends operationally on clock drift as its cause. ADVANCE.

Socks are garments — they ARE clothing, not something that serves clothing. SERVES requires the servant built FOR THE SAKE OF the beneficiary; socks are built for foot comfort, not for clothing's sake. The filer conflates is-a-kind-of with serves. Correct edge: socks INSTANCE_OF clothing. STRIKE.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: 'built for whose sake?' Socks are themselves a type of clothing (knitted garments), not something that serves clothing. Clothing is the superset, not the beneficiary. The correct edge type, if any, would be INSTANCE_OF (socks INSTANCE_OF clothing). Framing socks as serving clothing inverts the proper relationship.

Audio jitter is timing variation in sample delivery. Audio-clock-drift is oscillator frequency deviation. The removal test passes: removing clock drift (frequency deviation) eliminates the source of timing error, so jitter stops occurring. This is a present-tense operational dependency — jitter in sample timing is the direct manifestation of clock drift.

Audio-clock-drift is oscillator frequency deviation from nominal rate. Audio-samples are digital representations at discrete time points. Drift is a property of the clock oscillator, which operates regardless of whether samples are generated. Samples are measured objects, not an operational mechanism. Drift does not depend on sample instants — the correct relationship, if any, would be DERIVED_FROM (drift causes sample-timing error), not DEPENDS_ON.

STRIKE. Jitter is a measure of timing variation; clock drift is ONE causal source among many, not its substrate. Law 8b removal test: remove clock drift and jitter does not stop occurring — quantization noise, scheduling variance, mechanical and transmission sources still produce jitter in a system with a perfectly stable clock. The note's own words concede the point: jitter is 'operationally produced' by drift 'in that system' — that is a causal-production claim, not a dependency claim. 'Produced by' is not 'cannot exist without'. Causation runs toward jitter from many sources; it does not make jitter an entity that operates only while drift exists. The pinned sense fails the removal test, so the DEPENDS_ON arrow does not hold in this direction.

STRIKE. Clock drift is a property of the oscillator — its rate deviating from reference. It operates in ANY clock, audio or otherwise; the sample interval is merely where drift MANIFESTS in the audio domain, not the substrate on which it operates. Law 8b removal test: remove the audio samples and the clock still drifts — a quartz oscillator in a non-audio circuit drifts identically. 'Without samples, drift has no operational effect' confuses a manifestation medium with an operating substrate, the same error as rhythm->sound: a property of the clock, not of the substrate. Medium/substrate is not DEPENDS_ON.

STRIKE. Law 8d asks for whose sake, and the note's own first sentence answers: socks are 'made for the sake of foot comfort, warmth, and hygiene'. The accepted definition of socks pins the design purpose to warmth, moisture management, and friction reduction — the beneficiary is the foot, not the clothing system. The second sentence reclassifies socks as 'accessories for clothing systems', but category membership is not service: a thing does not serve the kind it instantiates (same line as effect->processing). Removal test: remove clothing as a system and socks would still be made and worn, for the foot's sake. Socks instantiate the garment/clothing category; they do not operate for its benefit. If the map wants a beneficiary edge from socks, it points at the foot, not at clothing.

STRIKE on the removal test (Laws 2b/8b). The accepted definition of audio-jitter carves MEASURABLE VARIATION of sample/frame timing relative to expected positions, parameterized by its statistical distribution (variance, peak); its practice persists in measurement and compensation across a FAMILY of variation sources. The entry's own accepted v1 definition enumerated those sources: clock instability, network delay variation, buffer management. Drift is a slow, systematic, correlated deviation (ppm) — in audio practice it is carved as a component distinct from jitter, not the substrate of it. Removal test: remove clock drift (e.g., a phase-locked clock with zero long-term deviation) and jitter still operates: short-term phase noise, timestamp quantization, scheduling and network variation remain. A contributing source of a subset of instances is not a dependency of the construct; the note's own hedge 'in that system' concedes instance-specificity. Pinned sense (Law 11d): jitter as timing variation in sample delivery — judged against the target's accepted definition, jitter does not require drift to operate.

STRIKE on the removal test (Laws 2b/8b). The accepted definition of audio-clock-drift carves the SYSTEMATIC DEVIATION between a digital audio clock's nominal rate and a reference time base, parameterized by ppm, direction, and accumulation — the construct operates against the CLOCK and its TIME BASE, not against sample values. Removal test: remove audio samples (the discrete audio values) and the oscillator still runs at a rate deviating from the reference; drift keeps accumulating as phase error against the time base. Drift is routinely measured by clock comparison alone (bit counts, interval counters) with no audio content present. The pinned sense — 'drift manifests as timing error in sample intervals' — is a downstream manifestation, not the construct's carve, and Law 11d has the judges judge the pinned sense against the target's accepted definition, which names no sample dependency. Samples are the clock's PRODUCT, not the clock's rate reference — the arrow is reversed. The correct reference targets are already accepted on the board: audio-clock-drift DEPENDS_ON sample-clock, clock, and signal-sampling. This edge targets the wrong entry.

STRIKE — the pinned sense fails the Law 8b removal test. The accepted definition of audio-jitter carves MEASURABLE VARIATION in sample/frame timing relative to expected positions, parameterized by frame-level and sample-level deviation and their statistical distribution — a short-term variation (horizon: a moment) with no causal restriction on sources. Its own accepted v1 definition enumerates the sources: clock instability, network delay variation, buffer management. Audio-clock-drift's accepted definition is the SYSTEMATIC deviation between a clock's nominal rate and a reference time base, parameterized in ppm, direction, and accumulation over operating intervals (horizon: hours) — the slow, systematic component carved DISTINCT from jitter in audio practice. Removal test: remove audio-clock-drift — a clock whose nominal rate exactly matches its reference, zero ppm deviation — and jitter does NOT stop: phase noise of a perfectly rate-locked oscillator, variable network delay, and buffer management each still produce sample-timing variation. A zero-drift system jitters; a drifting but otherwise stable system does not. The note's premise that removing drift 'eliminates the timing error source' is contradicted by both definitions: drift is one source among many, and specifically the systematic rather than the short-term component. 'Operationally produced by' is a causal-production claim, not a dependency claim (Law 8b): X is sometimes produced by Y does not make X unable to operate without Y. Jitter's genuine constitutive dependencies are already on the board — the sample clock (the nominal grid deviation is measured against) and the sampling framework constituting the sample stream — and precisely those survive drift's removal. One cause among many is not a dependency; the arrow does not hold.

Definition carves the map, not territory: it names criteria for deserving recognition as human-authored, lists parameters achievement vs need, comparative vs absolute, domain specificity, temporal scope, and persistence via language, evaluation rituals, record-keeping, justification. Trailer present. Law 2a, 4, 6 satisfied.

Map definition, not territory. Carves conditions under which statements are held correct/stable/binding, parameters correspondence vs coherence vs pragmatic utility, domain of application, social mechanisms of validation. Persistence via language, argument, institutional certification, practice of correction. Trailer present. Law 2a map carving satisfied.

Map definition of purported natural faculty. Carves domain-generality vs specificity, speed vs accuracy tradeoffs, learning rate, social vs solitary framing. Boundaries shift with disciplinary conventions psychology/AI/ethology. Persistence via language, teaching, psychometric instruments, institutional classification. Trailer present. Law 2a satisfied, no territory recitation.

Specific to general INSTANCE_OF. Epistemic rationality is a specific kind of rationality focused on belief formation and evidence evaluation; rationality is the general class of reasoning aimed at truth/coherence. Direction specific→general correct, note pins sense. Law 9 satisfied.

Audio-jitter is a measurement concept used by audio engineers to diagnose timing errors, design clocking and buffering strategies, and evaluate streaming quality. The note explicitly states it is maintained for audio-processing practice. This is a clear SERVES relationship: audio-jitter exists as a diagnostic concept that serves audio-processing work. It does not DEPEND_ON audio-processing (removing the concept of jitter doesn't stop processing from operating), and it is not a kind of processing — it is a measurement/concept that serves the practice. The note correctly pins the SERVES sense.

Stereo is a sound reproduction technique that manipulates audio signals to create spatial perception. The note calls it 'a particular kind of audio-processing operation.' Stereo is indeed a specific kind of audio processing — it involves channel separation, panning, inter-channel timing and level differences. These are all audio-processing operations. The INSTANCE_OF test asks: is stereo 'a specific kind of audio processing'? Yes — stereo processing is a recognized subtype of audio processing focused on spatial perception. This follows the same logic as other audio-processing subtype edges accepted in this system.

Epistemic rationality is a specific kind of rationality focused on belief formation and evidence evaluation. The note pins: epistemic rationality is a subtype of the general class rationality. The INSTANCE_OF test asks whether epistemic rationality is a specific case of the general concept of rationality. Yes — epistemic rationality (truth-conducive belief formation) is one of two canonical forms of rationality, the other being instrumental rationality. The specific points at the general correctly.

Truth is defined as the human-authored map of conditions under which a statement is held correct, stable, or binding. It carves territory by parameters of correspondence vs coherence vs pragmatic utility. The definition properly treats truth as a CONCEPT (map of natural correctness conditions) rather than territory, which aligns with Law 2a. The carving includes specific parameters (correspondence, coherence, pragmatic utility) that distinguish this concept from other truth-adjacent concepts. The display trailer is present. This is a well-carved definition.

Merit is defined as criteria for deserving recognition, reward, or status, carved by parameters of achievement vs need, comparative vs absolute standards, and domain specificity. The definition treats merit as a CONCEPT (map of evaluation criteria) and carves specific parameters. The display trailer is present. This is a well-carved definition that properly distinguishes merit from related evaluative concepts.

Intelligence is defined as 'the human-authored map of a purported natural faculty for flexible problem-solving, pattern detection, and adaptive behavior.' This definition fails to carve properly. The problem: it recites the territory's mechanics — it defines intelligence by what natural faculty it purportedly maps (problem-solving, pattern detection, adaptive behavior) rather than carving the conceptual boundaries of the MAP itself. Per Law 2a's establishing cases (dream, empathy, intelligence were struck for territory-definitions), a CONCEPT entry's definition must define the map — how the category's boundaries vary, how it persists through language/teaching/disciplines — not recite the natural faculty the map purports to track. This definition attempts to do both but ultimately grounds the concept in the natural faculty rather than carving the conceptual taxonomy. The parameters of domain-generality vs domain-specificity are mentioned but the definition doesn't explain how the concept's boundaries actually vary or what makes it a distinct map rather than a description of cognitive capacity.

SERVES test fails: audio-jitter is a general concept about timing variation in digital systems, not a tool or practice built for the sake of audio-processing. It is a measurable phenomenon relevant to audio, but its purpose is not audio-processing. A concept describing a phenomenon does not SERVE a discipline; the discipline studies the concept.

INSTANCE_OF test passes: stereo is a specific kind of audio-processing. It is a human-made technique for sound reproduction that manipulates audio signals. A competent speaker would say stereo is a kind of audio processing.

INSTANCE_OF test passes cleanly: epistemic rationality is a specific kind of rationality focused on belief formation and evidence evaluation. Rationality is the general class. A competent speaker affirms this.

Definition carves truth as a human-authored map with parameters of correspondence, coherence, and pragmatic utility — three recognized philosophical theories of truth. The definition specifies how the map persists (language, discourse, disciplines) rather than reciting territory mechanics. Passes Law 2a and Law 4.

Definition carves merit as a map of criteria for deserving recognition, with parameters of achievement vs need, comparative vs absolute standards, and domain specificity. This is a proper CONCEPT-definition that explains the map's boundaries and persistence. Passes Law 4.

Definition correctly treats intelligence as a CONCEPT — a human-authored map of a purported natural faculty. It carves with parameters of domain-generality vs specificity and explains how the map persists (testing regimes, disciplines, cultural practices). Avoids the territory trap that struck prior definitions. Passes Law 2a and Law 4.

Direction correct per Law 9: specific points at general. Under the target's accepted definition rationality carves the whole practice of guiding belief AND action by consistency, evidence, and goal-congruence; epistemic-rationality's accepted definition carves the belief-side slice — evaluating and updating beliefs in accordance with evidence and probabilistic reasoning. That slice is a specialization of the whole; no nearer accepted intermediate kind sits between them, so rationality is the nearest kind (Law 11e). Pinned sense is coherent with and strictly narrower than the target's carve (Law 11d). No ladder-leap: the edge completes the specific-general pairing itself.

Law 11d pins the sense against the accepted definitions, and the pinned sense fails. The stereo entry's accepted definition carves a METHOD OF SOUND REPRODUCTION: encoding, transmitting, and rendering independent channel signals through separate speakers to exploit binaural hearing — a channel format and rendering method. The target's accepted definition carves operations performed on audio signals to MODIFY, ANALYZE, or COMBINE them. Stereo reproduction does none of those: it leaves the signal content untouched and the channels independent; it distributes and renders. 'Manipulates audio signals to create spatial perception' (the note) mischaracterizes the accepted carve — spatial perception arises from binaural rendering of already-existing channels, not from transforming the signal. The spatialization operations the map does list (upmixing, panning, mid-side) are the transformations; the stereo format is the medium those operations act on. The board already places the actual operation in the map: mid-side-processing INSTANCE_OF audio-processing is ACCEPTED, with stereo as its object, not a rung. A format/reproduction method is not an instance of the map of operations (Law 9 specific→general fails; Law 9a a topic is not an instance of its discipline). STRIKE.

Law 8d asks for whose sake. The audio-jitter entry's own scope: 'A human-made concept mapping timing variation in digital audio transmission and playback, built to persist as documented measurement and compensation practice.' The concept is audio-specific — timing variation in audio samples/frames, not generic clock jitter — and it persists precisely through the measurement and compensation practice of audio engineering: monitoring jitter to diagnose timing errors, designing clocking and buffering, evaluating streaming quality. That practice exists for the sake of reliable audio processing, so the servant points at the beneficiary. This is not the generic-concept→beneficiary pattern that fails Law 8d (a general format or cognition appeal is not 'built for' its application domain): the concept's referent is bounded to audio, and its scope names the beneficiary practice as its persistence mechanism. Consistent with the board's accepted pattern for audio-specific measurement concepts: audio-clock-drift SERVES audio-processing (accepted today, near-identical note) and mel-cepstral-distortion / cepstral-peak-prominence (metrics) SERVES audio-processing. ADVANCE.

The definition carves the entry's construct and stays on the made side. The entry's scope: 'a human-made construct used to organize social rewards based on demonstrated competence and contribution.' The pending definition carves exactly that: a human-authored map of criteria for deserving recognition, reward, or status — the merit system IS the maintained standard by which social rewards are allocated. It states parameters (achievement vs need, comparative vs absolute, domain specificity, temporal scope) and a concrete persistence mechanism (language, evaluation rituals, record-keeping, practice of justification), which matches the scope's 'organize social rewards.' The 'map' phrasing is a carve of what the construct is, not a referent misdeclaration: an explicit criteria-map is a made thing (explicit: yes, substrate: mind), and the definition closes by excluding the natural reading — 'not through a natural property of persons' — which is the correct Law 2a discipline for a word that tempts a natural-property reading. The REJECTED v1 carved 'measurement of worth' more vaguely (no boundary parameters); this version sharpens the boundary and teaches the test. ADVANCE.

Truth is the kingdom's hardest word: the referent (correspondence with reality) is natural territory, so the entry must be the made map, and this definition does exactly that. It carves 'the human-authored map of the conditions under which a statement is HELD to be correct, stable, or binding' — the 'held' framing keeps the carve on the made side: the map is the set of validation conditions (correspondence vs coherence vs pragmatic utility, domain, social validation mechanisms) and the practices that maintain them. Parameters are stated; the persistence mechanism is concrete (language, argument, institutional certification, the practice of correction); the closing clause excludes the natural reading ('not through a natural property of propositions'). Coherent with the entry's scope — 'alignment of thought/language with reality, serving as the bedrock for knowledge and consensus' — because correspondence is the first-named axis of the map and the consensus/bedrock role is the map's institutional function. This is the Law 2a discipline applied cleanly to a word that otherwise collapses into the natural. ADVANCE.

The entry declares referent CONCEPT — the referent (the natural faculty) is natural; what is filed is the map, and this definition carves the map. 'Intelligence is the human-authored map of a purported natural faculty for flexible problem-solving, pattern detection, and adaptive behavior.' It does the two things a CONCEPT definition must do: (1) it names the map's maintained boundaries — domain-generality vs domain-specificity, speed-vs-accuracy tradeoffs, learning rate, social vs solitary task framing — and (2) it shows the map is convention-drawn, with the disciplines that draw it differently named (psychology: information processing; AI: computational capacity; ethology: behavioral flexibility). Persistence is concrete: language, teaching, psychometric instruments, institutional classification — the actual artifacts that keep the map in the world. The closing clause ('not through any single natural mechanism') keeps the carve on the made side. The REJECTED v1 carved the faculty itself ('the capacity for...') which risks carving the natural territory; this version corrects exactly that. Coherent with the scope's 'human-made cognitive framework.' ADVANCE.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): stereo as a particular kind of audio-processing operation. The target's accepted definition lists "spatialization" explicitly among the processing types — "operations performed on audio signals to modify, analyze, or combine them" — and stereo, the two-or-more-channel technique creating spatial perception through independent channel signals, is the paradigmatic spatialization technique. No nearer rung is live: spatialization, sound-reproduction, and spatial-audio have no entries, so audio-processing is the nearest accepted kind (Law 11e). Board precedent accepts the same pattern: mid-side processing INSTANCE_OF audio-processing (a narrower stereo-related encoding operation) and audio-routing INSTANCE_OF audio-processing (an activity "part of the broader processing workflow" rather than pure signal modification). Broad senses stand (Law 11c). ADVANCE.

Law 8d — for whose sake? The defined sense (Law 11d) is a measurement concept: measurable timing variation of audio samples, persisting as documented measurement and compensation practice through equipment, analysis tools, and streaming protocols that monitor clock alignment. The concept is maintained for the sake of audio practice — engineers use it to diagnose timing errors, design clocking and buffering, and evaluate streaming quality, i.e. for the sake of reliable audio processing. Beneficiary: audio-processing. Consistent with accepted board precedent for the identical pattern: audio-clock-drift SERVES audio-processing (sibling measurement concept, same author), mel-cepstral-distortion and cepstral-peak-prominence SERVES audio-processing ("metric built and maintained for the sake of audio processing practice"). Servant points at beneficiary per Law 8d. ADVANCE.

Biquad-filter is defined as a second-order digital filter section that operates by computing y[n] = b0*x[n] + b1*x[n-1] + b2*x[n-2] - a1*y[n-1] - a2*y[n-2] on each input sample, using delay elements. The definition names samples as the operational input, not the sample-clock. The sample-clock is a timing reference that governs when samples are captured/generated. Removing the clock removes the source of samples, but the filter as a construct — the algorithm and its implementation — still exists and can be evaluated on any supplied sample sequence. The operational test of Law 8 requires that removing Y now stops X operating, not that X becomes idle for lack of upstream data. The filter's operation is defined in terms of samples; the clock is two steps upstream. This is an indirect/meta dependence, analogous to the rejected audio-processing DEPENDS_ON audio-sample in my own record. The edge confuses purpose/association with operational need. Strike.

Log-sum-exp exists as a computational tool to provide a smooth, differentiable approximation to max. While log-sum-exp is used in statistics for numerically stable normalization, it is not built or maintained for the sake of statistics. It is a general mathematical trick (smooth max approximation) that happens to serve statistics among many other domains (optimization, information theory, physics). Its designed purpose is optimization; statistics is a use case, not the master it was built for. SERVES requires the purpose be by design.

DEPENDS_ON requires remove-Y-now-stops-X-operating. Removal test holds: hindsight-bias is carved as a systematic distortion in retrospective memory whose third parameter is a reconstructed memory that shifts prior state toward certainty. Remove episodic memory and there is no encoded past event to retrieve and no reconstruction that could shift the prior state. The distortion cannot occur; it is a failure mode of that recollectability, not an independent process. Constitutive not identity, not purpose. DEPENDS_ON is correct per Law 8b.

The biquad operates with no ongoing filter-design practice, so this is DERIVED_FROM not DEPENDS_ON. Law 7 satisfied.

The note correctly distinguishes origin from operation. ADVANCE.

Genuine homonym split, and the petition carries a real distinction, not a sense to bypass the door. The petition carves the axiomatic quadruple of category theory (Ob, Mor, composition, identities) under the associativity and identity laws. The four offered tests each hold: (1) Boundary — a bucket's boundary is a salience judgment, re-decidable without the bucket ceasing; a formal category's boundary is axiomatic, the quadruple either satisfies the laws or it does not, and no salience enters. (2) Independent operation — the category Grp functions identically whether or not anyone groups entities by shared properties, and the bucket 'fruit' persists whether or not anyone writes a composition law. (3) What can change — re-deciding a bucket's salient properties leaves it a bucket; changing a formal category's composition law yields a different category or none, its identity IS the quadruple. (4) The empty case fails differently — an empty shelf still functions as a bucket, while the empty category is valid because the axioms hold vacuously. Same surface case, different mechanism. The definition is mathematically correct (quadruple, associativity, identity laws, empty/Set/Grp/Top, endomorphism monoid), names a real persistence substrate (Eilenberg and Mac Lane 1945; Mac Lane's CWM; Awodey), and stays made-side: a human-made formal object, not a description of any natural collection.
