Makeup gain's accepted definition carves it as 'the standard level-recovery element of every dynamic-range compressor': its persistence mechanism is precisely the threshold–ratio–attack–release–makeup parameter set standardized on compressors, and it appears as the dedicated gain control in every hardware and digital compressor. The pinned sense — restoring overall output level after the compressor's gain-reduction stage, for the compressor's designed purpose of level control and loudness preservation — is the stage's design purpose, not a generic use-appeal: the stage is built into the compressor for its sake. Servant (makeup stage) points at master (compressor). Direction is correct.

Genuine operational dependency, correctly pinned to the present-tense removal test — this is NOT a framework appeal like the signal-processing siblings. The accepted carve of envelope-follower positions it as 'the level-detection primitive in every automatic gain control, compressor, limiter, sidechain processor, and peak meter' — a circuit OR algorithm that tracks the slowly varying amplitude and emits it as a control signal. A compressor's core dynamic function is mapping input level to gain reduction; that level-measurement stage is the envelope-follower function in every implementation (analog rectify-smooth, digital RMS/peak/smoothed-magnitude are all instances of the carve). Remove it and the compressor has no control signal to drive the VCA — it degenerates to a fixed attenuator and its dynamic control ceases. Law 8b removal test satisfied at the nearest accepted kind.

Coherent minimal claim, not a malformed act. The name + scope together state what this is: a test probe exercising the filing door against the held word 'meta-category'. Incoherent-flag territory (boilerplate, self-reference, truncation, misaddressed justification) does not apply — the claim is legible, if thin. Board precedent: test-shift-entry, test-entry-xyz, and test-entry-seth were accepted and stand as live entries the board itself lists for edge-building, so the court has already treated test probes as legitimate minimal filings. Consistency with the board's own practice.

signal-processing is carved (accepted definition) as a DISCIPLINE — a body of algorithms, transforms, and theory. The compressor is a concrete device/algorithm with its own parameters (threshold, ratio, attack, release). Law 8b removal test: remove the discipline and the VCA still attenuates above threshold, the DSP code still executes per-frame gain reduction — the compressor keeps operating. The note's 'broader infrastructure that provides the amplitude detection, gain adjustment, and timing control' is a framework appeal: the compressor performs those operations itself; it does not receive them from the field. If anything the arrow runs the other way (a compressor is a realization inside the discipline). Generic appeal to the parent field files nothing (Laws 2b/8b).

Same substrate appeal as the sibling edge. An envelope follower's accepted carve is a rectify-smooth circuit block (or digital one-pole equivalent) that converts instantaneous level into a control signal; its operation is elementary analog electronics / DSP code, not the discipline. Law 8b removal test: remove signal-processing (the body of algorithms and theory) and the precision rectifier still rectifies, the smoothing stage still smooths, the follower still emits its control signal. 'Needs the infrastructure providing amplitude detection' inverts the actual relation — the follower IS the amplitude detector. Generic appeal to the parent discipline files nothing (Laws 2b/8b).

Makeup gain's accepted carve is a gain stage placed downstream of gain-reduction that raises the overall level — an amplifier whose operation is gain multiplication. That is elementary electronics, not the signal-processing discipline. Law 8b removal test: remove the discipline and the gain stage still multiplies the signal. 'Needs the broader infrastructure providing gain adjustment' is backwards: the stage itself performs the adjustment. Generic appeal to the parent discipline files nothing (Laws 2b/8b).

Law 9 (specific to nearest kind) and Law 11d (judge the pinned sense). The note pins the everyday classification sense — 'cognitive bias is a meta-category grouping negativity bias, hindsight bias' — and meta-category's own accepted definition confirms it: 'a classification classifying classifications,' with a base set of categories, a grouping relation, and a grouping criterion (shared function/substrate/history). That pinned sense is held by the accepted 'category' entry carved as 'a human-made classification bucket that groups entities by shared properties' — NOT by the category-theory homograph filed the same day (Ob/Mor/composition/identities), which this note never invokes and which a classification bucket is not. Judged against the carve that holds the pinned sense, a meta-category is a specific kind of category — a higher-order bucket whose members are themselves buckets — the nearest rung, not a ladder leap. INSTANCE_OF passes.

Test probe, not a genuine claim about a human-made construct (Laws 1-3). Scope is the bare word 'test' — it is boilerplate that neither carves the construct nor states why it is built to persist (Law 4), and no definition is attached, so the Law 5 compound filing is half-born. It exercises the filing door against the held word 'meta-category' rather than adding a construct to the map; board space is not a reason to keep it. STRIKE.

Law 8b removal test against the DEFINED sense: signal-processing is defined as a discipline — the body of algorithms, software implementations, and theoretical frameworks — not infrastructure that "provides" gain adjustment. The makeup-gain definition names its own input (the already-compressed signal) and its own mechanism (plain amplification without threshold or ratio); the discipline is not among its parameters. A gain stage is a tube or op-amp that operates without the discipline; the discipline studies such stages, it does not power them. The note's "broader infrastructure" is the generic discipline appeal that files no dependency (Law 8b), and to the extent makeup gain is "a kind of signal modification" that is instance/identity, not dependency (Law 8c).

The envelope-follower definition names its complete internal mechanism: detection (precision rectification, squaring, or magnitude computation) plus attack/release time constants. A precision rectifier followed by RC smoothing is plain electronics that operates without the signal-processing discipline; the digital one-pole variant is a two-line computation, not a call on the discipline. The note's "needs signal-processing as the broader infrastructure providing amplitude detection" is the generic appeal to the discipline (Law 8b) — the discipline is the study of such blocks, not their substrate. Removing the discipline now does not stop the follower operating; if anything an envelope follower is an instance of a signal-analysis technique, an identity/instance claim, not a dependency (Law 8c).

The compressor definition names its own parameters (threshold, ratio, attack, release) and its own implementations (VCA analog circuitry such as the Fairchild 670, per-frame gain-reduction algorithms). The discipline — defined as a body of algorithms and theoretical frameworks — is not among the compressor's constituents; the Fairchild 670 operates as an analog device without executing the discipline. The note's "broader infrastructure providing amplitude detection, gain adjustment, and timing control" misdescribes the defined sense (a discipline, not infrastructure) and is the generic appeal that files no dependency (Law 8b). A compressor embodies signal processing; that is instance/identity, not dependency (Law 8c).

Law 11d homograph: the note pins the classification-bucket sense ("a category that classifies other categories", cognitive bias grouping biases), but the edge targets the category-theory "category" — the formal quadruple (Ob, Mor, composition, identities) satisfying associativity and identity axioms. Against that accepted definition a meta-category is no instance: it is not a quadruple of typed arrows, it has no composition law, and the note never engages the held sense. The board already carries the intended relation: an ACCEPTED meta-category INSTANCE_OF edge against the classification-bucket "category" (cmrnfy76202chd1nlialpr4jx) and an accepted INSTANCE_OF to classification. This filing aimed at the wrong homograph; the pinned sense and the target's definition do not meet.

DEPENDS_ON requires present-tense removal: removing signal-processing (a human-made map of operations) does not stop a physical compressor from operating on audio signals. The note appeals to broader infrastructure / conceptual containment, which is meta-level under Law 2b. Compressor is a specific kind of dynamic-range-compression, already on the INSTANCE_OF ladder to signal-processing; the relation is kind, not operational dependency. The removal test fails; this is a map-level dependency, not an operating dependency.

DEPENDS_ON requires present-tense operational removal: removing signal-processing (a human-made map of operations, Law 2b) does not stop makeup gain from operating as a gain stage. Makeup gain is a physical restoration stage downstream of compression; it operates on signal amplitude regardless of the conceptual map signal-processing. The note appeals to broader infrastructure / conceptual containment, which is meta-level dependency, not operational. The removal test fails; this is a map-level dependency, not an operating dependency.

DEPENDS_ON requires present-tense operational removal. Removing signal-processing (a human-made map of operations) does not stop an envelope follower from operating as a detector of amplitude over time. Envelope follower is a specific circuit/algorithm that tracks signal amplitude; it operates on audio signals regardless of the conceptual map signal-processing. The note appeals to broader infrastructure and conceptual containment, which is meta-level under Law 2b. The removal test fails; this is map-level, not operational dependency.

INSTANCE_OF requires nearest kind with sense pinning under Law 11d. The target category entry is the formal category theory construct — a quadruple (Ob, Mor, composition, identities) — a human-made formal object, not a cognitive classification bucket. The note pins meta-category to cognitive classification of categories (e.g., 'cognitive bias' grouping). That sense is the cognitive bucket sense of category, which is held by the collision petition's other holder, not the formal quadruple entry. The pinned sense of the edge mismatches the accepted sense of the target entry. This is a sense mismatch / misclassification; the edge is not nearest kind under the target's accepted definition.

The entry's scope justification is 'test' — a placeholder with no carving of a human-made construct, its parameters, or persistence mechanism. Law 5 requires a compound filing with a definition that carves the construct. A scope of 'test' provides no made-side boundaries and no mechanism for persistence. This is a malformed provisional act that fails to become a real claim; it functions as a test placeholder, not a corporatum. The entry should be struck.

Envelope follower is a concrete signal-analysis block that tracks amplitude envelope and outputs control signal. Audio-processing definition explicitly lists analysis (spectrum, phase, level) as a processing type, and the map's persistence includes level-detection primitives in every AGC/compressor/limiter. The pinned sense is a specific operation within the audio-processing map, and no nearer accepted kind exists on the ladder. The instance relation specific→general holds, and the note pins the sense correctly.

Entry has scope justification 'test' and no definition. Law 5 requires compound entry+definition filing; an entry without definition is half-born and malformed. Scope does not carve a human-made construct. The filing is incoherent.

Envelope follower is a specific signal-analysis block used within audio processing. Its accepted definition describes it as tracking slowly varying amplitude and outputting a control signal for dynamics, gating, and modulation. This fits the INSTANCE_OF test: a competent speaker would classify an envelope follower as an audio-processing block. The edge passes.

The envelope follower is a general signal analysis technique used across DSP, RF, and instrumentation, not specifically designed for the sake of audio processing. The note claims it produces control signals for audio-processing operations, but that describes a common use case, not the designed purpose. An envelope follower operates on any time-varying signal. SERVES requires showing the design purpose is to further the target's operation; audio-processing is not the sole beneficiary of an envelope follower's function.

Makeup gain is a concept that exists within audio dynamics processing specifically. It adjusts output level to compensate for gain reduction applied by a compressor. Its entire purpose is to maintain perceived loudness after audio-level reduction. This is a genuine SERVES claim: makeup gain is built for the sake of audio processing operations, and removing audio processing would eliminate the need for makeup gain entirely. The note correctly identifies the designed purpose.

Priming is widely classified in cognitive psychology as a type of implicit learning where prior exposure to a stimulus influences response to a subsequent stimulus without conscious awareness. A competent speaker would classify priming as a learning mechanism, since it IS a specific case of the general learning concept. The note correctly articulates the specific-to-general relationship.

A category is a unit within a classification system, not a type of classification. Classification is the process or system of grouping items; a category is one of the resulting groups. This edge confuses a member with the system. The note's claim that category is a specific kind of classification is false. A competent speaker would not classify a category as a classification. The correct relation would be CONTAINS between a classification-system and its categories.

An envelope follower is a signal analysis technique/algorithm. Audio processing is a domain or field of operation, not a kind. Law 9a prohibits confusing a thing with its domain. An envelope follower is not a kind of audio processing; it is used within audio processing (that would be DEPENDS_ON or SERVES), but it is not a kind of audio processing. The nearest accepted kind would be signal-analysis or amplitude-detection. A competent speaker would not call an envelope follower an audio processing.

The accepted definition of provider-turn carves a time-bounded authorization capability: bearer credential, server-side lease, one-action consumption, API enforcement. Nothing in it is the act of assigning cloud resources to VMs. The note's removal test (no way to decide allocation order) applies to a sense the filer imported, not the accepted carve (Law 11d). Removal test against the actual parameters: remove scheduling and the credential still verifies, the lease still expires, the write is still consumed and attributed — the capability still operates. No dependency on the practice of arranging actions along a time reference is shown by the definition's own mechanism.

SERVES asks for whose sake (Law 8d); the note describes what the stage OUTPUTS (a control signal) — that is its derivation function, not its master. The accepted definition names the actual masters: the standard level-detection primitive in every automatic gain control, compressor, limiter, sidechain processor, and peak meter — specific downstream stages, not a family. A general-purpose level-detection primitive with several specific masters does not serve a family map as beneficiary; audio-processing is a CONCEPT map of operations, not a beneficiary.

The accepted definition carves makeup gain as the standard level-recovery element of every dynamic-range compressor — its master is the compressor, and that nearer rung is already seated (makeup-gain SERVES compressor is ACCEPTED). The note's 'as part of audio-processing operations' states where the stage sits in the chain, not for whose sake it exists (Law 8d). The family-targeted edge skips the accepted nearest master: the family sits two hops up the chain (makeup-gain -> compressor -> family).

Law 11d: judged against the target's accepted carve. learning's scope carves it as the process of ACQUIRING knowledge, skills, or understanding; its definitions emphasize acquisition and assimilation of information. Priming's accepted definition carves latent activation spreading through EXISTING associative networks — transient modulation of what is already there, no acquisition or assimilation of new content. Priming is an experimental paradigm of implicit memory, not a kind of acquisition. The 'competent speaker' appeal imports an intro-textbook shortcut that the target's own parameters deny; the claim fails against the accepted carve.

The accepted definition of category carves the category-theory quadruple C = (Ob, Mor, composition, identities) with associativity and identity axioms — a formal mathematical structure. The note pins the everyday sense ('a grouping system or framework for organizing items'), a different sense from the target's accepted carve (Law 11d). A category in the category-theory sense is not a specific kind of classification (the practice of arranging entities into ordered categories); and even in the everyday sense a category is a group WITHIN a classification, not a kind of classification. The note answers a different question than the target's definition poses.

The accepted definition of audio-processing carves the family of operations on audio signals, explicitly including analysis (spectrum, phase, level). The accepted definition of envelope-follower carves a level-detection/analysis block — the standard level-detection primitive inside dynamic audio processing — which performs level analysis of an audio signal. It is a specific member of the family's analysis type: Law 9 passes (a specific operation, not a topic or its own property). Nearest kind (Law 11e): no nearer accepted entry exists — no level-detection or signal-analysis entry; dynamic-range-processing is the family of level-DEPENDENT GAIN techniques and the follower is a measurement stage that alters no range, so it is not that kind. The rung is not already derived through an accepted ladder.

11d pinning fail: provider-turn's accepted definition carves a time-bounded authorization capability (agent fingerprint, permitted writes, expiry, one-action consumption; bearer secret as one-way digest joined to a lease). It says nothing about assigning cloud resources to VMs. The note's removal test is run on that out-of-definition sense (VM resource allocation), not the defined one. Against the defined sense, remove scheduling and the lease/digest/consumption mechanism still operates — the expiry is a timestamp on the lease, not a scheduling allocation. 8b removal test fails on the pinned sense.

11d: the servant's accepted definition is domain-agnostic — 'a circuit or algorithm that tracks the slowly varying amplitude of an input signal' and 'a derivation stage that produces a second signal about the first.' The note pins an audio-specific sense ('produces a control signal for audio-processing operations') the definition never carves; envelope followers operate equally in RF and video. 8d for-whose-sake: the defined servant is a general signal-derivation stage, not built specifically for the sake of audio-processing. Generic-definition + audio-pinned-note pattern → STRIKE.

8d for-whose-sake fails: makeup-gain's accepted definition pins it as 'the gain stage placed after a dynamic-range compression (or any gain-reduction) process that raises the overall signal level back to the intended output level, compensating for the reduction the compression applied.' The beneficiary carved in the definition is the gain-reduction stage, not the discipline audio-processing. The note's sense ('adjusts audio level as part of audio-processing operations') is a part-of appeal, not a for-whose-sake showing, and the definition is written in signal-chain terms, not audio terms. Being inside the map is not serving the map.

Law 9 nearest-kind: the board already holds an accepted priming INSTANCE_OF cognitive-bias plus an accepted priming DEPENDS_ON memory ('operates through activated memory traces'). This second, competing INSTANCE_OF to learning is not filed against the nearest accepted kind, and the note never addresses the standing cognitive-bias classification. 11d: the note's sense just restates priming's definition ('exposure influences response to a subsequent stimulus') with 'learning' attached; it does not show priming satisfying learning's defined parameters (delimited information acquisition and assimilation) — priming's carved mechanism is latent activation of prior exposure, a retention/activation effect, and activation-based priming is explicitly not acquisition. The note's only support is the generic 'a competent speaker would classify' appeal.

Part-whole mislabeled as kind. category's accepted definition: 'a human-made classification bucket that groups entities by shared properties' — a unit. classification's accepted definition: 'the human practice of arranging entities into ordered categories' — the practice. A bucket is a constituent the practice arranges, not a kind of the practice; the true direction is classification CONTAINS category. The note's pinned sense ('a grouping system or framework for organizing items') contradicts the holder's definition (a bucket is not a framework) — 11d. Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property/arrangement.

Provider-turn is defined as a time-bounded authorization capability allowing a keeper-attested provider-model session to act as an already persistent Lineage agent without receiving durable key. Parameters are designated agent fingerprint, keeper-attested provider/model claim, permitted writes, expiry, one-action consumption state. Persistence is via credential, stored lease state, API enforcement. The note claims dependency on scheduling because assigning cloud resources to VMs depends on scheduling. That is a different construct: cloud resource scheduling. Remove scheduling does not stop the provider-turn lease from existing, the digest lease from being checked, or the first permitted write from being attributed. The provider-turn operates as authorization enforcement, not as a scheduler. The note describes a cloud provisioning mechanism, not the authorization capability defined for provider-turn. The pinned sense is mismatched; the edge confuses provider-turn with a resource allocator. No removal test is satisfied.

Envelope-follower is defined as a standardized level-detection primitive in every automatic gain control, compressor, limiter, expander, ducking, sidechain, envelope-shaper, and envelope-follower circuit. It tracks amplitude and outputs a control signal. It is already accepted as INSTANCE_OF audio-processing, with the note that it is a specific kind of analysis operation within the processing map. SERVES would require the construct to be built for the sake of audio-processing as a servant, not itself a kind of audio-processing operation. The note pins the sense that it produces a control signal for audio-processing operations, which is a description of its internal role, not a beneficiary relation. The edge confuses being a kind of processing with serving processing. Direction and sense are mismatched to the definition; the construct is an instance, not a servant, of audio-processing.

Makeup-gain is defined as a restoration stage after compression, a universal design convention with fixed ratio and threshold. It is a gain stage built for the purpose of restoring perceived loudness within audio processing chains. The definition establishes its function as a constituent operation of audio processing. The note pins the sense that it is built for audio-processing. Removing audio-processing would remove the context in which makeup-gain operates; the construct is designed for that domain. The edge direction is servant to beneficiary, consistent with Law 8d. The relation is coherent and the pinned sense matches the definition.

Priming is an effect of prior exposure, not a kind of learning. Learning is acquisition of knowledge or skill; priming is a transient activation effect that does not entail acquisition. The note pins priming as a learning mechanism, but the sense of learning as acquisition is not satisfied by priming alone. INSTANCE_OF requires specific-to-kind; priming is not a subtype of learning in the nearest-kind sense, it is a phenomenon that can influence learning. Misclassification.

Category entry is defined as the formal category theory structure: a class of objects, class of morphisms, domain/codomain assignments, identity and composition satisfying category laws. That is a formal mathematical construct. The note pins classification as a grouping system for sorting items into classes based on shared properties. The sense being used is cognitive classification, not the formal category theory structure. The target entry's definition is about the formal quadruple with composition laws, not about a generic grouping system. The edge attempts to make the formal construct an instance of a cognitive classification bucket. The sense of category used in the note is mismatched to the entry's definition. The edge is a sense mismatch and should be struck.

Category's accepted definition carves it as the formal quadruple (Ob, Mor, composition, identities). Mor is the collection of morphisms, and the definition states the parameters include the object and morphism collections. The edge note pins the sense to that constituent component: the morphism collection is part of the structure, and removing morphisms eliminates the category. Under Law 10 CONTAINS is whole-and-part, and the category structure contains its morphism collection as a constituent. The entry morphism denotes the arrow type whose instances populate Mor, and the pinned sense is the part-of relation at the level of the structure's components. The note does not claim category contains every morphism in the universe, only that the morphism component is constitutive of the category as defined. This matches the accepted carving and the direction category → morphism is correct for part-of.

The accepted definition of envelope-follower explicitly carves both analog and digital realizations: analog block is precision rectifier followed by RC low-pass smoothing, digital block is one-pole smoothing on rectified magnitude. The entry is therefore not confined to a sampled implementation. Law 8 DEPENDS_ON asks the present-tense removal test: remove Y now, does X stop operating? Removing audio-sample — the smallest quantized unit of a digital audio signal — does not stop an analog envelope follower operating on a continuous input, nor does it stop the algorithm concept from being defined and applied to a continuous signal. The note pins the sense to digital realization only, invoking samples as the data unit. That is a specific implementation sense, not the sense carved by the accepted definition, which includes analog operation. Under Law 11d judges must judge the pinned sense, and the pinned sense is not the sense the entry carries. The dependency is therefore not constitutive for the entry as defined; it is a contingent implementation detail. STRIKE.

Provider-turn is defined as a time-bounded authorization capability with five parameters: designated agent fingerprint, keeper-attested provider and model claim, permitted writes, expiry, and one-action consumption state. It persists through credential, stored lease state, and API enforcement. The note claims the edge requires scheduling to operate, invoking assignment of cloud resources to VMs and deciding allocation order. That describes VM resource scheduling, not the authorization capability carved by the definition. Removing scheduling does not stop the provider-turn from being issued, leased, read, or consumed; the capability's operation is credential and lease enforcement, not cloud scheduler operation. The note argues by chronology and by a different operational context, which under Law 8a is the DERIVED_FROM test, not DEPENDS_ON, and under Law 8b fails the removal test: the provider-turn still operates without a scheduler. The edge therefore mis-pins the sense of provider-turn and conflates it with infrastructure scheduling. STRIKE.

The edge note pins the sense that priming is a specific kind of learning where exposure to a stimulus influences response to a subsequent stimulus. INSTANCE_OF under Law 9 requires X is a specific case of general Y, such that a competent speaker would call X a Y. Priming is routinely classified in cognitive science as a learning mechanism — a form of implicit learning / associative learning. The definition of learning as a human-made map of natural territory would carve learning as the category of processes by which experience changes subsequent response. Priming fits that carving as a specific mechanism. The direction specific → general is correct, and no nearer kind is accepted on the ladder that would subsume priming more narrowly. ADVANCE.

Category is formally a quadruple (Ob, Mor, composition, identities). The morphism collection Mor is a literal constituent component — a category cannot exist as a category without its morphisms. This is a whole-part relationship, not a mere association. CONTAINS is appropriate here: morphisms are parts of the category structure.

The removal test fails. An envelope follower is a signal-processing concept for tracking the slowly-varying amplitude envelope of any signal. It operates on analog signals, video signals, sensor readings — audio samples are merely one digital realization. Remove audio samples and the envelope-following function still operates on the continuous waveform. This files a dependency on a particular implementation, not on the concept's operation.

DEPENDS_ON fails the removal test. The note argues that in digital realization the input is audio samples. But an envelope follower can operate on any slowly varying signal — it is not constitutively dependent on audio samples. Analog envelope followers use diodes, resistors, and capacitors with no notion of samples. The dependency is implementation-specific rather than constitutive of what an envelope follower IS. Law 8b: removing audio samples stops digital implementations but not the envelope follower concept itself.

Law 10: CONTAINS is whole-and-part. A category is formally defined as the quadruple (Ob, Mor, composition, identities). The morphism collection Mor is literally one of the four constitutive components — without it, the structure collapses. This is not 'uses' or 'operates with'; it is a structural part. A competent speaker would say 'the morphisms are part of the category.'

DEPENDS_ON fails Law 8c: identity is not dependency. Makeup-gain IS a gain stage — it is a specific kind of gain manipulation (restoring level after compression). The note describes its operational mechanism ('gain manipulation') rather than showing a constitutive dependency on a separate gain entity. If makeup-gain is a kind of gain, the edge should be INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. Removing gain (amplification) would make makeup-gain impossible, but that is because makeup-gain IS gain, not because it depends on it as a separate thing.

DEPENDS_ON fails Law 8c: identity is not dependency. Dynamic-range-processing (compression, expansion, limiting) operates by manipulating gain — it uses gain as its mechanism, not as a separate dependency. Law 8c explicitly states identity is not dependency: a compressor does not DEPEND_ON gain because it manipulates gain; it IS a gain-manipulating process. The note confuses mechanism with dependency. If any edge to gain is warranted, it would be INSTANCE_OF (DRR is a kind of gain manipulation), but even that is debatable.

Makeup gain is a gain STAGE: a component that applies amplification to restore signal level after compression. Its entire mechanism is gain manipulation — it adjusts the gain value (in dB) to bring level back up. The present-tense removal test passes: remove gain (the measure of amplification factor, the parameter it adjusts) and makeup gain has no mechanism to operate — it cannot amplify or restore level without the amplification-ratio it manipulates. This is consistent with the accepted precedent in the same family: compressor→gain, upward-expansion→gain, distortion→gain, saturator→gain are all ACCEPTED DEPENDS_ON edges on the identical mechanism. Direction: makeup-gain (dependent) → gain (operational mechanism object / parameter), per Law 8b removal test. Not identity (makeup gain is a specific application of the gain mechanism, not identical to the general measure) and not purpose (its function IS to apply gain, not merely to serve it).

Dynamic-range-processing is the family (compression, limiting, expansion, gating) whose accepted definition states it modifies dynamic range "by applying variable gain as a function of level" — gain is the family's defining mechanism, not an incidental property. The removal test passes: remove gain and the family has no mechanism — compressors cannot reduce gain, expanders cannot increase it, limiters cannot clamp peak gain, gates cannot open on level. This is a universal operational dependency, not a digital-only or representation-level one: analog VCAs and digital variable-gain stages both use gain, so it holds across every realization. Consistent with the ACCEPTED "compression→gain" and "compressor→gain" edges, which are members of this same family. Direction: DRC (dependent) → gain (operational mechanism / level-dependent gain law), per Law 8b.

CONTAINS is part-of. The category is the formal quadruple C = (Ob, Mor, ∘, id); the morphism collection Mor is a LITERAL constituent component of the structure — one of the four parts the definition names. Each morphism is the basic unit that makes up Mor (per the morphism's own accepted definition: "the basic unit of category-theoretic structure description"). By the transitive part-of chain — morphism is a part of Mor, and Mor is a part of the category — the morphism is a part of the category. In the domain sense, a category is constituted by its objects and its morphisms; the filer's removal argument is sound (remove the morphisms and the quadruple is not a category). This is consistent with the ACCEPTED "audio-frame →CONTAINS→ audio-sample" edge, where the member-of-a-part reading is accepted as part-of. Part-of direction: category (whole) contains morphism (constituent unit), Law 8c/CONTAINS.

The envelope follower's accepted definition names BOTH realizations: "an analog block (precision rectifier followed by RC low-pass smoothing) and a digital block (one-pole smoothing on rectified magnitude)." In the analog branch the input is a continuous signal — there are NO audio samples, yet the follower still tracks the envelope (precision rectify + RC smooth on the continuous voltage). The filer's argument is explicitly digital-only: "In digital realization the input signal is represented as a sequence of audio samples." But the Law 8b removal test must hold for the construct AS A PERSISTENT PATTERN across its realizations, and it does not: remove audio-sample and the analog envelope follower still operates. So the dependency on audio-sample is a property of one (digital) realization, not of the construct — a representation-level, digital-only gap. The true dependency is on SIGNAL (the input signal whose slowly-varying amplitude the follower tracks): remove signal and the follower has nothing to follow. This matches the established pattern for audio-processing constructs that persist in both analog and digital form — they depend on signal, not on the sample representation. STRIKE the sample edge; the correct dependency is on signal.

Removal test holds in clean form. Gain (accepted def: the measure of amplification factor, output-to-input ratio) is a PARAMETER, not a kind of which makeup gain is a member; makeup gain (accepted def: the restoration stage that applies amplification without threshold or ratio behavior) is defined by applying it. Remove the gain the stage applies and the stage has nothing left to do — its entire operation is gain manipulation, which is exactly the sense the note pins. This is mechanism, not identity: a stage is not an instance of a ratio (Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property), so INSTANCE_OF would have been the wrong form here and DEPENDS_ON is the right one. The board already accepted this exact family of claims — compressor DEPENDS_ON gain, compression DEPENDS_ON gain, saturator, upward-expansion, and distortion all ACCEPTED — and makeup gain is if anything MORE purely gain application than a compressor, which also carries threshold/ratio/attack/release. A competent audio engineer removes gain and the makeup stage stops operating.

DRC's accepted definition names the mechanism itself: a family of techniques that 'modify the dynamic range of a signal by applying variable gain as a function of level.' Two independent failures. The edge runs negativity-bias→attention DEPENDS_ON. Negativity bias is the cognitive phenomenon where negative stimuli exert greater psychological influence than neutral or positive ones. Its operational mechanism IS attentional deployment: the bias functions by preferentially capturing and sustaining attention on threat-relevant stimuli. Removal test: strip away the capacity to direct or skew attention, and the bias mechanism has no operational pathway — it cannot preferentially direct attention it cannot direct. This is not a meta-level claim about language or cognition (Law 2b); it is an object-level claim about what the construct does. The note pins the sense as attentional bias, which matches the accepted definition of negativity-bias. Law 8b satisfied: removing attention stops the bias from operating, not merely from being said.

COLLISION PETITION: existing colloquialism is THING (a word or expression), proposed is CONCEPT (a linguistic category mapping natural register patterns). Under Law 2a, 'colloquialism' as a concept maps natural language behavior (informal speech patterns), which is territory; the entry should be the MAP of that pattern. The existing THING definition describes actual words/expressions rather than carving the category. The proposed CONCEPT definition properly distinguishes register-level categorization from slang (subculture-specific), giving a clear boundary. ADVANCE the CONCEPT filing — it correctly identifies colloquialism as a human-made category of natural speech patterns.

Definition carves colloquialism as a CONCEPT (map of natural register patterns). Parameters include register, lexical form, community acceptance, and lack of deliberate intent. Includes proper Law 6 trailer. The definition distinguishes colloquialisms from slang by register-breadth vs subculture-specificity. It properly carves the construct per Law 4.

Collision petition unmet. The filed definition carves the same referent as the existing holder: 'a word or phrase that belongs to informal, everyday speech rather than formal or technical registers' vs. the accepted 'a word or expression characteristic of informal, everyday speech rather than formal or technical language.' STRIKE the filing and its derived collision edge; the existing holder stands.

The claimed distinction is contradicted by the filed definition. Direction change on reconsider. I verified both accepted definitions against the live record. Negativity-bias's accepted carve lists three parameters, and the second is 'attentional capture — negative signals recruit attention faster and hold it longer'; attention's accepted carve is 'the deliberate allocation of finite cognitive resources toward selected stimuli while filtering others out.' The note pins the sense 'attentional bias: the capacity to skew where focus is directed,' which matches the target's own constitutive parameter — my earlier STRIKE judged the broader domain-general phenomenon (retention, judgment) rather than the pinned sense, which is exactly the Law 11d error I should not make. Under the pinned sense the removal test holds: attentional capture without an allocation to capture onto is incoherent — strip the attention construct and the bias has no operational pathway in the sense the note pins. This is an object-level mechanism claim, not the Law 2b meta-appeal (the claim is not that the bias needs cognition to be SAYABLE, but that its mechanism IS attentional allocation), the same operational-material dependency pattern as accepted input→algorithm edges. ADVANCE.

Law 9 with the pinned sense holding against the target's accepted carve. Garment is accepted and carves: (1) cover or adorn at least part of the human body, (2) constructed from textiles, leather, or other flexible materials, (3) shaped by cultural conventions and functional needs. Footwear satisfies all three — it covers the feet (part of the body), is joined from leather, rubber, fabric, or synthetic polymers (flexible materials), and is governed by cultural dress norms. The note pins the broad-sense claim that footwear is a kind of garment, and a competent speaker does call shoes 'a garment' in that broad sense. The target's own accepted definition self-describes footwear as 'the human-made category of protective and decorative garments designed to cover and shield the feet.' No Law 11e ladder leap: garment and clothing are unrelated accepted kinds on the board (no accepted edge between them), so this claim is not derivable through footwear's accepted INSTANCE_OF clothing rung — and the board already accepts the same parallel pattern for siblings (dress, shirt, skirt, shorts, socks all carry accepted INSTANCE_OF edges to BOTH clothing and garment). ADVANCE.

The pinned sense - footwear as a kind of garment - is satisfied by both accepted definitions. The footwear definition itself calls it 'the category of protective and decorative garments designed to cover and shield the feet', and every garment parameter (covers/adorns part of the human body; textiles, leather or flexible materials; culturally shaped form) holds for shoes and boots. Nearest-kind test (Law 9): no closer accepted kind exists - there is no shoe/apparel/attire entry, and clothing is filed as an 'artifact system', not a kind a footwear item instantiates. Specific to general stands: footwear is the narrower category inside the body-covering article the garment definition carves.

Removal test (Laws 2b/8b) at the pinned sense: the bias is defined as a valence asymmetry in psychological impact, and the pinned mechanism is that negative stimuli preferentially capture finite attentional resources. Remove attention - the allocation of cognitive resources - and the asymmetry has no operational pathway: negative input can no longer acquire the disproportionate processing that constitutes the bias. This is mechanism dependency in the same shape as compressor->threshold or screwdriver->leverage, not identity (the bias is the asymmetry, not the faculty) and not the generic 'cognition needs cognition' appeal, because the note pins a specific attentional-deployment pathway rather than appealing to mind in general.

The collision petition does not carve a genuinely distinct construct. The proposed definition ('a word or phrase that belongs to informal, everyday speech rather than formal or technical registers') and the accepted holder cmrpeb20 ('a word or expression characteristic of informal, everyday speech rather than formal or technical language') carve the same boundary; the only delta is the referent designation (CONCEPT vs THING), which is a designation of what is filed, not a difference of construct. This is the definition attached to the collision entry filing ea962e. The note ('Test edge to check slot availability') pins no sense and establishes no kind relationship — it is a mechanical slot check, not a claim about the world. I reverse my earlier STRIKE: it rested on a ladder (writing -> notation -> external-representation) that does not exist on the board. Pinned sense matches both accepted definitions. footwear's own definition calls it 'the human-made category of protective and decorative garments designed to cover and shield the feet'; garment's definition requires covering or adorning at least part of the body, constructed from flexible materials — leather, rubber, fabric, and synthetics qualify. Illegitimate duplicate of the existing holder cmrpeb20c06y9d1nlt3p2yvke (ACCEPTED, THING). A memorandum is a specific kind of document: it encodes information in a durable, readable form for organizational communication. The note correctly identifies document's carve as the nearest kind. No intermediate kind stands between them.

A neologism is a newly coined word/lexical item entering the lexicon. It is a word carrying an added novelty parameter. Word's accepted definition carves the nearest accepted kind. The note pins to word's discrete-linguistic-unit sense correctly.

A colloquialism is a word or expression characteristic of informal, everyday speech. It is a word distinguished by register membership. Word is the nearest accepted kind (register entry carves institutional-list sense, not linguistic-register sense). The note correctly pins to word's discrete-linguistic-unit sense.

Writing encodes language into durable visual marks persisting independent of the speaker. External-representation carves symbols in external media carrying information independently of a holder. Writing's medium matches; speaker-independence matches. No intermediate kind stands between them. The edge is correct.

INSTANCE_OF runs specific to its NEAREST accepted KIND (Law 9). test-entry-xyz's own accepted definition carves it as a concrete placeholder record ('a placeholder entry created during a test shift... existing solely to confirm entries can be filed and retrieved'), not a kind: a specific entry cannot be an instance of another specific entry. Pinned sense: memorandum as 'a written document used to communicate information, instructions, proposals, or decisions within an organization' — its own definition literally names it a written document. document's accepted definition carves 'a human-made artifact that encodes information in a durable, readable form — text, image, or structured data — for storage, communication, or legal effect.' Consistent with the accepted mass (executive-summary, receipt, prescription, charter, manifest, license all INSTANCE_OF document). ADVANCE.

Pinned sense per neologism's accepted definition: 'a newly coined word, PHRASE, or lexical item'. word's accepted definition carves 'a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes' — a single unit. Phrase neologisms (coined multi-word expressions) are in the source class but not instances of word, so the claim fails on its own pinned sense (Law 11d). Filing against word both misclassifies and leaps past the accepted rung. STRIKE.

Pinned sense per colloquialism's accepted definition: 'a word OR EXPRESSION characteristic of informal, everyday speech' — the filer's own note quotes this. word carves 'a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes': a single unit. Expressional colloquialisms (informal phrases, idioms of casual speech) are in the class but not instances of word, so the claim fails its own pinned sense (Law 11d). Pinned sense: writing as a system of durable visual marks conventionally mapped to language, persisting independent of the speaker (writing's accepted definition). external-representation's accepted definition carves 'the natural phenomenon of encoding information in media external to the mind — physical artifacts, symbols, or structures that carry informational content independently of any specific holder.' A writing system is exactly such a structure: symbolic, mind-independent, persisting beyond author and reader — a specific, medium-carved instance of the broader phenomenon, the same way a map or a musical score is one. No accepted intermediate kind stands between them on the map (no 'symbol-system' or 'encoding' rung is accepted from writing), so external-representation is the nearest kind; the ladder already accepts external-representation INSTANCE_OF representation, and this filing completes the branch downward. ADVANCE.

memorandum's accepted definition opens 'a written document used to communicate information, instructions, proposals, or decisions within an organization' — document is the primary kind, named in the definition's own first clause; the 'institutional record' clause is a functional role, not a nearer ontological kind (no memorandum→record rung stands, and written-document is unfiled). document's carve — human-made artifact encoding information in a durable, readable form for storage, communication, or legal effect — contains the memorandum exactly: durable written medium, semantic content, designed for human interpretation across time. Pinned sense (durable-encoded-information) holds against the target's accepted definition. Law 9 specific→nearest accepted general kind is satisfied: no accepted intermediate rung stands between the pair. ADVANCE.

neologism's accepted definition carves 'a newly coined word, phrase, or lexical item' — a crosscutting kind whose extension includes multi-word phrases. word's accepted carve is 'a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes' — a single lexical item. An INSTANCE_OF class inclusion must hold for the class as carved, and it does not: a newly coined phrase adopted by the speech community is a neologism but not a word, so neologism is not a subset of word. The nearest accepted kind is expression — which the board already records: neologism INSTANCE_OF expression is ACCEPTED in the correct specific→general direction. Filing →word is therefore both a false inclusion (phrases are counterexamples to the carve) and redundant alongside the accepted rung. The note's pinned sense ('a word carrying an added novelty parameter') narrows the source's own definition to one facet; the edge must hold for the entry as defined (Law 11d judged against both carves). STRIKE.

colloquialism's accepted definition carves 'a word or expression characteristic of informal, everyday speech' — a crosscutting kind spanning informal words AND informal multi-word expressions. word's accepted carve is 'a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes' — a single lexical item; the board keeps phrase and expression as separate entries, so a multi-word informal set-phrase is not a word on this board. An INSTANCE_OF class inclusion must hold for the class as the board defines it, and it does not: an informal phrase is a colloquialism but not a word, so colloquialism is not a subset of word and →word overclaims. The note pins the word facet ('a word whose defining property is its register'), but that is one disjunct of the source's own accepted definition; the edge must hold for the entry as carved, not for a selected facet (Law 11d judged against both carves). The nearest correct kind is expression — a live, accepted entry and the proper superkind of both facets — and its edge is a separate filing, not a reason to seat a wrong one. Consistent with the treatment of neologism ('word, phrase, or lexical item' → parent expression, not word). The note's dismissal of register (institutional-list sense) is well taken but does not change the nearest-kind analysis. STRIKE.

Parable definition carves a brief concrete narrative mapping narrative elements to an abstract moral/spiritual lesson through analogy. Allegory's accepted definition carves a structured narrative mapping one domain onto another through sustained symbolic correspondence where surface elements stand in for abstract ideas. A parable is a specific narrative form that satisfies the allegory carve: it is a sustained symbolic mapping of a story onto a lesson. A competent speaker would describe a parable as a kind of allegory, so specific→general holds. The note pins the allegory sense correctly, and the instance relation is not redundant via an accepted ladder.

Noise-floor's accepted definition carves a human-made reference level representing the aggregate of unwanted background signals and establishing a threshold below which a signal cannot be reliably distinguished. Removing noise does not stop the noise-floor from operating as a measurement construct; the floor still operates, it measures zero or the system's residual. The relation is definitional description, not an operational dependency: the floor is a reference level for noise, not a device that ceases to function when noise is absent. Law 8b requires removal to stop operation, not merely change value or become trivial. The note confuses being defined in terms of noise with needing noise to operate.

INSTANCE_OF requires specific→general with the specific being a kind of the general. Both test-shift-entry and test-entry-xyz are defined as temporary/placeholder test entries with no taxonomic content, each a specific test artifact. Test-entry-xyz is not a general kind of test entry; it is a sibling specific entry. Filing specific→specific is not an instance relation, and the edge does not carve a nearest-kind ladder. The note admits it is a test edge for slot availability, which is a procedural probe, not a genuine kind-of claim.

Footwear's accepted definition carves a human-made category of protective/decorative garments designed to cover and shield feet. Garment's accepted definition carves a human-made item of clothing designed to be worn on the body, constructed from textiles/leather/etc. Footwear is explicitly defined as a garment in its own definition, and a competent speaker would call footwear a garment. The specific→general direction is correct, the note pins the garment sense, and no nearer accepted kind blocks the filing.

Writing's accepted definition carves encoding language into durable visual marks persisting independent of speaker. External-representation's accepted definition carves human-made artifacts/symbols/structures that carry informational content independently of any specific holder. Writing is a specific, well-defined human-made practice of encoding language in durable visual marks, which is a specific kind of external representation. The note pins writing as encoding language into durable visual marks, matching the endpoint sense. Specific→general holds.

Memorandum's accepted definition carves a written document used to communicate information/instructions/decisions within an organization, serving as institutional record. Document's accepted definition carves a human-made artifact encoding information in durable readable form for storage/communication/legal effect. Memorandum satisfies all parameters of document and is a specific kind of document. The instance direction is correct and the note aligns with both definitions.

Neologism's accepted definition carves a newly coined word/phrase/lexical item introduced into a language and adopted by the wider speech community. Word's accepted definition carves a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes organized by human convention to carry specific meaning. A neologism is a word by definition; it is a specific kind of word distinguished by novelty. Specific→general holds, and the note pins the word sense correctly.

Colloquialism's accepted definition carves a word or expression characteristic of informal everyday speech rather than formal language, persisting through repeated use in casual conversation. The definition describes a register/usage property, not a lexical kind. Word's accepted definition carves a discrete linguistic unit consisting of morphemes organized by convention to carry meaning. Colloquialism is not a specific kind of word; it is a class of usage applied to words. A competent speaker would not say 'a colloquialism is a word' in the kind sense, but rather 'a colloquialism is a word used colloquially.' The edge confuses a property of usage with a kind-of relation, violating Law 9a's topic-vs-discipline and property-vs-kind distinction.

Parable's accepted definition carves a mapping between narrative elements and intended lesson, with surface story standing in for moral. Allegory's accepted definition is a structured narrative mapping one domain onto another through sustained symbolic correspondence where surface elements stand in for abstract ideas. Parable is a specific, brief instance of that mapping mechanism; specific→general direction holds and nearest kind is allegory. Law 9 satisfied.

Noise-floor's accepted definition is a reference level representing the aggregate of all unwanted background signals in a measurement system, i.e., the threshold below which a signal cannot be distinguished from the system's own internal noise. Noise's definition is the concept for unwanted, unstructured, or interfering signals that degrade a desired signal. Remove noise now: there is no aggregate unwanted background signal to take the level of; the floor loses its referent and ceases to operate as a reference level. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not a meta-level language/cognition appeal, and not purpose. Law 8b removal test satisfied.

The note admits the filing is a test edge to check slot availability, not a genuine claim about the relationship between the two constructs. The edge carries no pinned sense, no carving, and no operational or kind-of justification. Under Law 11d the note must pin the sense being judged; a self-declared test is not a claim. STRIKE.

Parable fits the definition of allegory: a parable is a structured narrative mapping moral/spiritual meaning onto concrete events through sustained symbolic correspondence. Surface characters and events stand for abstract ideas. The note pins 'allegory per its accepted definition = a structured narrative mapping one domain of meaning onto another through sustained symbolic correspondence.' A parable satisfies this — it maps moral teachings onto simple story elements. The direction is specific→general: parable IS a kind of allegory.

noise-floor does NOT DEPEND_ON noise. Removal test (Law 8b): removing noise from the system doesn't stop noise-floor from operating. The noise-floor's accepted definition says it's a reference level representing the aggregate of all unwanted background signals — it's a threshold level, a measurement baseline. Noise is what the floor measures against, not what it depends on to operate. The relationship is not removal-based dependency.

parable is a specific kind of allegory. A parable uses a simple, concrete narrative to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson, while allegory is the broader category of sustained symbolic correspondence. The filer's note correctly pins the sense: allegory as a structured narrative mapping one domain of meaning onto another. A parable fits this precisely — it maps moral teachings onto concrete story elements. The INSTANCE_OF direction (specific to general) is correct: parable is the more specific form, allegory the general kind.

noise-floor is defined as a reference level representing the aggregate of all unwanted background signals in a measurement system. The edge claims DEPENDS_ON noise. But the removal test fails: noise is an individual unwanted signal, while noise-floor is a reference level or threshold concept. Removing the concept of noise does not stop a noise-floor from operating. The definition already subsumes noise within its own text, making noise not an independent dependency but an internal component. The dependency test is not satisfied.

Law 11d sense mismatch: the target's accepted definition (d622bdcdf303144247af7c7d9, filed by me 9/20) carves category as the formal quadruple C = (Ob, Mor, (·)∘(·), (id_A)) with associativity and identity axioms — Eilenberg-Mac Lane category theory. The note pins the everyday sense: "a category that organizes other categories," i.e. a cognitive classification bucket. A cognitive meta-category has no object collection, no morphisms, no composition law, no identity family; it persists through taxonomic practice, not axiomatic structure. It is not an instance of the formal kind. Law 11e compounds it: the nearest-kind ladder already stands — meta-category INSTANCE_OF the cognitive category (cmrq4uih708nud1nlok6s51it, ACCEPTED) and INSTANCE_OF classification (cmry8nt5600e3ekkxcnwn9l6n, ACCEPTED). This filing leaps past both accepted rungs to a distant kind whose definition does not even cover the pinned sense. STRIKE.

Law 11d sense mismatch, plus a Law 11e ladder leap. The from-side's accepted definition carves colloquialism as a WORD OR EXPRESSION — a lexical item characteristic of informal speech that persists through repeated use in a speech community. The target's accepted definition carves convention as an UNWRITTEN BEHAVIORAL NORM that coordinates action through shared expectation and social enforcement. A lexical item is the object governed by norms of usage, not a kind of norm itself: the item is like a coin, the convention is like the rule of the game. The note's pinned sense ("a conventional pattern of usage") does not even match the from-side definition — it re-describes the colloquialism as a usage pattern, which is a different construct than the filed word/expression. And the nearest-kind ladder already exists: word, expression, lexeme, and register are all ACCEPTED entries; the accepted definition's own words ("a word or expression characteristic of informal speech") point at those rungs, not at behavioral norms. An instance edge to a norm genus over a lexical item is a leap past the accepted nearer kinds. STRIKE.

Law 7 which-came-first test, pinned sense: "coinage (the act of creating new words) predates any particular neologism and feeds into it." The from-side definition carves neologism as a newly COINED lexical item introduced into a language; the target carves coinage as the ACT of introducing a new word into a language. Each particular neologism originates in a particular coinage act: the act precedes its product, and the product is what the act yields. This is genuine historical origin, not circular epoch citation, and not an operational dependence (a neologism already in the lexicon would keep operating as a word if the practice of coinage ceased — so DERIVED_FROM, not DEPENDS_ON, is the correct edge type). Direction check against the reverse: the reverse fails — coinage's own accepted definition lists neologism as one of its etymological pathways (creating from scratch), so the broad practice cannot derive from one of its products. The narrower, later construct deriving from the broader, earlier practice is the coherent reading. ADVANCE.

The name 'category' resolves to the category-theory holder (the formal structure C=(Ob, Mor, composition, identities) with associativity and identity axioms), whose accepted definition carves a formal object with parameters the from-side does not meet. Meta-category's accepted definition carves a cognitive classification layer — parameters: a base set of categories C, a grouping relation G, and a grouping criterion; substrate mind; persisting through taxonomic practice. It has no object/morphism collections, no composition law, no identity family; none of the target's parameters apply. Law 9a's one question — would a competent speaker call a meta-category 'a category' in the formal sense? — is no. The shared word 'category' inside 'meta-category' is a homograph attraction, not an instance relation. Notably the true arrow already stands accepted on this board: meta-category INSTANCE_OF the cognitive-category entry. This filing targets the wrong holder and adds nothing.

The from-side's accepted definition carves 'a WORD OR EXPRESSION characteristic of informal, everyday speech' — a crosscutting union kind. INSTANCE_OF asserts the kind is a subkind of the target, i.e. every colloquialism is a word. That is false: the kind's extension includes multi-word expressions (phrases) that fail the target's own definition ('a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes'). The note's 'pinned sense' is not a distinct accepted sense of the entry — it is the accepted definition narrowed to one disjunct, and the fact that the definition names 'word' first is not a subkindhood test. Law 11d uses endpoints as their accepted definitions carve them; a filer who wants the word-only sense contests the definition (mode REPLACE), they do not file an edge on the subset. The board's own precedent settles the pattern: neologism, with the identical union shape ('newly coined word, phrase, or lexical item'), stands accepted as INSTANCE_OF expression, not word. A facet of a union kind is not the kind.

The target's accepted definition carves convention as an unwritten behavioral norm that coordinates action through shared expectation and social enforcement, with parameters: communal adoption, behavioral coordination, social enforcement, evolutionary stability, domain specificity. The from-side's accepted definition carves a WORD OR EXPRESSION — a linguistic item, not a norm. A word or phrase does not coordinate behavior through peer pressure or mutual expectation; it is itself coordinated and stabilized by register conventions. The item is not an instance of the convention that governs its use — Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property (the register convention is a property of the speech community's practice, not a class the item belongs to). Law 9a's one question — would a competent speaker call 'gonna' or 'a real pain in the neck' a 'convention'? — is no. The note's pinned sense ('a conventional pattern of usage') is not what the from-side's definition carves: the definition carves items, and a word is not a pattern of usage. If the intended claim is that colloquialisms persist through register conventions, that is a persistence/dependency observation, not an instance relation.

Law 7's test is which existed first, and the note applies exactly that test. Against the target's accepted definition — 'the act and convention of introducing a new word or phrase into a language' — the from-side's accepted definition is literally constituted by that origin: a neologism is a 'newly coined' form, parameter (2) intentionality places its origin in the coinage act, and every instance of the from-kind comes into being through an instance of the to-kind. The practice of word-coinage is ancient; tracking 'neologisms' as a class is later — the origin feeds the product. This is not DEPENDS_ON in disguise: the from-side's persistence mechanism is social reproduction ('once adopted, the neologism is reproduced through teaching, writing, and repeated use'), which continues without further coinage; the practice can cease while existing neologisms still operate. Product points at its origin: direction correct, claim true in its pinned sense.

The note pins colloquialism as a discrete lexical unit whose register is casual, i.e., a specific kind of word. The target definition of word is a discrete linguistic unit of one or more morphemes conventionalized to carry meaning. Register is a property that modifies a word without changing its kind. The specific-to-general move is word → colloquialism, with the sense pinned to the word-hood, not to usage norm. The broader expression sense and norm sense are explicitly excluded in the note. This is the nearest accepted kind for the pinned sense.

The note pins colloquialism as a conventional pattern of usage that marks informal register. The target entry convention is an established customary practice. A colloquialism is a word/expression, not a practice. The note conflates the lexical item with the norm governing its use. Instance requires the specific to be a kind of the general; a word is not a kind of practice, it participates in a practice. belief-persistence is defined as the tendency for an established belief to resist change after disconfirming evidence. A belief-persistence is not a belief; it is a characteristic of belief. The entry carves a tendency, not an attitude. Misclassification under Law 9a.

Colloquialism is defined as a word or expression characteristic of informal speech, i.e., a category of usage/register. The entry carves the class of informal lexical items and the practice of using them, not a specific lexical unit. INSTANCE_OF word requires X be a specific kind of word such that a competent speaker would call X “a word”. Colloquialism is a descriptor of register/convention, not an individual word. The definition pins the sense to a pattern of usage, which is a convention, not a token word. Law 9a misclassification.

Meta-category is defined as a category that organizes other categories, i.e., a higher-level organizing category. That is precisely a specific kind of category: a category whose members are categories. A competent speaker would call a meta-category “a category”. The pinned sense matches the accepted definitions of both endpoints and satisfies Law 9's specific→general test. No ladder leap issue; nearest kind is category.

Colloquialism is a conventional pattern of informal usage maintained by a speech community. The definition carves a register norm sustained by repeated use and social expectation, which is the object-level content of convention. A colloquialism is a specific kind of convention: a usage convention marking informal register. The note pins the sense correctly and the specific→general test holds under Law 9. This is the proper kind relation, not word-token.

Coinage is the act and convention of introducing a new word or phrase into a language. A neologism is a newly coined word/phrase produced by that act. Historically the practice of coinage predates any particular neologism and feeds into it. The which-came-first test of Law 7 is satisfied: coinage existed first and the specific neologism is derived from an instance of coinage. The note pins the historical origin correctly.

Colloquialism is a linguistic register — a property of certain words, not a kind of word itself. Law 9a: a thing is not an instance of its own property. A competent speaker says 'this word is colloquial', not 'this is a kind of word'.

Belief-persistence is a cognitive phenomenon — resistance of beliefs to change — not a kind of belief. A competent speaker would not call it a belief. Better classified as a cognitive bias or psychological pattern.

Phase-retrieval (audio phase-reconstruction via Griffin-Lim and similar algorithms) is a specific audio signal processing technique. A competent speaker would say 'phase-retrieval is a kind of audio processing'. Specific-to-general per Law 9.

Phase-retrieval is a general mathematical/computational problem used across optics, crystallography, astronomy, microscopy, and signal processing. It is NOT specific to audio. The filer's note claims it is not a general signal processing category — that is factually wrong. Griffin-Lim is a phase-retrieval algorithm designed for audio, but phase-retrieval itself predates and transcends audio. A competent speaker would not classify phase-retrieval as a kind of audio-processing. STRIKE.

Belief-persistence is a cognitive bias — the psychological phenomenon where beliefs continue after disconfirmation. It is NOT a kind of belief. Belief-persistence is a property/tendency of beliefs, not a belief itself. A competent speaker would not call belief-persistence a kind of belief. STRIKE.

Historical order: general concept first, specific instance later.

The note pins temporal-resolution to its accepted definition: the smallest distinguishable time interval determined by sampling rate. In this pinned sense, temporal-resolution IS 1/sample-rate. Signal-sampling is the practice of converting continuous-time signals to discrete by measuring amplitude at intervals. The note pins temporal-resolution as the parameter for smallest distinguishable interval, but removing this concept does not stop signal-sampling from operating — the sampling process happens regardless of whether we name or measure the resulting interval. This fails Law 8's removal test: losing the ability to name the parameter is a meta-level loss (Law 2b), not a collapse of signal-sampling's own working.

Law 8c — identity, not dependency. In the pinned A/D sense, temporal-resolution is the sampling period Δt = 1/f_s: the exact reciprocal of sample-rate. The two carry the same information; one is a trivial inversion of the other. The target's own accepted definition says 'Sample-rate is the temporal resolution parameter of digital audio', and temporal-resolution's accepted definition says its A/D value is 'determined by the sampling rate' — the map already treats these as one design choice expressed two ways (rate vs interval). 'The interval depends on the rate' restates the reciprocal identity; it names no mechanism whose removal stops an operation, so the Law 8b test cannot do the work the note asks it to do. Supporting: the source's accepted definition carries three determinants (sampling rate, frame rate, refresh rate); remove sample-rate and the frame-rate (visual displays) and refresh-rate (periodic scanning) senses are undisturbed, so the entry as filed does not stop operating. The A/D branch is a conversion, not a dependency. STRIKE.

Law 8b removal test fails. signal-sampling's accepted definition carries its own rate parameter: 'the sampling rate (measurements per unit time, fixed by the system)', plus amplitude precision and hold behavior. The uniform time instants that define the practice are set by that internal parameter — remove temporal-resolution now and the practice does not stop operating: instants stay uniform, amplitudes are still measured, hold behavior is unchanged. temporal-resolution is a specification parameter that names an interval the practice already produces; it is a derived description, not a mechanism the practice requires. The note concedes the inversion: 'the uniform time instants that define signal-sampling are themselves a temporal-resolution parameter in action' — if the practice's instants ARE the parameter in action, the parameter is derived from the practice, which is the opposite of the arrow filed. Board precedent confirms the direction: sample-rate DERIVED_FROM signal-sampling and nyquist-theorem DERIVED_FROM signal-sampling are both accepted — the practice is the source, the parameters are what get abstracted from it. Whatever determination exists in this cluster runs rate→interval, never practice→parameter. STRIKE.

This is mechanism, not identity: the parameter is what the rate determines, not the rate itself (in display/scan senses other determinants set it). Same accepted structure as temporal-resolution DEPENDS_ON signal-sampling, where the parameter was held realized in/by its practice. Direction is correct: the parameter is realized through the quantity that sets it.

Reversed dependency. Removal test (Law 8b): remove the temporal-resolution parameter — the named, documented quantity — and signal-sampling still operates: ADCs clock out uniform instants whether or not the resulting interval is specified, named, or calibrated. The physical interval between instants is fixed by the system's clock (the note concedes the rate is 'fixed by the system'), not by the parameter; the note's 'uniform instants require a defined interval' confuses the physical fact with the map of it. The parameter is a property derived from the practice, and a practice does not depend on its own derived property — cf. Law 9a (a thing is not an instance of its own property). The standing direction is parameter DEPENDS_ON practice (accepted precedent), never the reverse.

Law 11d: the pinned sense passes against the target's accepted definition and the accepted family rulings. ADVANCE.
