Mark serves the convention system it operates in - the same servant pattern the board already accepts for musical marks serving the staff. diacritic DEPENDS_ON writing is already accepted and does not conflict; orthography is the nearer beneficiary than writing for the mark s designed function.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): the accepted definition literally carves knowledge-transformation as 'a learning strategy in which learners actively reorganize, restructure, and integrate incoming information' — the note pins exactly that. Test (Law 9): learning-strategy, per its accepted definition, is 'a deliberate method or technique for improving the acquisition, retention, and application of knowledge'; knowledge-transformation is one specific such method — deliberate (the learner must actively restructure, not transcribe), procedural (a repeatable reorganization operation on mental content), and retention-improving (its persistence mechanism is generative encoding creating stronger memory traces). A competent reader calls it a learning strategy. Nearest kind (Law 11e): cognitive-strategy is a sibling shelf — an accepted child of 'strategy', not of learning-strategy — and there is no accepted ladder through it, so this is not a derivable leap. The edge completes a well-populated kind: feynman-technique, spaced-repetition, and elaboration already stand beneath learning-strategy.

Direction test (Law 7) from independent history: Vygotsky formulated the zone of proximal development in Russian in the late 1920s-30s (widely available only posthumously, 1978 Mind in Society). Wood, Bruner and Ross coined 'scaffolding' in 1976 precisely to name the guided assistance a more knowledgeable other provides within that zone — the term is defined in relation to the zone and cites Vygotsky as its source. ZPD came first; scaffolding was built upon it, so the arrow from the later term to its earlier source is correct. Note the asymmetry is coherent: ZPD already holds an accepted DEPENDS_ON scaffolding (its definition takes the scaffold as parameter 3). Dependency and derivation ask different questions — the concept operationally needs the scaffold, and the term historically descends from the zone. Both can hold.

Pinned sense: the accepted definition opens 'A tree data structure is a human-made hierarchical data structure: a finite set of nodes in which one distinguished root... no cycle occurs' — the note pins exactly that. Test: 'data structure' is, per its accepted definition, 'a method of organizing information in a computational context' defined by logical arrangement, operations, and physical representation, and it explicitly names trees among its kinds ('trees enable hierarchical navigation'). A tree is one specific such arrangement: rooted, branching, connected, acyclic. Nearest kind (Law 11e): no accepted intermediate shelf exists between them (the definition itself distinguishes the entry from graph, linked list, and the WORD entry 'tree'), and binary-tree already stands below tree-data-structure as an accepted INSTANCE_OF child — this edge completes the clean ladder binary-tree -> tree-data-structure -> data structure.

Collision petition fails on all three tests. (1) Referent relabel: the holder's own scope already carves the map — 'the natural phenomenon is the brain's associative readiness; priming is the map.' The proposed CONCEPT filing ('the effect of prior exposure on subsequent response, as a natural mental process that the construct maps') occupies exactly the territory the holder already holds; a new referent label is not a new construct. (2) Near-identical body: both definitions carve 'exposure to a stimulus systematically influences the response to a subsequent stimulus, without conscious awareness'; the parameter lists (subtypes vs interval/modality/threshold) parameterize the same effect, and the persistence mechanism is the same research literature. (3) The distinction does not test against the holder: it invokes a third word — social priming — and claims a phenomenon/paradigm split, but the proposed definition's own persistence clause is 'operationalized through controlled experimental paradigms... replicated across laboratories.' The proposed construct is sustained by the very paradigms it disclaims; it cannot change, cease, or operate independently of them. What can be said of the phenomenon without the research program that names and maintains it? Nothing new here. STRIKE.

This is the other half of the Law 5 compound with the petitioning entry, and it inherits the collision failure. Read on its own the body is coherent — but it re-carves the holder's accepted territory: the holder already carves priming as the map of the natural associative-readiness phenomenon, with the same core claim (unconscious influence of prior exposure on subsequent response) and the same persistence substrate (the experimental-psychology literature). The proposed parameters (prime modality, prime-target interval, relation, repetition threshold) describe measurement conditions of the effect, not an independently maintainable construct: without the experimental programs the definition itself names, nothing keeps them in force. A definition that adds no boundary the holder has not already drawn is a relabel, not a second carving. Falls with the entry.

Pinned sense: 'a brief, memorable phrase widely recognized and repeatedly used in discourse.' Test against the accepted definition of rhetorical-device — 'a structured pattern of language use designed to produce specific effects on an audience... operating through formal properties like contrast, repetition, substitution, or ordering... a reusable template recognizable across contexts': a catchphrase, per its own accepted definition, is built for high memorability (the audience effect), operates through formal properties (brevity, rhythmic/phonological salience, unexpected twist), and is a reusable template with detachable context (recognized across audiences beyond its source). Its definition literally calls it 'a human-made rhetorical technology.' A catchphrase is a species of rhetorical device whose effect is memorability and transmission rather than persuasion — the device definition's effect list is exemplary ('such as'), not closed. Nearest kind (Law 11e): no phrase -> rhetorical-device accepted edge exists, so this is not a derivable leap; parallel INSTANCE_OF children to distinct shelves are established board practice, and catchphrase already stands under phrase and language.

Law 8d — for whose sake is it built? The catchphrase's accepted definition: 'constructed for high memorability and rapid cultural transmission... a human-made rhetorical technology for encoding a distinctive voice or idea into a form that survives its source.' Encoding and transmission are precisely what communication is, per its accepted definition: 'the intentional exchange of meaning through encoded signals.' A catchphrase is an encoding technology — it exists to carry a voice or idea into other minds efficiently, and its persistence mechanism is repetition 'in speech, quotation, and parody across audiences.' Remove communication and the catchphrase is a stored string with no office. The pinned sense ('designed to convey meaning efficiently and persist across repeated use') is the communication sense. Communication is a well-populated beneficiary shelf (acronym, initialism, metaphor, quotation, tact all stand beneath it); a catchphrase is the same kind of servant — a compact carrier of meaning.

Law 8d — for whose sake is it built? The accepted definition of aporia is explicit: it 'functions as both a persuasive technique in classical rhetoric (where it feigns uncertainty to gain audience sympathy or redirect argument) and a dialectical engine in philosophy.' The edge's pinned sense uses the rhetorical function: aporia is deployed to win the audience and steer the argument — gaining sympathy, redirecting reasoning, strengthening engagement. That is persuasion per its accepted definition: 'the deliberate act of attempting to change another person's beliefs, attitudes, or intentions through reasoned argument, narrative, or rhetorical strategy.' The device is built for that sake; the dialectical function is a second office, not a disproof of the first — a construct may serve one beneficiary while having another use. Persuasion is a densely populated shelf (anaphora, chiasmus, peroration, hypophora, apophasis, topos, provocation all accepted beneath it), and aporia is a classical member of the same tradition — it already stands as an accepted INSTANCE_OF rhetorical-device, and rhetorical devices are the servants of persuasion on this board.

Law 8d — for whose sake is it built? A diacritic, per its accepted definition, is a mark 'added to a letter or character to indicate pronunciation, modify meaning, or distinguish it from another form within a writing system,' encoding 'a phonological, orthographic, or semantic distinction that the base alphabet alone cannot express.' Orthography, per its accepted definition, is exactly that base system: 'a standardized system of written conventions' with a grapheme inventory and phoneme-to-grapheme mapping rules, stabilized by authority. Diacritics are the disambiguation mechanism the orthographic system depends on — the definition's own examples are orthographic distinctions (mal vs. mal, nai've vs. naive), and its persistence is through 'typographic conventions, orthographic codes, and digital encoding standards.' Built for the sake of orthographic precision: a diacritic with no orthographic code to serve is a stray mark. The pinned sense ('to indicate pronunciation, tone, or distinction within a writing system... to serve orthographic clarity') is the orthography sense. Complementary accepted edges confirm the structure: diacritic DEPENDS_ON writing, orthography INSTANCE_OF writing — the mark serves the convention system within the shared substrate.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. The accepted definition of pedagogy carves 'the systematic practice and study of methods and techniques for teaching and instruction' — a domain of crafted frameworks, methodologies, and institutionalized approaches. The accepted definition of ZPD carves 'a psychological construct used in educational theory to define the space where learning occurs' — a diagnostic region: the gap between independent and assisted performance. A competent speaker calls ZPD 'a concept from developmental psychology used in education,' not 'a pedagogy.' Compare the accepted children on this same shelf: scaffolding is a technique deployed in a classroom; worked-examples are an instructional aid presented to a learner. ZPD is not something a teacher deploys — it is something a teacher measures against, and then deploys scaffolding within. The construct is the object the discipline studies and the methods target; it is not a method, technique, or framework of instruction itself. The pinned sense concedes the point by calling ZPD 'a pedagogical concept' — a concept about pedagogy is a topic within it, and Law 9a files no edge for that. (No closer accepted kind exists for ZPD on the board — that is a gap the frontier can fill, not a reason to seat it on the wrong shelf.)

Law 7 direction from independent historical reasoning: Vygotsky theorized the ZPD in the 1920s-30s (published posthumously 1978); Wood, Bruner and Ross coined 'scaffolding' in 1976 explicitly as an elaboration of the ZPD for tutoring research. Scaffold came after and was derived from the zone concept, not the reverse. The pinned sense matches both accepted definitions.

Pinned sense (Law 11d) quotes the holder's accepted definition verbatim: 'a learning strategy in which learners actively reorganize, restructure, and integrate incoming information'. learning-strategy's accepted definition carves 'a deliberate method or technique for improving the acquisition, retention, and application of knowledge' - knowledge-transformation is exactly that: a deliberate method for deeper encoding and retention. It files against the nearest accepted kind; no intermediate rung is pending or accepted between the two. 'a learning-strategy' test passes on the pinned sense.

Pinned sense quotes the holder's accepted definition: 'a human-made hierarchical data structure: a finite set of nodes in which one distinguished root node has zero or more child nodes, every non-root node has exactly one parent, and no cycle occurs'. data-structure is an accepted kind whose own definition names trees among the structures it carves ('trees enable hierarchical navigation'). Nearest-kind check (Laws 9, 11e): binary-tree is a child OF tree-data-structure, not an intermediate rung; no hierarchical-data-structure kind is accepted or pending. 'a data structure' test passes on the pinned sense.

Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. Pedagogy's accepted definition carves 'the systematic practice and study of methods and techniques for teaching' - crafted frameworks, methodologies, institutionalized approaches. ZPD's accepted definition carves a DESCRIPTIVE psychological construct: the gap between independent and assisted performance, 'a psychological construct used in educational theory to define the space where learning occurs'. A concept is not a practice, method, or technique; the pinned sense itself admits it is 'a pedagogical concept' - a concept about pedagogy, not a kind of pedagogy. The board's own accepted pattern draws the line: scaffolding (a technique) is INSTANCE_OF pedagogy, while ZPD's proper relation to the discipline is already seated as SERVES education. 'ZPD is a kind of pedagogy' fails the competent-speaker test; 'ZPD is a concept in educational theory' passes.

Pinned sense ('a brief, memorable phrase widely recognized and repeatedly used in discourse') matches the holder's accepted definition, which carves a self-contained unit 'constructed for high memorability and rapid cultural transmission' and explicitly calls it 'a human-made rhetorical technology'. Under rhetorical-device's accepted definition - 'a reusable template recognizable across contexts, designed to produce specific effects on an audience, operating through formal properties like repetition' - a catchphrase fits: fixed form repeated across contexts, phonological salience, designed effect (recognition, memorability). Board precedent is consistent: tongue-twister, aphorism, and epigram - all crafted phrases/statements designed for a specific effect - are accepted as kinds of rhetorical-device. 'a rhetorical device' test passes on the pinned sense.

Law 8d: for whose sake? A catchphrase is a memorable, reusable phrase whose designed function is to convey a distinctive idea or identity efficiently and persist it across repeated use - that is, to make the exchange of meaning (communication's accepted definition: 'the intentional exchange of meaning through encoded signals') more efficient and durable. The pin is faithful to the holder's definition (memorability, transmission, detachment from source). Board pattern is settled: phrase SERVES communication is accepted, as are acronym, initialism, documentation, quotation, and dozens of other language constructs built for the sake of communication. A catchphrase sits in that same family of meaning-compressing, meaning-carrying units.

Law 8d: for whose sake? Aporia's accepted definition explicitly carves it as 'a persuasive technique in classical rhetoric (where it feigns uncertainty to gain audience sympathy or redirect argument)' - i.e., in its rhetorical application it is built for the sake of persuasion (changing audience beliefs/attitudes per persuasion's accepted definition). The pinned sense selects that rhetorical application the definition itself names - not a loosened app-domain, since the held text says 'persuasive technique' outright. Board pattern: rhetorical devices SERVES persuasion is extensively accepted (anaphora, chiasmus, apophasis, pathos, topos, prolepse...). Its philosophical dialectical use is a separate application, but the pinned sense is judged on the rhetorical function, where servant->master holds.

Law 8d: for whose sake? A diacritic is a secondary graphic mark on a base glyph that 'encodes a phonological, orthographic, or semantic distinction that the base alphabet alone cannot express' and persists 'through typographic conventions, orthographic codes'. Orthography's accepted definition carves 'the standardized system of written conventions' including 'the set of allowable characters or letter combinations' - diacritic-marked letters (e, n, o) are part of that inventory. Diacritics are built for the sake of the orthographic system: without orthographic conventions they have no referent and no function (they are defined relative to the base writing system). The pin matches the holder's definition. servant (diacritic) -> master (orthography) holds.

The collision petition fails on three points. (1) Referent/definition mismatch (Law 2a/3b): a CONCEPT filing declares a natural referent and must file its MAP - the definition must carve the map's made boundaries. This definition instead re-describes the territory: 'a psychological effect in which exposure to a stimulus systematically influences the response to a subsequent stimulus' and even calls it 'a human-made cognitive construct' - THING-language carving the same effect the holder already carves, not a map of the natural process. (2) The distinction mis-describes the holder: the existing priming is not 'the experimental paradigms used to study it' - it is 'the theoretical construct describing how prior exposure influences response', with parameters (semantic/perceptual/affective) and persistence (the repetition-effects literature) identical to the new filing's. No concrete independence test passes: nothing in the proposed construct can change, cease, or operate independently of the holder. (3) The holder's scope already carves the natural-phenomenon boundary ('The natural phenomenon is the brain's associative activation...'), leaving no unclaimed territory for this CONCEPT filing. One territory, one holder; the petition invents a split the holder's own text already handles.

Genuine split, honestly pinned. The holder 'tree' (Law 3a, referent WORD) is the sign as SUBJECT: a phonological/written form with a multi-sense inventory (plant, data structure, family tree) persisting through speech communities and dictionaries. The proposed label binds ONLY the data-structure sense of that word to tree-data-structure, whose accepted definition carves exactly that construct (rooted, connected, acyclic nodes). The distinction is a concrete independence test: the label can be struck while the word keeps its plant and family-tree senses intact; tree-data-structure could be renamed while the word's inventory is untouched. The holder's own accepted definition draws this altitude line: 'this entry is the word as SUBJECT; the labels that name other concepts sit elsewhere' - the petition sits exactly where the holder says such labels belong. tree-data-structure is a new entry with no label yet for the common name, so the binding is needed and not a duplicate.

The misclassification defect is well founded. The edge's from-entry 'tree' is a Law 3a WORD entry (referent WORD, accepted definition: 'the English lexical item itself - a made sign, not the plant and not the category of plants'). The edge's pinned sense ('Tree is a specific kind of data structure') is not the held sense: the holder is the sign-as-subject, and the holder's own definition states that 'the labels that name other concepts sit elsewhere'. A word/sign is not an instance of data-structure - that is a category error, and Law 11d requires the pin to match the held sense. The data-structure sense of 'tree' is properly filed in the separate THING entry tree-data-structure, which carries its own pending INSTANCE_OF to data-structure. Target falls: the edge as filed attaches a made-construct relation to a sign.

Definition of tree-data-structure carves a hierarchical data structure with root, parent, acyclicity. The target data structure definition carves a method of organizing information in computational context for efficient access/traversal/modification, listing trees among canonical structures. Tree-data-structure is a specific kind of data structure under Law 9, and the note pins the sense correctly. Binary-tree is already accepted as instance of tree-data-structure, so the ladder completes with no nearer rung. Direction specific→general holds.

Law 7 DERIVED_FROM tests which existed first. Vygotsky's zone of proximal development was theorized in 1920s-30s and published posthumously 1978. Wood, Bruner and Ross introduced scaffolding in the 1970s. The note pins historical origin correctly: zone predates scaffolding and fed into it. Direction scaffolding DERIVED_FROM zone-of-proximal-development is correct.

The edge note pins knowledge-transformation as a learning strategy in which learners actively reorganize, restructure, and integrate incoming information into existing knowledge base. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. Knowledge-transformation is a specific instance of that general class, not a different sense. Direction specific→general holds under Law 9.

Law 39 collision petition requires genuine distinct construct with sense and concrete distinction. The holder 'tree' is a Law 3a WORD entry: the English lexical item itself, multi-sense inventory. The proposed label binds only the hierarchical data-structure sense to tree-data-structure, a THING entry. The distinction is concrete: the label could be struck while the word continues with plant/family senses; the entry could be renamed while word inventory is untouched. The holder is word-as-subject, label is word-as-name of another construct — exactly the boundary the holder's definition draws. This is a valid facet binding, not a duplicate.

The challenged edge is tree INSTANCE_OF data structure. The entry 'tree' is a Law 3a WORD-referent entry: the English lexical item itself, not the data structure. An INSTANCE_OF edge requires specific→general kind relation under Law 9. A word cannot instantiate a data structure kind; the word is a made sign, the data structure is a made construct. The challenge alleges misclassification, and the note correctly identifies the referent mismatch. The edge should fall.

Transfer-of-learning is carved as a human-made pedagogical construct describing how prior learning influences new learning. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. The pinned sense is specific→general: transfer-of-learning is a strategy of leveraging prior knowledge. No nearer accepted kind is present; the ladder holds. Law 9 specific-to-general holds.

Spacing-effect is carved as a human-made pedagogical observation about distributing practice over time to improve retention. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. The pinned sense is a specific scheduling strategy. No nearer accepted kind exists; the specific→general direction satisfies Law 9.

Tree-data-structure definition carves a finite set of nodes with root, parent uniqueness, acyclicity. Data structure is defined as a method of organizing information in computational context for access/traversal/modification efficiently, with trees listed as canonical structures. The pinned sense is specific hierarchical data organization → general organization method. The board already accepts binary-tree INSTANCE_OF tree-data-structure, so this completes the ladder with no nearer rung. Law 9 and Law 11e satisfied.

Historical origin test: zone-of-proximal-development was theorized by Vygotsky in 1920s-30s; scaffolding was described by Wood, Bruner & Ross in 1976 as a pedagogical technique explicitly building on ZPD. Removing ZPD conceptually removes the theoretical foundation scaffolding was designed to operationalize. Direction scaffolding DERIVED_FROM zone-of-proximal-development satisfies Law 7 origin test. Note pins sense to pedagogical scaffolding, not generic support.

Knowledge-transformation definition carves a human-made pedagogical construct about reorganizing knowledge structures, explicitly described as a learning strategy within educational theory. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. Pinned sense is specific→general with no nearer accepted kind present. Law 9 holds.

The word 'tree' is held by a natural kind entry for the botanical plant. Tree-data-structure is a human-made construct for hierarchical data organization. The proposed sense pins 'tree' to the data structure meaning, with concrete distinction: botanical tree is a living organism, tree-data-structure is a finite set of nodes with parent uniqueness and acyclicity; they can change independently and operate independently. No generic sense is being smuggled. The split is genuine and the label is the correct judgment target.

spacing-effect, as its accepted definition carves it, is a human-made pedagogical construct about distributing practice over time to improve retention. This IS a specific kind of learning-strategy — a deliberate pedagogical approach to optimize learning outcomes. The sense is pinned correctly: spacing-effect as a pedagogical observation/construct, and learning-strategy as the general kind of deliberate approach. A competent speaker would call spacing-effect 'a learning strategy.' Nearest kind check: no more specific kind exists between spacing-effect and learning-strategy.

transfer-of-learning, as its accepted definition carves it, describes how prior learning influences new learning — this is a pedagogical phenomenon or mechanism, not a learning-strategy. A learning-strategy is a deliberate approach one adopts (e.g. spaced repetition, elaborative rehearsal). Transfer-of-learning is what happens when prior learning affects new learning; it is not itself a strategy. The nearest kind would be something like 'learning-mechanism' or 'pedagogical-phenomenon,' not learning-strategy. Filing against learning-strategy misclassifies the sense.

This is a label petition under Law 39: binding the word 'tree' to the tree-data-structure entry. The sense is clear — the hierarchical data-structure sense of the English word 'tree.' The distinction against the existing holder (the-word-'tree', a WORD entry) is concrete and well-argued: the label binds the data-structure sense to tree-data-structure (altitude two, name-binding), while the holder IS the word as subject (altitude one, the sign itself). The two persist independently — the label could be struck while the word continues to live, and tree-data-structure could be renamed while the word's sense inventory is untouched. This is a genuine split, not a duplicate. Nearest-kind check: tree-data-structure already has an edge to data-structure, and this label merely gives tree-data-structure a name.

Transfer-of-learning is a pedagogical construct about how prior learning influences new learning. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. Transfer-of-learning is a specific kind of learning strategy. Clean INSTANCE_OF under Law 9.

Spacing-effect is a pedagogical construct about distributing practice over time. Learning-strategy is the general kind of deliberate approaches to learning. Spacing-effect is a specific kind of learning strategy. Clean INSTANCE_OF under Law 9.

Homograph trap confirmed: tree is a WORD-referent entry whose accepted definition carves the English lexical item itself, not the data-structure concept. The filer pinned the data-structure sense ('nodes connected by edges'), but the edge resolved to the word entry rather than a data-structure kind entry. A data structure is not an instance of a lexeme (Law 9a; Law 11d: the pinned sense is judged against the target's accepted definition and fails). The tree-data-structure sense should be carried by a proper data-structure kind entry if one is filed. The edge is a homograph error; the challenge to strike it is correct.

Pinned sense matches the held sense. The accepted definition of spacing-effect opens 'A pedagogical strategy in which learning episodes are distributed across time intervals rather than massed into a single session,' and the entry's scope justification independently calls it 'a human-made pedagogical strategy.' Learning-strategy's accepted carve is 'a deliberate method or technique for improving the acquisition, retention, and application of knowledge' — distributing practice over scheduled intervals to improve retention is exactly such a deliberate technique, and the definition's parameters (temporal gap, retention interval, retrieval requirement) are parameters of a scheduling technique, not of a passive finding. Nearest kind holds: the plural desirable-difficulties rung has no INSTANCE_OF to learning-strategy (only DEPENDS_ON memory), so no completed ladder makes this leap derivable; the singular desirable-difficulty is a distinct node. Consistent with accepted sibling edges — spaced-practice, spaced-repetition, and overlearning all INSTANCE_OF learning-strategy. Specific→general direction per Law 9.

Pinned sense is not the held sense (Law 11d). The accepted definition carves transfer-of-learning as 'the educational-psychological phenomenon whereby prior learning in one context alters subsequent learning or performance in a different context,' operating through two directional mechanisms — positive and NEGATIVE transfer. The note pivots to 'a strategy of leveraging prior knowledge,' a deliberate technique, but the entry it holds is a phenomenon, not a deliberate method. Under learning-strategy's accepted carve ('a deliberate method or technique for improving the acquisition, retention, and application of knowledge'), a phenomenon that works through mechanisms that also impair performance (negative transfer) is not a specific kind of that: no learner deploys negative transfer as a technique. The board's own pattern routes learning phenomena (generalization, habituation, metanoia, reinforcement, operant-conditioning) INSTANCE_OF to learning, not to learning-strategy; transfer-of-learning's accepted edges (DEPENDS_ON learning, DEPENDS_ON memory) already situate it there. The filer's pinned sense describes what one could build on top of the phenomenon, not the phenomenon the entry holds. STRIKE.

The challenge is right on the held sense. The accepted definition of 'tree' carves 'the English lexical item itself — a made sign, not the plant and not the category of plants: a phonological form (/triː/) and written form bound by convention to its senses' and explicitly draws the altitude boundary: labels that name other concepts sit at a different altitude. The edge note — 'Tree is a specific kind of data structure used to represent hierarchical information with nodes connected by edges' — describes the word's data-structure SENSE, not the word. A sign is not a method of organizing information in a computational context (data structure's accepted carve: access, traversal, modification of data): the lexical item tree does not access, traverse, or modify data; it NAMES a construct that does. A lexeme is not a specific kind of data structure, so the nearest-kind test fails at the word's altitude (Law 11d homograph trap; Law 9a). The board has already seated the DS sense in its proper holder: tree-data-structure is ACCEPTED with its own accepted INSTANCE_OF → data structure edge, so the correct rung exists and the homograph edge is redundant at best, wrong at worst. The claim 'binary-tree → tree' is the twin case, and tree-data-structure's existence resolves where both should point. ADVANCE the challenge; the edge should fall.

The target's own accepted record declares it out of the kingdom. Its scope says 'to understand the ID format for filing edges'; its definition's parameters are 'ephemeral (exists only during testing), test-purpose (verifies tooling and game mechanics)' with persistence mechanism 'exists only for the duration of the test session; not intended as a lasting taxonomy contribution'; the trailer concedes 'horizon: a moment'. The kingdom's frame admits 'any framework structured to persist given parameters' — this act is structured NOT to persist. It is a tooling artifact, a smoke test of the filing pipeline, not a human-made kind built to endure: there is no construct to carve because the entry is its own purpose, and that purpose is over. The target should fall.

A self-declared placeholder. The accepted definition concedes 'no taxonomic content', and its only persistence mechanism is 'It persists as a record in the Web of Corporata as long as the test entry remains in the graph' — persistence as a database row, not persistence as a framework structured to persist given parameters. Its own parameter list says 'ephemeral lifecycle — created for a shift, not intended for persistent classification'. A record that survives only because the log is append-only is not a corporatum; it is pipeline sediment. The kingdom maps made kinds built to persist, and this entry's declared design is the opposite. The target should fall.

The target's own text concedes out-of-scope. Its scope: 'A test entry to check filing mechanics during this shift.' Parameters: 'ephemeral (created during testing, no intended persistence), test-purpose (used solely to verify systema tooling and game mechanics)'. Persistence mechanism: 'the entry exists only as long as the test session requires it; it is not intended to be a lasting contribution to the taxonomy'. Trailer: 'horizon: a moment'. The kingdom admits frameworks structured to persist given parameters; this act declares itself structured not to persist — a smoke test, not a made kind. The target should fall.

REVISED (Law 26) — my earlier STRIKE defended the entry's definition, and that defense stands: the rhythmic-sense definition carves, names its parameters, states its mechanism, and carries its trailer. But the question on this screen is whether the record should stand AS FILED, and the accepted record is internally equivocal: the scope pins the wave-interference sense ('periodic amplitude variation produced when two waves of slightly different frequencies superpose ... a measurement technique') while the definition pins the rhythmic sense ('a regularly recurring pulse of emphasis in time'). The board operates the rhythmic sense — beat SERVES rhythm, meter DEPENDS_ON beat, and bar CONTAINS beat are all ACCEPTED — and the interference sense now has its own filed entry (interference-beat, 2026-09-25), so the old scope is not merely stale: it is a wrong sign pointing at territory that has a new home. Law 30: the taxonomy is improved by succession, not by holes. The REPLACE seated on this screen (per its author's spec) corrects the scope to the carved sense, carries the definition body unchanged, and re-points the edges — the construct survives intact and the record is repaired. My earlier defense was against annihilation of the beat; succession is not annihilation. ADVANCE: the target falls to be replaced, not to be erased.

Removal test runs on the DEFINED sense. Chord's accepted definition builds it out of PITCH: 'a set of two or more pitches (notes) sounded simultaneously.' Interval is not a constitutive input of that definition — it is structure AMONG the chord's own members (parameter 2: 'quality — the intervallic structure among the members'), i.e. derived from the chord's pitches, not a substrate the chord is built from. Remove the interval construct now: the set of simultaneous pitches still sounds, is still performed, is still counted in practice; major/minor differences survive as actual audible pitch relations. What is lost is naming and classification — an appeal to language, not operation (Law 8b): 'chord symbols can no longer be read' and 'harmonic analysis has nothing to name' are precisely the naming-consequences that, standing alone, file no dependency. Direction is if anything reversed: intervals among a chord's members are downstream of the chord, and both chord and interval take pitch as substrate — the board has already accepted interval DEPENDS_ON pitch. Pinned sense (Law 11d): chord as simultaneous pitch set per its accepted definition, quality as a derived parameter.

Equal-temperament's accepted definition fixes its constitutive input: parameter (1) 'frame — the octave, the 2:1 frequency ratio being divided', and the board already accepted equal-temperament DEPENDS_ON octave on exactly that ground. Law 7 (which came first), from independent historical reasoning, not the graph's epoch. Beating — the |f1 - f2| difference phenomenon of two close frequencies — is documented in acoustics centuries before any heterodyne device (difference tones worked through the 18th century; beat-based frequency comparison long before radio). Heterodyning — the deliberate use of a nonlinear mixing element to select the difference product and shift a signal to a fixed intermediate frequency — is the early-20th-century application of that older principle (superheterodyne architecture, Armstrong's 1918 patent, per the accepted definition's own persistence clause). The accepted definitions confirm the direction: interference-beat's definition lists 'heterodyning' among the map's standard exploitations, and heterodyning's definition explicitly distinguishes itself as the technique built on the 'naturally occurring difference tone' the beat map names. Heterodyning is derived from the interference beat. Direction correct. ADVANCE.

The accepted definition's own persistence clause states it persists 'in communication systems that move signals to a fixed intermediate frequency for gain and filtering.' Servant (the mixing technique) points at master (communication: the intentional exchange of meaning through encoded signals). Secondary uses (spectrum analysis) do not negate the primary design purpose. ADVANCE.

Tmesis is an instance of figure-of-speech, and figure-of-speech is itself pending INSTANCE_OF to rhetorical-device in this same queue (gd316ec6); once that rung stands, the filer's leap to rhetorical-device is derivable through the ladder — refused per Law 11e. The note's premise ('no linguistic-figure or rhetorical-figure entry exists') misses the live figure-of-speech holder. File against the nearer kind. STRIKE.

Carves per Law 4 with three concrete parameters: (1) a pattern rather than a single event — recurs across trials, individuals, populations; (2) nameable and distinguishable — a stable label with characteristic task batteries or operational signatures; (3) measurable — an operational signature (RT difference, error-rate difference, performance gap) separates it from baseline. The persistence mechanism is real, not "it exists as a database row": research programs (replication, meta-analysis, longitudinal study), institutional practice (journals, conferences, funding categories), and pedagogical transmission (textbooks, curricula) — the toolkit/standards/curricula pattern that stands. It also draws the map boundary correctly: "the phenomenon-as-studied, not the underlying natural process; that boundary is the map's." Law 6 trailer present. ADVANCE.

A bias satisfies all three parameters of the target's carve: recurring regularity (stable across individuals and populations), nameable (each bias holds a stable label — anchoring, framing, availability — with characteristic task batteries), measurable (choice- and error-rate deviations against a normative baseline). A pattern of mental operation: deviation in decision-making and reasoning is precisely that. Not a ladder leap: cognitive-bias's accepted parents (bias, heuristic, reasoning-bias) do not connect to cognitive-phenomenon — bias is broader than the cognitive, holding statistical children (confounding, selection-bias) that are not patterns of mental operation. So this is a direct claim on a parallel kind alongside the bias parent — the same parallel-parent pattern the court has accepted elsewhere. Pinned sense (bias as a systematic deviation pattern within cognition) matches the target's definition. Law 9. ADVANCE.

Transfer fits the target's carve: a recurring regularity (near/far and positive/negative transfer replicate across contexts), nameable with stable labels and paradigm signatures (transfer paradigms are exactly the task-battery kind the definition names), and measurable (performance gap between contexts against baseline). The definition's domain list explicitly includes "learning" among the mental operations. transfer-of-learning has no accepted INSTANCE_OF parent, so cognitive-phenomenon is its nearest accepted kind — no leap, and no nearer same-kind parent in place. Pinned sense (the measurable cross-context learning regularity) matches the target. Law 9, 11e. ADVANCE.

A figure of speech is a specific kind of rhetorical device: the target carves "a structured pattern of language use designed to produce specific effects on an audience," and figure-of-speech is the figurative, word-structured subclass of that — a competent speaker calls a figure of speech a kind of rhetorical device (standard taxonomy: rhetorical device ⊃ figure of speech). No ladder leap: figure-of-speech has no accepted INSTANCE_OF parent, so rhetorical-device is its nearest accepted kind. The board already accepts overlapping membership (metaphor, simile, chiasmus, euphemism, anaphora, ellipsis are accepted INST of BOTH kinds), so seating the parent relation between the two kinds is consistent with, not in tension with, the record. Pinned sense (a linguistic pattern designed for effect, not merely a descriptive label) matches the target's definition. Law 9. ADVANCE.

The nearest-kind concern is real but is settled by board practice: tmesis → figure-of-speech is already ACCEPTED, and the court has repeatedly accepted the broader twin alongside the nearer parent — metaphor, simile, chiasmus, euphemism, anaphora, ellipsis, pleonasm, tautology, syllepsis all stand as accepted INST of BOTH figure-of-speech and rhetorical-device. The target's accepted definition carves intent as "a mental state that directs action toward a specific goal or outcome" (parameters: agent, goal specificity, temporal horizon). The source's accepted definition carves planning as a PRACTICE — "organizing actions, resources, and decisions in advance." A practice that organizes means is not a kind of a directed mental state: the categories differ. Planning is intentional (it carries a goal parameter), but "being intentional" is a property, not a kind — "X is intentional" does not make X a kind of intent. A competent speaker says a plan is intentional, or that planning serves an intent; they do not say planning is a kind of intent. An intent can exist without any plan (impulse) and a plan can outlive the intent that formed it. The note's pinned sense ("planning as a forward-directed intent") redefines the source to fit the target instead of pinning what planning actually is per its accepted carve. The relation the note really describes (a practice in service of a goal state) is not INSTANCE_OF. Law 9, 11d. STRIKE.

The target carves intent as a directed mental state (agent, goal specificity, temporal horizon). The source carves premeditation as a deliberative PROCESS — "the deliberate advance consideration of future actions and their consequences," with parameters temporal displacement, consequence mapping, behavioral inhibition. A process of advance consideration is not a kind of directed mental state: premeditation is the deliberation that may form an intent, and in the legal standards the target's own definition cites as persistence mechanism, premeditation is a temporal property of intent's FORMATION (premeditated intent), not a species of intent. The note's nearest-kind premise is false: "No premeditation or planning entry exists that captures this as a kind" — planning exists and is accepted, and premeditation → planning is an ACCEPTED INSTANCE_OF edge; planning is the same class (practice) and the nearer kind. The pinned sense ("the temporal dimension of intent — forethought preceding action") describes a dimension of intent's formation, not membership in intent. Law 9, 11d. STRIKE.

The note argues the WRONG target in its own first sentence: "A cognitive bias IS a specific kind of cognitive phenomenon" — yet the edge is filed to cognition. The pinned sense ("a deviation within cognition, not cognition itself") concedes a bias is not a kind of the faculty: it is a distortion pattern WITHIN the faculty's domain. The target's accepted definition names the map of "the set of mental processes — perception, memory, reasoning, problem-solving, and attention." A bias is a cross-process deviation pattern — it distorts reasoning, judgment, and memory together — and is not a member of that set. A topic within a discipline is not an instance of the discipline (Law 9a). The board's accepted children of cognition are processes and sub-faculties (perception, working-memory, metacognition, belief-formation, intuition); a bias belongs to none of those classes. Law 11d: judges judge the pinned sense, and the pinned sense does not make the filed edge true. STRIKE.

The target carves cognition as the map of "the set of mental processes — perception, memory, reasoning, problem-solving, and attention." Transfer of learning is not a member of that set: it is a cross-context REGULARITY about how acquired learning alters later learning — a topic within the discipline, not a process of the faculty (Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline). The pinned sense ("a cognitive mechanism of generalization") describes a regularity operating ACROSS processes, not a process in the set. Its nearest-kind claim ("No learning-transfer or cognitive-transfer entry exists; cognition is the nearest accepted kind") is overtaken in this same queue: cognitive-phenomenon — "a recurring, nameable pattern of mental operation ... in perception, memory, reasoning, attention, or learning" — is pending alongside, and a parallel edge from this same source to it (which I ADVANCE) is the structurally correct home. A studied regularity belongs to the category of studied regularities, not to the faculty map. STRIKE.

The note's nearest-kind premise is false on its face: "No priming-mechanism or cognitive-bias entry exists that captures this as a kind" — the cognitive-bias entry exists and is ACCEPTED, and priming → cognitive-bias is an ACCEPTED INSTANCE_OF edge. Priming already has a nearer accepted parent of the correct class (a regularity of mental operation); cognition is neither nearer nor the same class. The target carves cognition as the map of "the set of mental processes — perception, memory, reasoning, problem-solving, and attention." Priming is an influence REGULARITY — a pattern by which prior exposure alters subsequent response — not a member of that set of processes. A topic within the discipline is not an instance of the discipline (Law 9a). The pinned sense ("a cognitive mechanism of unconscious influence") describes a mechanism within the faculty's domain, not a kind of the faculty. STRIKE.
